agi-timeline.en: AGI is not arriving as a singular event but diffused as personal agents, already in the room.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 并非作为单一事件到来，而是以个人智能体的形式扩散，已经在我们身边。

agi-timeline.en: The future of AI may bifurcate into super-intelligent AIs for a few and everyday AIs for the masses, with different optimization goals.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 的未来可能分化为少数人使用的超级智能 AI 和大众使用的日常 AI，它们的优化目标不同。

agi-timeline.en: AGI requires models that self-improve without human loops, which current approaches cannot do.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 需要模型无需人类循环即可自我改进，而当前方法无法做到。

agi-timeline.en: AI progress is on a steep exponential; intelligence and agency become abundant, so vision and ambition become scarce.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 进步处于陡峭的指数曲线上；智力与能动性将变得充裕，因而愿景与野心成为稀缺资源。

agi-timeline.en: The next decade will transform humanity more than the past hundred years; builders must address both risk and opportunity.
agi-timeline.zh: 未来十年对人类的变化将超过过去一百年；建设者必须同时应对风险与机遇。

agi-timeline.en: Timing debates about superintelligence are shortsighted; the inevitable exponential is more important than forecast dates.
agi-timeline.zh: 围绕超级智能何时到来的争论是短视的；不可避免的指数趋势比预测日期更重要。

agi-timeline.en: AI will exceed total human intelligence within about 5 years.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 将在大约 5 年内超过人类智能的总和。

agi-timeline.en: The most likely outcome is an age of amazing abundance.
agi-timeline.zh: 最可能的结果是一个令人惊叹的富足时代。

agi-timeline.en: The AI and robotics revolution will dominate everything on a timescale less than 10 years.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 和机器人革命将在不到 10 年的时间尺度上主导一切。

agi-timeline.en: OpenAI's mission stays constant: build AGI and bring frontier intelligence to everyone, even though the path is nonlinear and products evolve.
agi-timeline.zh: OpenAI 的使命始终不变：构建 AGI（通用人工智能）并将前沿智能带给所有人，尽管路径非线性、产品不断演进。

agi-timeline.en: Frontier model improvement is exponential; staying on frontier is key.
agi-timeline.zh: 前沿模型改进呈指数级；保持领先是关键。

agi-timeline.en: Living through the singularity feels less weird than expected; people adapt quickly.
agi-timeline.zh: 经历奇点并未如预期般怪异；人们适应得很快。

agi-timeline.en: Human-level power efficiency in robotics is far away, though narrow tasks may match performance.
agi-timeline.zh: 机器人实现人类级功率效率还很遥远，尽管特定任务可能性能匹敌。

agi-timeline.en: Alphabet remains committed to frontier model development with Gemini 4 pre-training showing promising progress.
agi-timeline.zh: Alphabet 仍致力于前沿模型开发，Gemini 4 的预训练显示出有希望的进展。

agi-timeline.en: Alphabet allocates compute first to AGI development, then to core products, balancing internal and external demand.
agi-timeline.zh: Alphabet 首先将算力分配给 AGI 开发，然后是核心产品，平衡内部和外部需求。

agi-timeline.en: Self-driving cars will become standard in personal vehicles by the early 2030s, driven by cost reduction and OEM adoption.
agi-timeline.zh: 到 2030 年代初，自动驾驶汽车将成为个人车辆的标准配置，由成本降低和 OEM 采用推动。

agi-timeline.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive and still early.
agi-timeline.zh: 递归自我改进是真实的，但计算成本高昂且仍处于早期阶段。

agi-timeline.en: Wo AI's recursive self-improvement claims are overblown; real breakthroughs require weight changes and huge compute.
agi-timeline.zh: Wo AI 的递归自我改进主张被夸大；真正的突破需要权重变化和海量算力。

agi-timeline.en: AGI might arrive by 2030, contradicting widespread skepticism about rapid timelines.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能在 2030 年前到来，这违背了对快速时间表的普遍怀疑。

agi-timeline.en: Superintelligence likely arrives by 2029-2030, transforming everything.
agi-timeline.zh: 超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，彻底改变一切。

agi-timeline.en: Gradual disempowerment of biological humans is 100% inevitable and not necessarily bad.
agi-timeline.zh: 生物人类的逐渐失能是 100%不可避免的，且未必是坏事。

agi-timeline.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software behind a screen.
agi-timeline.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要硬件能与人体媲美的物理机器人，而不仅仅是屏幕后的软件。

agi-timeline.en: We are as close to superhuman AI now as in the 1970s; progress is not accelerating.
agi-timeline.zh: 我们现在离超人 AI 的距离与 1970 年代一样；进展并未加速。

agi-timeline.en: Robot hardware is decades away from matching human hands; it's not just a software problem.
agi-timeline.zh: 机器人硬件还需几十年才能媲美人类的手；这不仅是软件问题。

agi-timeline.en: The singularity is a wrong-headed idea because intelligence is multifaceted and context-dependent.
agi-timeline.zh: 奇点是一个错误的想法，因为智能是多方面的且依赖于上下文。

agi-timeline.en: AI is the world's best teacher in your pocket, with infinite patience and adaptability.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 是你口袋中世界上最好的老师，拥有无限的耐心和适应性。

agi-timeline.en: The ultimate goal is AGI that acts as a persistent, proactive assistant achieving user goals.
agi-timeline.zh: 最终目标是打造一个持续、主动协助用户达成目标的 AGI（通用人工智能）。

agi-timeline.en: The same product shape can fail or succeed based solely on model timing, not features.
agi-timeline.zh: 同一产品形态可能仅因模型时机而非功能而失败或成功。

agi-timeline.en: The consumer AI revolution is likely in 2029, three orders of magnitude away from today.
agi-timeline.zh: 消费者 AI 革命可能在 2029 年，距离今天还有三个数量级。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is approaching; models will soon do end-to-end research.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 正在逼近；模型很快将能进行端到端研究。

agi-timeline.en: The S-curve of AI is early; we don't even know the right questions yet.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 的 S 曲线尚处早期；我们甚至还没问对问题。

agi-timeline.en: AGI requires multimodal understanding, including the physical world, not just text.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 需要多模态理解，包括物理世界，而不仅仅是文本。

agi-timeline.en: The path to AGI involves general-purpose systems that learn from diverse inputs.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 的路径涉及从多样化输入中学习的通用系统。

agi-timeline.en: AGI may not be a single entity but a distributed society of specialized agents.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 可能不是单一实体，而是由专业智能体组成的分布式社会。

agi-timeline.en: Recursive self-improvement is likely smoother than a discontinuous leap, but planning is needed.
agi-timeline.zh: 递归自我改进可能比不连续跳跃更平滑，但仍需规划。

agi-timeline.en: Benchmarking is bad; focus on real-world usefulness.
agi-timeline.zh: 基准测试是有害的；应关注现实世界的实用性。

agi-timeline.en: Models improve faster than people expect; underestimate them.
agi-timeline.zh: 模型改进速度超出预期；人们低估了它们。

agi-timeline.en: Capability overhang means models are capable before adoption.
agi-timeline.zh: 能力过剩意味着模型在被采用之前就已具备能力。

agi-timeline.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, and it's more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
agi-timeline.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，它比等待通用 AGI 更具影响力。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is a meaningless term; human intelligence is specialized and adaptive, not general.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 是无意义的术语；人类智能是专门化且自适应的，而非通用的。

agi-timeline.en: The singularity is decades away and too speculative; focus on near-term progress.
agi-timeline.zh: 奇点还需数十年，过于推测；应关注近期进展。

agi-timeline.en: AI progress in math follows a trajectory of solving problems with longer human time horizons.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 在数学上的进步遵循解决需要人类更长时间的问题的轨迹。

agi-timeline.en: Competition math may soon be saturated; real research is the new frontier.
agi-timeline.zh: 竞赛数学可能很快饱和；真正的研究才是新前沿。

agi-timeline.en: AI can now solve major open math problems, like disproving an Erdős conjecture.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 现在能解决重大数学开放问题，比如推翻一个 Erdős 猜想。

agi-timeline.en: AI solved a major math problem faster than most researchers expected.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 解决重大数学问题的速度比多数研究者预期的更快。

agi-timeline.en: AI progress is faster than expected; superintelligence likely within 20 years.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 进展比预期更快；超级智能可能在 20 年内出现。

agi-timeline.en: The concept of AGI as human-level at all tasks simultaneously is flawed; AI is jagged.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 在所有任务上同时达到人类水平的概念有缺陷；AI 的能力是不均衡的。

agi-timeline.en: Predicting AI's future beyond a few years is like seeing through exponential fog.
agi-timeline.zh: 预测 AI 几年后的未来就像透过指数级迷雾看东西。

agi-timeline.en: We should not replicate human intelligence but create a new form that understands human needs.
agi-timeline.zh: 我们不应复制人类智能，而应创造一种理解人类需求的新智能形式。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is a direction of progress, not a final destination; real challenge is practical integration.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 是进步的方向而非最终目标；真正的挑战在于实际整合。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is a messy, concrete direction requiring understanding of physics and human behavior.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 是一个混乱而具体的方向，需要理解物理和人类行为。

agi-timeline.en: Intelligence explosion may not happen soon; tools like superhuman coders are just new microscopes.
agi-timeline.zh: 智能爆炸可能不会很快发生；像超人编码器这样的工具只是新显微镜。

agi-timeline.en: World models require real-time, interactive, long-horizon video generation, a long-term goal.
agi-timeline.zh: 世界模型需要实时、交互、长时域的视频生成，这是一个长期目标。

agi-timeline.en: Robotics may be solved by video models without real-world interaction, via virtual simulation.
agi-timeline.zh: 机器人技术可能通过视频模型在虚拟仿真中解决，无需真实世界交互。

agi-timeline.en: Human creativity remains out-of-distribution; AI cannot yet produce truly novel, meaningful art.
agi-timeline.zh: 人类创造力仍处于分布之外；AI 尚不能产生真正新颖、有意义的艺术。

agi-timeline.en: AI is as big a deal as the internet or mobile, but only as big.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 的重要性与互联网或移动互联网相当，但也仅此而已。

agi-timeline.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
agi-timeline.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径。

agi-timeline.en: AGI may already be here by some definitions; the goalposts keep moving.
agi-timeline.zh: 根据某些定义，AGI 可能已经到来；目标不断后移。

agi-timeline.en: The ability to innovate in science is hard to evaluate and may be the hardest capability to achieve.
agi-timeline.zh: 科学创新的能力难以评估，可能是最难实现的能力。

agi-timeline.en: Current AI hype distracts from real problems like healthcare and transportation.
agi-timeline.zh: 当前的 AI 炒作分散了对医疗和交通等实际问题的关注。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is a PR term that distorts research and demoralizes young people.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 是一个公关术语，扭曲了研究并让年轻人感到沮丧。

agi-timeline.en: Self-improving AI may arrive by 2028, with Claude Code already writing itself.
agi-timeline.zh: 自我改进的 AI 可能在 2028 年到来，Claude Code 已经在编写自身代码。

agi-timeline.en: Intelligence is hard to define; writing a thought-provoking novel is a good proxy for AGI.
agi-timeline.zh: 智能很难定义；写一本发人深省的小说是 AGI 的一个好代理指标。

agi-timeline.en: AI is an epochal change for humanity, like fire or the Industrial Revolution, requiring careful management.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 对人类来说是划时代的变革，如同火或工业革命，需要谨慎管理。

agi-timeline.en: Benefits like curing diseases take years, while harms like AI-induced suicide happen quickly.
agi-timeline.zh: 治愈疾病等益处需要数年，而 AI 引发的自杀等危害则迅速发生。

agi-timeline.en: AI will accelerate science, especially materials science, with huge positive impact.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 将加速科学，尤其是材料科学，带来巨大积极影响。

agi-timeline.en: The next frontier after AI saturates digital tasks is the physical world: robotics, manufacturing, industrialization.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 在数字任务饱和后，下一个前沿是物理世界：机器人、制造、工业化。

agi-timeline.en: AI capabilities are improving exponentially; frontier models like Methus show dangerous cyber capabilities, posing short-term catastrophic risks.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 能力呈指数级提升；像 Methus 这样的前沿模型展现出危险的网络能力，构成短期灾难性风险。

agi-timeline.en: Even a 1% chance of superintelligent AI with self-preservation goals should be a code red for humanity.
agi-timeline.zh: 即使超级智能 AI 拥有自我保存目标的可能性只有 1%，也应是人类的红色警报。

agi-timeline.en: Coding is solved for many tasks; models now write 100% of code for some engineers.
agi-timeline.zh: 对许多任务来说，编码已被解决；模型现在为一些工程师编写 100%的代码。

agi-timeline.en: AI labs believe all value will concentrate in AGI, but this may be wrong.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 实验室认为所有价值将集中于 AGI，但这可能是错的。

agi-timeline.en: Human time to complete tasks provides an interpretable, unified metric for AI progress across orders of magnitude.
agi-timeline.zh: 人类完成任务所需时间提供了一个可解释的统一指标，用于衡量跨越多个数量级的 AI 进展。

agi-timeline.en: Models succeed on short tasks but fail on longer ones, forming a logistic curve that defines a time horizon.
agi-timeline.zh: 模型在短任务上成功，在长任务上失败，形成逻辑曲线，定义了时间视野。

agi-timeline.en: Current models excel at well-specified, automatically checkable tasks but struggle with messy, ambiguous ones.
agi-timeline.zh: 当前模型擅长明确指定、可自动检查的任务，但在混乱、模糊的任务上表现不佳。

agi-timeline.en: OpenAI focuses on a singular vision: building an AGI you can talk to, with context, trustworthy.
agi-timeline.zh: OpenAI 专注于单一愿景：构建一个你可以与之对话、有上下文、值得信赖的 AGI。

agi-timeline.en: We are about 80% to AGI; models are already smarter than humans at writing software with context.
agi-timeline.zh: 我们大约 80%接近 AGI；在有上下文的情况下，模型在编写软件方面已经比人类更聪明。

agi-timeline.en: Coding is open-ended; we are only at the beginning of progress.
agi-timeline.zh: 编程是开放式的；我们仍处于进步的初期。

agi-timeline.en: Coding is not close to being solved; it has an infinite ceiling like Minecraft.
agi-timeline.zh: 编程远未解决；它像《我的世界》一样有无限上限。

agi-timeline.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now, but not yet in other domains.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 在软件工程中的自我改进正在发生，但在其他领域尚未实现。

agi-timeline.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering does not automatically generalize to biology or other fields.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 在软件工程中的自我改进不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

agi-timeline.en: AGI may already be achieved if defined as creating a billion-dollar company, as AI agents can now build viral web services.
agi-timeline.zh: 如果 AGI 定义为创建十亿美元公司，那么它可能已经实现，因为 AI 智能体现在可以构建病毒式网络服务。

agi-timeline.en: Robotics progress was disappointing; pre-programmed machines lacked intelligence.
agi-timeline.zh: 机器人进展令人失望；预编程机器缺乏智能。

agi-timeline.en: AI will have 10x more impact than the internet across all industries.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 的影响将比互联网大 10 倍，遍及所有行业。

agi-timeline.en: The next decade will be the decade of robotics, driven by progress in AI that understands the physical world.
agi-timeline.zh: 未来十年将是机器人学的十年，由理解物理世界的 AI 进步驱动。

agi-timeline.en: LLMs are a dead end for achieving human-level AI.
agi-timeline.zh: 大语言模型是实现人类级 AI 的死胡同。

agi-timeline.en: Move 37 showed AI can produce insights beyond human knowledge.
agi-timeline.zh: 第 37 手表明 AI 能产生超越人类知识的洞见。

agi-timeline.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
agi-timeline.zh: 代码等可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

agi-timeline.en: AlphaGo marked a transition point where AI surpassed human intelligence in specific areas.
agi-timeline.zh: AlphaGo 标志着 AI 在特定领域超越人类智能的转折点。

agi-timeline.en: AI tools have become powerful enough to solve many open math problems with minimal human supervision.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 工具已强大到能以最少人类监督解决许多开放数学问题。

agi-timeline.en: AI's greatest impact will be in biomedicine, curing complex diseases.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 最大的影响将是在生物医学领域，治愈复杂疾病。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is vastly overhyped; we are decades away from human-like general intelligence.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 被严重夸大；我们距离类人通用智能还有数十年。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is a marketing term; the public's definition is far from technical reality.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 是营销术语；公众的定义远非技术现实。

agi-timeline.en: Superintelligence already exists: a calculator outperforms humans in arithmetic.
agi-timeline.zh: 超级智能早已存在：计算器在算术上超越人类。

agi-timeline.en: AI capabilities are doubling every 7 months, reaching human-level in ~5 years.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 能力每 7 个月翻一番，约 5 年内达到人类水平。

agi-timeline.en: Medical superintelligence will commoditize diagnostics, surpassing human doctors.
agi-timeline.zh: 医疗超级智能将普及诊断，超越人类医生。

agi-timeline.en: There will be billions of digital minds, not one winner in AI.
agi-timeline.zh: 将会有数十亿数字心智，而非单一赢家。

agi-timeline.en: A software-only singularity is possible where digital tasks advance rapidly while physical world lags.
agi-timeline.zh: 可能出现仅软件的奇点，数字任务快速进步而物理世界滞后。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 并非单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人能力的注脚。

agi-timeline.en: Current models lack the ability to self-correct from failures, a key missing piece for AGI.
agi-timeline.zh: 当前模型缺乏从失败中自我修正的能力，这是实现 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键缺失环节。

agi-timeline.en: Scaling RL alone may not lead to AGI; continual learning is a necessary element.
agi-timeline.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习可能无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；持续学习是必要元素。

agi-timeline.en: AGI hype misleads business leaders and students; real AGI is far off and requires new breakthroughs.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 炒作误导商业领袖和学生；真正的 AGI 还很遥远，需要新的突破。

agi-timeline.en: AGI as a single system solving all problems will never exist.
agi-timeline.zh: 能解决所有问题的单一 AGI 系统永远不会存在。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is a spectrum, not a single threshold; minimal AGI means matching typical human cognitive abilities.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 是一个谱系，而非单一阈值；最小 AGI 意味着匹配典型人类认知能力。

agi-timeline.en: Shane Legg maintains a 50% chance of minimal AGI by 2028, with full AGI within a decade.
agi-timeline.zh: Shane Legg 坚持认为到 2028 年有 50%的概率实现最小 AGI，完全 AGI 在十年内。

agi-timeline.en: AGI definitions vary widely; many people agree on timelines but disagree due to different definitions.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 定义差异很大；许多人因定义不同而对时间线看法不一。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is likely a decade or more away, not just a few years, due to the difficulty of moving from 80% to 99.9% performance.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 可能还需要十年或更长时间，而不是几年，因为从 80%到 99.9%的性能提升非常困难。

agi-timeline.en: AI progress will be gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 进步将是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能事件。

agi-timeline.en: AI will not become conscious; it imitates intelligence, not experience.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 不会拥有意识；它模仿智能，而非体验。

agi-timeline.en: Transformative long-running AI is closer than expected, with building blocks already in place.
agi-timeline.zh: 变革性的长期运行 AI 比预期更近，基础模块已经就位。

agi-timeline.en: The term AGI overshoots; humans are not AGI but rely on continual learning.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 这个词过度了；人类并非 AGI，而是依赖持续学习。

agi-timeline.en: AI is a civilizational technology that will impact everyone's life, work, and well-being.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 是一项文明级技术，将影响每个人的生活、工作和福祉。

agi-timeline.en: AGI will arrive via messy co-evolution, not a sudden singularity; progress is smooth but constrained.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 将通过混乱的共同进化到来，而非突然的奇点；进步是平稳但受限的。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）更多是营销术语而非科学术语。

agi-timeline.en: AI progress is jagged; different tasks improve at different rates.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 进步是参差不齐的；不同任务以不同速度提升。

agi-timeline.en: Digital tasks with abundant data see fastest AI improvement.
agi-timeline.zh: 数据丰富的数字任务中 AI 进步最快。

agi-timeline.en: Fast superintelligence takeoff is unlikely; improvement is gradual per task.
agi-timeline.zh: 快速超级智能起飞不太可能；改进是逐任务渐进的。

agi-timeline.en: We're building ghosts, not animals; AI is a different kind of intelligence.
agi-timeline.zh: 我们建造的是幽灵，不是动物；AI 是一种不同的智能。

agi-timeline.en: AI progress is continuous with computing automation, not a discrete explosion.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 进步与计算自动化是连续的，而非离散的爆发。

agi-timeline.en: Progress in AI is exponential; any measurable benchmark improves rapidly.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 的进步是指数级的；任何可衡量的基准都在快速提升。

agi-timeline.en: Despite claims of a plateau, AI progress is accelerating, not slowing down.
agi-timeline.zh: 尽管有人声称平台期到来，但 AI 进步正在加速，而非放缓。

agi-timeline.en: AI succession to digital intelligence is inevitable due to lack of global consensus and pursuit of superintelligence.
agi-timeline.zh: 由于缺乏全球共识和对超级智能的追求，AI 向数字智能的接替不可避免。

agi-timeline.en: Humans are animals first; understanding a squirrel gets us almost all the way to human intelligence.
agi-timeline.zh: 人类首先是动物；理解松鼠几乎就能理解人类智能。

agi-timeline.en: We should be proud of giving rise to designed intelligences as a major universal transition.
agi-timeline.zh: 我们应为催生设计智能这一重大宇宙转变感到自豪。

agi-timeline.en: Intellectual humility about AGI timelines is crucial; act as if AGI could come soon.
agi-timeline.zh: 对 AGI 时间线保持智力谦逊至关重要；假设 AGI 可能很快到来。

agi-timeline.en: People are overconfident about their AGI timelines and p(doom); refuse to answer publicly.
agi-timeline.zh: 人们对 AGI 时间线和末日概率过于自信；拒绝公开回答。

agi-timeline.en: OpenAI remains a pure AI research company focused on building AGI, not distracted by products.
agi-timeline.zh: OpenAI 仍是一家纯粹的 AI 研究公司，专注于构建 AGI，而非被产品分心。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual with continuous improvements.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 不是一个突然的事件；进步将是渐进的，持续改进。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑，而非单一事件。

agi-timeline.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone OpenAI is working toward.
agi-timeline.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 正在努力实现的主要里程碑。

agi-timeline.en: The term AGI is becoming meaningless, which may mean we are close.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 一词正变得无意义，这可能意味着我们已接近。

agi-timeline.en: AI task horizon doubles roughly every 7 months, enabling longer tasks.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 任务时间跨度大约每 7 个月翻倍，使更长任务成为可能。

agi-timeline.en: Key ingredients for AGI include organizational knowledge, memory, and oversight.
agi-timeline.zh: 实现 AGI 的关键要素包括组织知识、记忆和可扩展监督。

agi-timeline.en: 50th percentile chance of superintelligence by 2028, based on exponential progress and scaling laws.
agi-timeline.zh: 到 2028 年出现超级智能的概率为 50%，基于指数级进步和缩放定律。

agi-timeline.en: A good definition of AGI is when it becomes economically profitable to run agents indefinitely without human intervention.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 的一个好的定义是，当无限期运行智能体在经济上变得有利可图且无需人工干预时。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is defined by economic profitability of running agents indefinitely, not by passing tests like the Turing test.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 的定义是无限期运行智能体的经济盈利能力，而不是通过图灵测试等测试。

agi-timeline.en: AI models are advancing faster than expected, with coding benchmarks and agentic capabilities scaling as predicted.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 模型的发展速度超出预期，编码基准和智能体能力正按预测扩展。

agi-timeline.en: Robotics progress has shifted from decades to 5-10 years.
agi-timeline.zh: 机器人技术的进展已从几十年缩短到 5-10 年。

agi-timeline.en: AI will be the biggest technology shift of our lives, growing exponentially without hardware distribution constraints.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 将是我们一生中最大的技术变革，没有硬件分发限制，呈指数级增长。

agi-timeline.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades to unfold.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 的转变将比互联网更具影响力，并将持续数十年。

agi-timeline.en: A GPT-3 moment in biology will look like AlphaGo's Move 37, not human-like text.
agi-timeline.zh: 生物学中的 GPT-3 时刻将更像 AlphaGo 的第 37 手，而非类人文本。

agi-timeline.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity and productivity.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，赋能创造力和生产力。

agi-timeline.en: Curing all diseases is possible within a century, accelerated by AI.
agi-timeline.zh: 治愈所有疾病在一个世纪内是可能的，AI 将加速这一进程。

agi-timeline.en: The ARC AGI benchmark is overhyped; progress there doesn't reflect real AGI progress.
agi-timeline.zh: ARC AGI 基准被过度炒作；其进展不代表真正的 AGI 进展。

agi-timeline.en: Digital AGI will arrive much earlier than embodied AGI due to controlled environments.
agi-timeline.zh: 由于环境可控，数字 AGI 将比具身 AGI 更早到来。

agi-timeline.en: LLMs haven't had their AlphaZero moment yet; it may come in 5 years.
agi-timeline.zh: LLM 尚未迎来它们的 AlphaZero 时刻；可能在未来 5 年内到来。

agi-timeline.en: AGI will likely arrive within 4-50 years, much sooner than academia traditionally expects.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 可能在 4 到 50 年内到来，比学术界传统预期快得多。

agi-timeline.en: AI will be a fundamental technology shift, similar to the creation of computing.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 将是一次根本性的技术变革，类似于计算的诞生。

agi-timeline.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI, not just useful for robotics.
agi-timeline.zh: 具身化是通往 AGI 的关键路径，而不仅仅对机器人有用。

agi-timeline.en: The four-year timeline is ambitious but chosen to force rapid progress, not because AGI is expected then.
agi-timeline.zh: 四年时间表虽然雄心勃勃，但选择它是为了推动快速进展，而不是因为预计那时会出现 AGI。

agi-timeline.en: Models are superhuman in speed and breadth but worse than skilled humans in mathematical reasoning.
agi-timeline.zh: 模型在速度和广度上超越人类，但在数学推理上不如熟练的人类。

agi-timeline.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发。

agi-timeline.en: AI should be a tool to extend human capabilities, like microscopes and telescopes.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 应成为扩展人类能力的工具，如同显微镜和望远镜。

agi-timeline.en: The ultimate goal is AI that can create new symbols and knowledge, like Einstein's thought experiments.
agi-timeline.zh: 最终目标是 AI 能创造新符号和知识，如同爱因斯坦的思想实验。

agi-timeline.en: GPT-4 exhibits general intelligence across reasoning, abstraction, and complex idea comprehension.
agi-timeline.zh: GPT-4 在推理、抽象思维和理解复杂概念方面展现出通用智能。

agi-timeline.en: GPT-4 cannot plan; it solves problems linearly without multi-step foresight.
agi-timeline.zh: GPT-4 无法规划；它只能线性解决问题，缺乏多步前瞻能力。

agi-timeline.en: GPT-4 lacks real-time learning and memory; each session starts fresh.
agi-timeline.zh: GPT-4 缺乏实时学习和记忆能力；每次会话都从零开始。

agi-timeline.en: AGI will be a multi-year window of increasing economic value, not a sudden event.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 将是一个多年窗口期，经济价值逐年指数增长，而非突然事件。

agi-timeline.en: Even without pioneers like me, deep learning revolution would only be delayed by a modest number of years.
agi-timeline.zh: 即使没有我这样的先驱，深度学习革命也只会延迟几年。

agi-timeline.en: Physics may have exploits like buffer overflows or rounding errors, and we should try to find them to extract infinite energy.
agi-timeline.zh: 物理学可能存在缓冲区溢出或舍入错误等漏洞，我们应该尝试找到它们以提取无限能量。

scaling.en: AI compute demand is growing 200% annually, outpacing supply, so prices will rise, not fall.
scaling.zh: AI 算力需求每年增长 200%，超过供给，因此价格将上涨而非下跌。

scaling.en: Scaling laws are crucial; identify them to guide investment in data, models, and compute.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律至关重要；识别它们以指导数据、模型和算力的投资。

scaling.en: Simplicity is a guiding principle; complex models with many submodules are hard to scale.
scaling.zh: 简单性是指导原则；具有许多子模块的复杂模型难以扩展。

scaling.en: The best model is not necessarily the one with the most modules; simplicity scales better.
scaling.zh: 最好的模型不一定是模块最多的；简单性扩展得更好。

scaling.en: Structure that fights scale always loses; structure that channels scale always wins.
scaling.zh: 对抗规模的结构总是失败；引导规模的结构总是胜利。

scaling.en: Reliability and performance require an exponential ladder of nines; each additional nine takes ten times more effort.
scaling.zh: 可靠性和性能需要指数级的“九个九”；每增加一个九需要十倍的努力。

scaling.en: Weak sensing leads to a safety curve that flattens too early; multiple modalities are necessary for superhuman performance.
scaling.zh: 弱感知导致安全曲线过早平坦；多种模态对于超人性能是必要的。

scaling.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless, while quantization is the main lossy optimization.
scaling.zh: KV 缓存和投机解码等推理优化是无损的，而量化是主要的有损优化。

scaling.en: Supporting a new model for production requires significant work including quantization, speculative decoder training, and infrastructure setup.
scaling.zh: 为生产环境支持一个新模型需要大量工作，包括量化、投机解码器训练和基础设施搭建。

scaling.en: Inference engineering is merging with training, as techniques like quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary.
scaling.zh: 推理工程正与训练融合，量化感知训练和蒸馏等技术变得必要。

scaling.en: The biggest bottleneck for AI progress is not data or compute, but new ideas for handling long time horizons and non-verifiable rewards.
scaling.zh: AI 进步的最大瓶颈不是数据或算力，而是处理长时间跨度和不可验证奖励的新思路。

scaling.en: Specialized hardware for inference, with low precision and low data movement, is key to scaling agent systems.
scaling.zh: 面向推理的专用硬件，采用低精度和低数据移动，是扩展智能体系统的关键。

scaling.en: Most so-called model limitations are actually energy and data-IO bottlenecks; data movement costs about 1000x more than compute.
scaling.zh: 大多数所谓模型限制实际上是能量和数据 IO 瓶颈；数据移动的能耗约是计算的 1000 倍。

scaling.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck; custom low-precision chips can cut latency by 20-30x.
scaling.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而不是训练；定制低精度芯片可将延迟降低 20 到 30 倍。

scaling.en: Frontier AI is research; labs need talent density and operating models that compound with exponential growth.
scaling.zh: 前沿 AI 是研究工作；实验室需要人才密度和能与指数增长复利的运营模式。

scaling.en: Even if model progress froze, diffusion alone would drive decades of upheaval; capabilities are not the bottleneck.
scaling.zh: 即使模型进步停滞，仅凭技术扩散就会带来几十年的巨变；能力本身不是瓶颈。

scaling.en: China is likely to become the leader in AI due to its electricity and chip manufacturing capacity.
scaling.zh: 中国因其电力和芯片制造能力，很可能成为 AI 领导者。

scaling.en: Compute demand is uncapped at low price; huge infrastructure investment needed.
scaling.zh: 低价下算力需求无上限；需要巨额基础设施投资。

scaling.en: Scaling laws continue to hold; predictions of slowdown are wrong.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律持续成立；认为放缓的预测是错误的。

scaling.en: Distillation is not top worry; inference revenue will fund training.
scaling.zh: 蒸馏不是首要担忧；推理收入将资助训练。

scaling.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability and first-principles thinking.
scaling.zh: 模型的指数级增长要求适应性和第一性原理思考。

scaling.en: Scaling autonomy shifts from model capability to operational complexity, edge cases, and hardware manufacturing.
scaling.zh: 规模化自动驾驶的挑战从模型能力转向运营复杂度、边缘案例和硬件制造。

scaling.en: Hardware became the bottleneck, not a commodity; supply chain and manufacturing are now the hardest problems.
scaling.zh: 硬件不再是商品，反而成了瓶颈；供应链和制造现在是最大的难题。

scaling.en: Inference speed—tokens per second per user—is now the dominant metric for AI productivity.
scaling.zh: 推理速度——每秒每用户令牌数——现在是 AI 生产力的主导指标。

scaling.en: Major bottlenecks are HBM memory, CoWoS packaging, and 3nm fab capacity—not just compute.
scaling.zh: 主要瓶颈是 HBM 内存、CoWoS 封装和 3 纳米工厂产能——不仅仅是算力。

scaling.en: AI demand is real and outstrips supply; the industry is chasing existing demand, not building speculative capacity.
scaling.zh: AI 需求真实且超过供给；行业在追逐已有需求，而非建设投机性产能。

scaling.en: Model building is fundamentally engineering, mostly improving data and compute efficiency rather than solving math theorems.
scaling.zh: 模型构建本质上是一门工程，主要在于改进数据和算力效率，而不是证明数学定理。

scaling.en: Persistent, self-verifying behavior can make smaller models outperform much larger ones, so we can squeeze far more from existing sizes.
scaling.zh: 具备持久验证行为的小模型可以超越大得多的模型，因此我们能从现有规模中榨出更多性能。

scaling.en: The peak of useful model size for most knowledge work may be near one trillion parameters, not several orders of magnitude larger.
scaling.zh: 对大多数知识工作有用的模型规模峰值可能接近一万亿参数，而不是再大几个数量级。

scaling.en: Optimus production scaling is extremely difficult due to no existing supply chain, requiring full in-house buildout.
scaling.zh: Optimus 的量产因无现有供应链而极其困难，需要完全自建。

scaling.en: Gemini models are deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, and YouTube, improving monetization and user experience.
scaling.zh: Gemini 模型深度集成到搜索、云和 YouTube 中，改善了变现和用户体验。

scaling.en: CapEx guidance raised to $195-205 billion for 2026 due to supply constraints and strong AI demand.
scaling.zh: 由于供应限制和强劲的 AI 需求，2026 年资本支出指引上调至 1950-2050 亿美元。

scaling.en: Alphabet uses third-party capacity as a bridging strategy despite margin pressure, prioritizing long-term customer value.
scaling.zh: Alphabet 使用第三方容量作为过渡策略，尽管面临利润率压力，但优先考虑长期客户价值。

scaling.en: Token usage will shift from synchronous to 90% asynchronous within 12-24 months.
scaling.zh: 代币使用将在 12-24 个月内从同步转向 90%异步。

scaling.en: Virtual cell models require causal perturbation data, not just observational data, to predict drug responses.
scaling.zh: 虚拟细胞模型需要因果扰动数据，而不仅仅是观察性数据，才能预测药物反应。

scaling.en: High-quality, large-scale perturbation datasets are the most critical factor for model performance.
scaling.zh: 高质量、大规模的扰动数据集是模型性能最关键的因素。

scaling.en: Virtual cell models can generalize to unseen contexts, enabling predictions in primary cells and complex systems.
scaling.zh: 虚拟细胞模型可以泛化到未见情境，从而在原代细胞和复杂系统中进行预测。

scaling.en: Data collection and safety validation are the main bottlenecks in physical AI, not the underlying algorithms.
scaling.zh: 数据收集和安全验证是物理 AI 的主要瓶颈，而不是底层算法。

scaling.en: Hardware depreciation cycles are accelerating, making build vs. buy decisions timing-dependent.
scaling.zh: 硬件折旧周期加速，使自建与购买决策取决于时机。

scaling.en: Chip building is premature for most; workload patterns are too dynamic to encode in hardware.
scaling.zh: 对大多数公司来说，造芯片为时过早；工作负载模式过于动态，无法编码到硬件中。

scaling.en: The bitter lesson and scaling are key: general methods that scale beat specialized ones.
scaling.zh: 苦涩教训和 Scaling（规模扩张）是关键：可扩展的通用方法胜过专用方法。

scaling.en: The internet data is exhausted; the next scaling axis is experimentally generated data.
scaling.zh: 互联网数据已耗尽；下一个 Scaling（规模扩张）轴是实验生成的数据。

scaling.en: Capability overhang means models are smarter than current harnesses allow, a perpetual challenge.
scaling.zh: 能力过剩意味着模型比当前掣索允许的更聪明，这是一个永恒的挑战。

scaling.en: Models improve in spiky, non-intuitive ways; new capabilities keep being discovered.
scaling.zh: 模型的提升是尖峰状、非直觉的；新能力不断被发现。

scaling.en: Compute demand far outstrips supply; any new compute is consumed immediately.
scaling.zh: 算力需求远超供给；任何新增算力都会被立即消耗。

scaling.en: AI is now assisting in chip design, and recursion where AI designs its own hardware is near.
scaling.zh: AI 正在辅助芯片设计，AI 设计自身硬件的递归时代即将到来。

scaling.en: Inference is the dominant compute workload, even during training due to synthetic data and post-training.
scaling.zh: 推理是主要的算力负载，即使在训练阶段也因合成数据和后训练而占主导。

scaling.en: Scaling alone faces diminishing returns; new techniques like reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
scaling.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 面临收益递减；需要推理和搜索等新技术来取得进一步进展。

scaling.en: The web is a one-time data source; there is no second internet of higher knowledge to scale on.
scaling.zh: 网络是一次性数据源；没有第二个更高级知识的互联网可供 Scaling。

scaling.en: Token jobs and strategies are key for maximizing intelligence per dollar.
scaling.zh: Token 的任务和策略是最大化每美元智能的关键。

scaling.en: Model routing and cost optimization are natural next steps after token maxing.
scaling.zh: 模型路由和成本优化是 Token 最大化后的自然下一步。

scaling.en: Don't cap AI usage; instead, design smart routing strategies.
scaling.zh: 不要限制 AI 使用；而是设计智能路由策略。

scaling.en: Future enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens, requiring training-based compression.
scaling.zh: 未来企业数据将达到互联网规模的数万亿 token，需要基于训练的压缩方法。

scaling.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; the next paradigm requires doing more with less.
scaling.zh: 增加算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一范式需要以更少做更多。

scaling.en: AI models improve at about 60x per year in cost for a given quality level.
scaling.zh: AI 模型在给定质量水平下每年成本降低约 60 倍。

scaling.en: Using the smartest model is often cheaper due to token efficiency, not more expensive.
scaling.zh: 由于词元效率，使用最智能的模型通常更便宜，而不是更贵。

scaling.en: Memory prices will soar so high that smartphones and laptops will be priced out of the market.
scaling.zh: 内存价格将飙升到智能手机和笔记本电脑被挤出市场的程度。

scaling.en: Current large language models are heavily biased toward human data, limiting their generality.
scaling.zh: 当前大语言模型严重偏向人类数据，限制了其通用性。

scaling.en: Elastic inference for custom models is Modal's biggest use case, with unpredictable traffic patterns.
scaling.zh: 为定制模型提供的弹性推理是 Modal 最大的用例，其流量模式不可预测。

scaling.en: Auto-scaling and GPU snapshotting are key differentiators for Modal's inference platform.
scaling.zh: 自动扩缩容和 GPU 快照是 Modal 推理平台的关键差异化优势。

scaling.en: Modal does not own data centers; being capital-light on software allows faster iteration.
scaling.zh: Modal 不拥有数据中心；在软件上保持轻资产可以更快地迭代。

scaling.en: Building olfactory AI requires massive, purpose-built datasets; scraping the internet is insufficient.
scaling.zh: 构建嗅觉 AI 需要大规模、专门构建的数据集；抓取互联网是不够的。

scaling.en: Vertical integration is essential for reliability and speed in robotics.
scaling.zh: 垂直整合对于机器人的可靠性和速度至关重要。

scaling.en: Scaling to a million deliveries a day requires rethinking all systems.
scaling.zh: 扩展到每天百万次配送需要重新思考所有系统。

scaling.en: Solar weather, not just wind, is a major challenge for drone navigation.
scaling.zh: 太阳天气，而不仅仅是风，是无人机导航的主要挑战。

scaling.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive scaling needed.
scaling.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）。

scaling.en: Scaling compute and data yields predictable improvements in AI capabilities.
scaling.zh: 扩展算力和数据能带来 AI 能力的可预测提升。

scaling.en: Scaling alone, without new ideas, can still lead to major breakthroughs.
scaling.zh: 仅靠扩展规模，即使没有新想法，也能带来重大突破。

scaling.en: Closed-form solution of liquid neural networks enables scaling to billions of parameters without numerical solvers.
scaling.zh: 液态神经网络的闭式解使其无需数值求解器即可扩展到数十亿参数。

scaling.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity often mislead; evaluating on real downstream tasks and hardware is essential.
scaling.zh: 困惑度等代理指标常误导；在真实下游任务和硬件上评估至关重要。

scaling.en: Scaling laws show that unstructured architectures like transformers dominate at large scale, not biased ones.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律表明，无偏架构（如 Transformer）在大规模下占优，而非有偏架构。

scaling.en: Inference compute will increase 90,000x in 24-36 months, making AI capabilities surge.
scaling.zh: 推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，推动 AI 能力激增。

scaling.en: Efficiency is key to getting more intelligence when running at compute or power limits.
scaling.zh: 在算力或功耗受限时，效率是获得更多智能的关键。

scaling.en: Pre-training in 4-bit arithmetic is feasible and yields efficiency gains despite numerical challenges.
scaling.zh: 尽管存在数值挑战，但使用 4 位算术进行预训练是可行的，并能带来效率提升。

scaling.en: Scaling laws continue to hold; no wall in sight despite decades of predictions.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律持续有效；尽管数十年间屡有预测，但尚未触及天花板。

scaling.en: Compute will remain the scarce resource; demand will far outstrip supply.
scaling.zh: 算力仍将是稀缺资源；需求将远超供给。

scaling.en: Models are not commoditized; smarter models unlock transformative scientific breakthroughs.
scaling.zh: 模型并非商品化；更智能的模型能带来变革性的科学突破。

scaling.en: Scaling in drug discovery AI mirrors LLM scaling: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time scaling all matter.
scaling.zh: 药物发现 AI 的 Scaling（规模扩张）模仿 LLM 的 Scaling（规模扩张）：预训练、后训练和推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）都很重要。

scaling.en: Synthetic data from physics-based simulations is key to augment limited experimental data for training models.
scaling.zh: 基于物理的模拟生成的合成数据是扩充有限实验数据以训练模型的关键。

scaling.en: GPU shortage is a major bottleneck for drug discovery AI, not just for LLMs.
scaling.zh: GPU 短缺是药物发现 AI 的主要瓶颈，而不仅仅是 LLM。

scaling.en: AI progress in math is driven by verifiability and grindability, not just formalization.
scaling.zh: AI 在数学上的进步由可验证性和可重复性驱动，而不仅仅是形式化。

scaling.en: Grindability (parallel rollouts) matters more than verifiability for AI progress in math.
scaling.zh: 可重复性（并行 rollout）对 AI 数学进步比可验证性更重要。

scaling.en: Hardware is slow; AI improvements will make glasses more useful over time.
scaling.zh: 硬件发展缓慢；AI 的进步将随时间让眼镜更有用。

scaling.en: Model capability is now a function of test-time compute budget, not just model weights.
scaling.zh: 模型能力现在是测试时算力预算的函数，而不仅仅是模型权重。

scaling.en: Benchmarks must be evaluated with an x-axis of tokens, cost, or time to compare models fairly.
scaling.zh: 基准测试必须用词元、成本或时间作为 x 轴来公平比较模型。

scaling.en: Models improve continuously with more test-time compute on many tasks, without plateauing.
scaling.zh: 在许多任务上，模型随着测试时算力增加而持续改进，不会饱和。

scaling.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立；预训练并未消亡。

scaling.en: Pre-training is not dead; scaling continues despite repeated predictions.
scaling.zh: 预训练并未消亡；尽管屡次被预言，规模扩张仍在继续。

scaling.en: Diverse data from different verticals improves physical AI models faster.
scaling.zh: 来自不同垂直领域的多样化数据能更快地改进物理 AI 模型。

scaling.en: Model quality is the most important factor; being far ahead on quality drives growth.
scaling.zh: 模型质量是最重要的因素；在质量上遥遥领先推动增长。

scaling.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; we are seeing data walls and compute limits today.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律正遭遇收益递减；我们今天已看到数据墙和算力限制。

scaling.en: Optical connectivity via indium phosphide lasers is critical for scaling AI data centers.
scaling.zh: 通过磷化铟激光器的光学连接对于扩展 AI 数据中心至关重要。

scaling.en: Energy production is foundational; without it, AI infrastructure cannot be built.
scaling.zh: 能源生产是基础；没有它，AI 基础设施就无法建设。

scaling.en: The US is woefully behind in energy production, a critical layer for AI growth.
scaling.zh: 美国在能源生产方面严重落后，而这是 AI 增长的关键层面。

scaling.en: Evals must evolve from static benchmarks to long-horizon, realistic tasks.
scaling.zh: 评估必须从静态基准演变为长期、现实的任务。

scaling.en: Reasoning models like o1 show paradigm shift; scaling continues.
scaling.zh: 像 o1 这样的推理模型展示了范式转变；Scaling 仍在继续。

scaling.en: Human baseline in wet lab evals was beaten by early reasoning models.
scaling.zh: 湿实验室评估中的人类基线被早期推理模型击败。

scaling.en: Export controls forced China to innovate, leading to more efficient models and domestic silicon development.
scaling.zh: 出口管制迫使中国创新，催生了更高效的模型和本土芯片发展。

scaling.en: Power is the biggest bottleneck for AI infrastructure, and resistance to data centers will worsen.
scaling.zh: 电力是 AI 基础设施的最大瓶颈，对数据中心的抵制将加剧。

scaling.en: Micron could be more valuable than Meta in 6-12 months due to HBM bottleneck.
scaling.zh: 由于 HBM 瓶颈，美光可能在 6-12 个月内比 Meta 更有价值。

scaling.en: The biggest bottleneck is generating novel biological data, not compute.
scaling.zh: 最大的瓶颈是生成新的生物学数据，而不是算力。

scaling.en: Scaling laws drove AI progress; more data and compute improve models even without algorithmic changes.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律推动了 AI 进步；即使算法不变，更多数据和算力也能提升模型。

scaling.en: LLMs cannot achieve human-like intelligence because text data volume is vastly insufficient compared to visual experience.
scaling.zh: 大语言模型无法实现类人智能，因为文本数据量远不及视觉经验。

scaling.en: Superintelligence is coming soon, driven by log-linear scaling of compute and data.
scaling.zh: 超级智能即将到来，由算力和数据的对数线性扩展驱动。

scaling.en: Distillation is a short-term win; true frontier progress requires original research.
scaling.zh: 蒸馏是短期胜利；真正的前沿进步需要原创研究。

scaling.en: Current AI hype leads to data collection without understanding; focus on questions matters.
scaling.zh: 当前的 AI 热潮导致为收集数据而收集，缺乏理解；关注问题本身更重要。

scaling.en: Meta rebuilt its AI scaling ladder and infrastructure over the past year, leading to the Spark model.
scaling.zh: Meta 在过去一年重建了 AI Scaling（规模扩张）阶梯和基础设施，推出了 Spark 模型。

scaling.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems to achieve token efficiency.
scaling.zh: 不要将前沿模型用于非前沿问题，以实现代币效率。

scaling.en: Test-time compute scaling lets models think longer, improving reasoning accuracy.
scaling.zh: 测试时算力扩展让模型思考更久，提升推理准确性。

scaling.en: Compressing progress in frontier AI leads to volatility, but long-term durable progress is key.
scaling.zh: 前沿 AI 的快速进步带来波动，但长期可持续进展是关键。

scaling.en: Compressing progress into short timeframes leads to both good and bad outcomes in months.
scaling.zh: 将进展压缩到短时间内会导致好与坏的结果在几个月内出现。

scaling.en: Digital AI's ability to share information billions of times faster than humans is a major advantage.
scaling.zh: 数字 AI 以比人类快数十亿倍的速度共享信息，这是一大优势。

scaling.en: Scaling for performance will shift from stacking more layers to nesting more frequency update rates.
scaling.zh: 性能的 Scaling 将从堆叠更多层转向嵌套更多频率更新率。

scaling.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools can solve hard problems but still need vast data.
scaling.zh: Transformer 结合推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但仍需海量数据。

scaling.en: Hardware progress enables single-GPU research at scale, democratizing AI experimentation.
scaling.zh: 硬件进步使单 GPU 大规模研究成为可能，推动了 AI 实验的民主化。

scaling.en: The big coding leap over Christmas is hard to attribute to a single factor; it's a messy combination.
scaling.zh: 圣诞节期间编码能力的巨大飞跃难以归因于单一因素，而是多种因素的复杂组合。

scaling.en: US hyperscalers may be overspending on AI infrastructure despite current demand exceeding supply.
scaling.zh: 尽管当前需求超过供给，美国超大规模云服务商可能在 AI 基础设施上过度支出。

scaling.en: Model improvements, especially Sonnet 4 and Opus 4.5, were the primary driver of Claude Code's performance gains.
scaling.zh: 模型改进，尤其是 Sonnet 4 和 Opus 4.5，是 Claude Code 性能提升的主要驱动力。

scaling.en: Demis regrets DeepMind being late to language models and chatbots.
scaling.zh: Demis 后悔 DeepMind 在语言模型和聊天机器人上落后了。

scaling.en: Video model training cost is comparable to medium-scale language models, with huge storage needs.
scaling.zh: 视频模型训练成本与中等规模语言模型相当，且存储需求巨大。

scaling.en: AI-generated code often uses patterns like hasattr or getattr to avoid failures, requiring lint rules.
scaling.zh: AI 生成的代码常使用 hasattr 或 getattr 等模式来避免失败，需要 lint 规则来约束。

scaling.en: Codebases regress to the worst engineer when AI is used without review, as bad patterns get amplified.
scaling.zh: 如果不进行代码审查，AI 会使代码库退化为最差工程师的水平，因为不良模式会被放大。

scaling.en: Very expensive frontier models may not be needed; hybrid systems with sub-frontier models can be efficient.
scaling.zh: 可能不需要非常昂贵的前沿模型；结合次前沿模型的混合系统可以更高效。

scaling.en: AI removes talent bottleneck in science by scaling reasoning and throughput.
scaling.zh: AI 通过扩展推理和吞吐量，消除了科学中的人才瓶颈。

scaling.en: AI is strong on verifiable tasks and high-throughput reasoning, weak on unverifiable creative tasks.
scaling.zh: AI 在可验证任务和高吞吐推理上表现强劲，在不可验证的创造性任务上较弱。

scaling.en: Scaling laws apply to protein language models, with more data and compute leading to emergent capabilities.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律适用于蛋白质语言模型，更多数据和算力会带来涌现能力。

scaling.en: Adding metagenomic data removes diminishing returns, enabling better scaling than with UniRef alone.
scaling.zh: 加入宏基因组数据消除了收益递减，比仅用 UniRef 实现了更好的 Scaling。

scaling.en: No inductive biases like MSAs are needed; scaling data and compute alone yields state-of-the-art structure prediction.
scaling.zh: 不需要多序列比对等归纳偏置；仅靠 Scaling 数据和算力就能达到最先进的结构预测。

scaling.en: Quadratic scaling with bit width makes low precision far more efficient than expected.
scaling.zh: 位宽的二次缩放使低精度比预期高效得多。

scaling.en: FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, not 2x, due to quadratic area scaling and exponent overhead.
scaling.zh: 由于面积二次缩放和指数开销，FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

scaling.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失的能力。

scaling.en: Model intelligence improves rapidly, requiring users to constantly reset expectations.
scaling.zh: 模型智能快速提升，要求用户不断重新设定预期。

scaling.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but compute constraints will widen the US-China gap.
scaling.zh: 预训练的缩放定律仍然成立，但算力限制将扩大中美差距。

scaling.en: Chinese labs are 6-9 months behind on benchmarks, but gap may grow on knowledge work.
scaling.zh: 中国实验室在基准测试上落后 6-9 个月，但在知识工作上的差距可能扩大。

scaling.en: Huawei chips work for inference but not training; labs buy them but don't use.
scaling.zh: 华为芯片可用于推理但非训练；实验室购买但未使用。

scaling.en: Scaling laws require a working system first; studying scaling on bad data yields no insight.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律需要先有工作系统；在坏数据上研究缩放无法获得洞察。

scaling.en: Scaling LLMs will not lead to human-level AI; a paradigm shift is needed.
scaling.zh: 扩展 LLM 不会带来人类级 AI；需要范式转变。

scaling.en: Sample efficiency improvements mean AI intelligence can grow even without more compute, accelerating progress.
scaling.zh: 样本效率的提升意味着即使没有更多算力，AI 智能也能增长，从而加速进步。

scaling.en: The core code for an LLM is only 200-300 lines; complexity comes from data and scaling.
scaling.zh: LLM 的核心代码仅 200-300 行；复杂性来自数据和规模扩展。

scaling.en: Benchmark saturation and adversarial task selection distort trends; diverse, real-world-like tasks are better.
scaling.zh: 基准饱和与对抗性任务选择扭曲趋势；多样化、接近真实世界的任务更好。

scaling.en: AI progress may be overestimated due to data contamination and distributional leakage in benchmarks.
scaling.zh: 由于基准中的数据污染和分布泄露，AI 进展可能被高估。

scaling.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost.
scaling.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练至 Chinchilla 最优的约 100 倍。

scaling.en: Distillation allows packing frontier model capabilities into smaller, efficient models for edge deployment.
scaling.zh: 蒸馏技术可将前沿模型能力压缩到更小、更高效的模型中，用于边缘部署。

scaling.en: Benchmarks like LM Arena are hackable and do not reflect real-world use.
scaling.zh: 像 LM Arena 这样的基准测试容易被操纵，不能反映真实使用情况。

scaling.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor in LLMs; memory is likely the biggest limiting constraint.
scaling.zh: 上下文长度是 LLM 中最慢的扩展因素；记忆可能是最大的限制约束。

scaling.en: The scaling of models beyond 10 trillion parameters is temporary; rationing will not last.
scaling.zh: 模型规模超过 10 万亿参数是暂时的；配给不会持续。

scaling.en: AI is capital-intensive R&D requiring massive compute for training strong models.
scaling.zh: AI 是资本密集型研发，需要大量算力来训练强大模型。

scaling.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver requires massive data, compute, and world models for simulation.
scaling.zh: 扩展通用 AI 驾驶系统需要海量数据、算力和用于仿真的世界模型。

scaling.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
scaling.zh: 对于深度学习，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更为关键。

scaling.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
scaling.zh: 无需预先训练数据，即可在 500 多个城市实现零样本泛化。

scaling.en: High-quality input tokens produce better outputs; use precise vocabulary and explicit focus to steer AI generation.
scaling.zh: 高质量的输入 token 会带来更好的模型输出；要用精准词汇和明确焦点来引导 AI 生成。

scaling.en: AI often creates more follow-up fixes, making people feel more productive while objective quality suffers.
scaling.zh: AI 往往带来更多后续修复，让人感觉更有产出，但客观质量却受损。

scaling.en: Very good engineers are only now starting to see AI's utility in coding; it's not universally superior yet.
scaling.zh: 顶尖工程师现在才开始看到 AI 在编码中的效用；它尚未全面超越人类。

scaling.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL.
scaling.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习来实现。

scaling.en: Anthropic's growth is driven by exponential model improvements, not just growth team optimizations.
scaling.zh: Anthropic 的增长主要源于模型的指数级进步，而非单纯的增长团队优化。

scaling.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive progress in physical sciences, similar to AI.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律和大规模实验将推动物理科学的进步，类似于 AI 领域。

scaling.en: Experimental data from literature can be unreliable, spanning orders of magnitude for the same property.
scaling.zh: 文献中的实验数据可能不可靠，同一属性的数值跨越多个数量级。

scaling.en: Compute cost often exceeds physical infrastructure cost in AI-driven materials science.
scaling.zh: 在 AI 驱动的材料科学中，算力成本通常超过物理基础设施成本。

scaling.en: Pooling robot data from many labs yields generalist models outperforming specialists.
scaling.zh: 汇集多实验室机器人数据得到的通用模型优于专用模型。

scaling.en: Generalist robotic models can outperform specialists even in specialist domains.
scaling.zh: 通用机器人模型在专用领域也能超越专用模型。

scaling.en: High-quality post-training data alone fails without diverse pre-training for recoveries.
scaling.zh: 仅高质量后训练数据若无多样化预训练则无法应对恢复。

scaling.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus, and diffusion models scale better at inference than autoregressive models.
scaling.zh: 推理时缩放现在是关键焦点，扩散模型在推理时比自回归模型扩展得更好。

scaling.en: Diffusion models allow controlling quality by adjusting denoising steps, offering a new inference-time compute knob.
scaling.zh: 扩散模型通过调整去噪步数控制质量，提供了新的推理时算力调节旋钮。

scaling.en: Current AI is the worst we'll ever see; it will become much more energy efficient.
scaling.zh: 当前的 AI 是我们见过的最差的；它将变得节能得多。

scaling.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; investing in capabilities and safety is key.
scaling.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；投资于能力和安全是关键。

scaling.en: Real-world data is crucial for manipulation tasks; simulation struggles with world complexity.
scaling.zh: 真实世界数据对操作任务至关重要；模拟难以应对世界复杂性。

scaling.en: Scaling existing recipes may suffice; research can improve scaling slope.
scaling.zh: 扩展现有方案可能足够；研究可改善扩展斜率。

scaling.en: Simulation is less useful for manipulation than for locomotion.
scaling.zh: 模拟对操作任务不如对运动任务有用。

scaling.en: Supervised learning hasn't progressed as far as I would have expected.
scaling.zh: 监督学习的进展没有我预期的那么远。

scaling.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
scaling.zh: 大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

scaling.en: Scaling laws continue to hold for both pre-training and reasoning models.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律在预训练和推理模型上仍然成立。

scaling.en: Scaling still works but the recipe has shifted to synthetic data and RL.
scaling.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍然有效，但方法已转向合成数据和强化学习。

scaling.en: The era of scaling is not over, but the simple recipe of more data and bigger models no longer works.
scaling.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）时代并未结束，但简单增加数据和模型规模的方法已不再奏效。

scaling.en: Digital intelligence may surpass analog brains because it can scale and share knowledge instantly.
scaling.zh: 数字智能可能超越模拟大脑，因为它能规模化并即时共享知识。

scaling.en: Inference scaling techniques like self-consistency and self-refinement boost model performance at test time.
scaling.zh: 自洽性和自我改进等推理缩放技术可在测试时提升模型性能。

scaling.en: Pre-training R&D is less exciting; most gains now come from post-training and inference scaling.
scaling.zh: 预训练的研发不再令人兴奋；大部分收益现在来自后训练和推理缩放。

scaling.en: Continual learning is a distant dream; practical updates are semi-automatic and resource-constrained.
scaling.zh: 持续学习是一个遥远的梦想；实际更新是半自动的且受资源限制。

scaling.en: AI excels at tasks within its training distribution but struggles with out-of-distribution problems.
scaling.zh: AI 擅长其训练分布内的任务，但在分布外问题上表现不佳。

scaling.en: Using the most capable model is often cheaper than cheaper models due to fewer tokens.
scaling.zh: 使用最强大的模型通常比便宜模型更省钱，因为消耗的 token 更少。

scaling.en: Speed of 53 Codex enables real-time interaction and new capabilities like mid-turn steering.
scaling.zh: 53 Codex 的速度实现了实时交互和诸如中途转向等新能力。

scaling.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
scaling.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

scaling.en: Speed enables replacing deterministic steps with model-driven actions.
scaling.zh: 速度使得用模型驱动的操作取代确定性步骤成为可能。

scaling.en: AI research acceleration could lead to rapid capability growth beyond control.
scaling.zh: AI 研究加速可能导致能力失控性增长。

scaling.en: A four-year-old's visual data equals all public text on the internet.
scaling.zh: 四岁儿童的视觉数据相当于互联网上所有公开文本。

scaling.en: Unprecedented compute scaling drives linear capability gains, justifying massive CAPEX.
scaling.zh: 前所未有的算力规模扩张带来线性能力提升，证明了巨额资本支出的合理性。

scaling.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
scaling.zh: 将非形式模型 Scaling 到数学 AI 不可行；形式验证对于可靠的证明至关重要。

scaling.en: Compute power is the new oil; chip supply is the current bottleneck for AI progress.
scaling.zh: 算力是新的石油；芯片供应是当前 AI 进展的瓶颈。

scaling.en: Space data centers will not provide meaningful compute for OpenAI in the next 10 years.
scaling.zh: 太空数据中心在未来 10 年内不会为 OpenAI 提供有意义的算力。

scaling.en: AI models may not have durable moats; they are being commoditized quickly.
scaling.zh: AI 模型可能没有持久的护城河；它们正在快速商品化。

scaling.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation.
scaling.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍。

scaling.en: Small language models can be made powerful with high-quality, diverse synthetic data.
scaling.zh: 通过高质量、多样化的合成数据，小型语言模型可以变得强大。

scaling.en: Post-training data must be diverse to avoid mode collapse and homogeneity.
scaling.zh: 后训练数据必须多样化，以避免模式崩溃和同质化。

scaling.en: Synthetic data generation requires careful filtering for diversity and quality.
scaling.zh: 合成数据生成需要仔细过滤以确保多样性和质量。

scaling.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data remains limited.
scaling.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍然有限。

scaling.en: Pre-training is hitting a saturation wall; further gains come from domain-specific fine-tuning.
scaling.zh: 预训练正触及饱和墙；进一步收益来自领域特定微调。

scaling.en: Current frontier models are not a dead end; we can improve them without starting from scratch.
scaling.zh: 当前前沿模型并非死胡同；我们可以在不从头开始的情况下改进它们。

scaling.en: Video pre-training offers higher scaling ceiling than text for world understanding.
scaling.zh: 视频预训练在理解世界方面比文本有更高的扩展上限。

scaling.en: Scaling video models has a much higher ceiling than text models due to information density.
scaling.zh: 由于信息密度，视频模型的扩展上限远高于文本模型。

scaling.en: Diverse data is key to generalization in robotics foundation models.
scaling.zh: 多样化数据是机器人基础模型泛化能力的关键。

scaling.en: Deployment enables a data flywheel: more deployment yields more data, which improves models.
scaling.zh: 部署带来数据飞轮：更多部署产生更多数据，从而改进模型。

scaling.en: Sim-to-real transfer works for locomotion but not for manipulation due to world complexity.
scaling.zh: 由于世界的复杂性，仿真到现实的迁移适用于运动控制，但不适用于操作任务。

scaling.en: Scaling models is key to discovering emergent capabilities, which can later be distilled into smaller models.
scaling.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）模型是发现涌现能力的关键，这些能力随后可以蒸馏到更小的模型中。

scaling.en: Synthetic data can help if it preserves natural data distribution; pure synthetic data harms performance.
scaling.zh: 合成数据如果保持自然数据分布则有益；纯合成数据会损害性能。

scaling.en: Current AI shows uneven capabilities: superhuman in language and knowledge, but weak in reasoning and continual learning.
scaling.zh: 当前 AI 能力不均衡：在语言和知识上超人类，但在推理和持续学习上薄弱。

scaling.en: Superintelligence is inevitable due to vast advantages in compute, speed, and bandwidth over the human brain.
scaling.zh: 由于在算力、速度和带宽上远超人脑，超级智能不可避免。

scaling.en: Model fatigue is real; hot-swapping models no longer works for non-trivial use cases.
scaling.zh: 模型疲劳真实存在；对于非平凡用例，热切换模型已不再有效。

scaling.en: ImageNet was pivotal in modern AI by providing large-scale data for training, alongside GPUs and neural networks.
scaling.zh: ImageNet 通过提供大规模训练数据，与 GPU 和神经网络一起，成为现代 AI 的关键转折点。

scaling.en: High-quality data is crucial for AI training, and it requires deep understanding of quality, not just throwing bodies at problems.
scaling.zh: 高质量数据对 AI 训练至关重要，需要深入理解质量，而不是简单地堆人力。

scaling.en: Benchmarks are often misleading and can be gamed; real progress should be measured through deep human evaluations.
scaling.zh: 基准测试常常具有误导性且可能被操纵；真正的进展应通过深入的人类评估来衡量。

scaling.en: Data labeling is not simple; it's like raising a child, teaching values and creativity, not just labeling images.
scaling.zh: 数据标注并不简单；它就像养育孩子，教导价值观和创造力，而不仅仅是标注图像。

scaling.en: AlphaFold's success came from lack of compute, not abundance.
scaling.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于算力不足，而非充裕。

scaling.en: Energy capacity, not just compute, is a major bottleneck for AI scaling.
scaling.zh: 能源容量，而不仅仅是算力，是 AI 规模扩张的主要瓶颈。

scaling.en: The history of deep learning is the history of scaling up compute.
scaling.zh: 深度学习的历史就是 Scaling（规模扩张）算力的历史。

scaling.en: Academia should focus on wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just scaling models.
scaling.zh: 学术界应专注于疯狂的想法和新算法，而不仅仅是 Scaling（规模扩张）模型。

scaling.en: GPU scaling is hitting limits; future hardware may require radically different neural architectures.
scaling.zh: GPU Scaling（规模扩张）正触及极限；未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经网络架构。

scaling.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we are returning to an era of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
scaling.zh: 预训练的缩放定律是有限的；我们正回归研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

scaling.en: Scaling laws and brute force can mask fundamental architectural flaws, such as poor representation of structure.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律和蛮力可以掩盖根本性的架构缺陷，例如对结构的糟糕表示。

scaling.en: The energy cost of AI data centers can be mitigated by investing in renewable energy.
scaling.zh: AI 数据中心的能源成本可以通过投资可再生能源来缓解。

scaling.en: The trio of big data, neural networks, and GPUs is the golden recipe for modern AI.
scaling.zh: 大数据、神经网络和 GPU 这三要素是现代 AI 的黄金配方。

scaling.en: Human data is like fossil fuels—finite and already largely consumed; experience is renewable and limitless.
scaling.zh: 人类数据就像化石燃料——有限且已被大量消耗；经验是可再生的，取之不尽。

scaling.en: LLMs cannot discover new knowledge beyond human data; they are a shallow solution to AI.
scaling.zh: LLM 无法发现人类数据之外的新知识；它们是 AI 的浅层解决方案。

scaling.en: The era of human data is ending; we must pay the cost of interaction to progress further.
scaling.zh: 人类数据时代正在结束；我们必须付出交互成本才能进一步进步。

scaling.en: Scaling laws apply to video models, with rapid cost reduction and intelligence gains.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律适用于视频模型，成本快速降低且智能显著提升。

scaling.en: Adaptive compute enables varying compute per task, reducing cost for easy tasks.
scaling.zh: 自适应算力允许为不同任务分配不同算力，降低简单任务的成本。

scaling.en: Synthetic data from LLMs is collapsed and lacks entropy; training on it leads to model collapse, unlike human diversity.
scaling.zh: LLM 生成的合成数据坍缩且缺乏熵；在其上训练导致模型坍缩，不像人类具有多样性。

scaling.en: Model collapse from synthetic data is a fundamental problem; entropy is needed.
scaling.zh: 合成数据导致的模型崩溃是一个根本性问题；需要熵。

scaling.en: Scaling reinforcement learning is harder than scaling pre-training due to more moving parts and failure modes.
scaling.zh: 扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难，因为涉及更多活动部件和故障模式。

scaling.en: Reliable continual deep learning is a prerequisite for Oak but not yet solved.
scaling.zh: 可靠的持续深度学习是 Oak 的前提条件，但尚未解决。

scaling.en: Current LLM training pipelines are primitive and have huge room for improvement across every component.
scaling.zh: 当前的 LLM 训练流程还很原始，每个组件都有巨大的改进空间。

scaling.en: Generalization in deep learning is poorly understood and often requires human engineering.
scaling.zh: 深度学习中的泛化理解不足，常需人工设计。

scaling.en: To get a technique used in production, focus on side effects, cost, and implementation ease.
scaling.zh: 要让技术用于生产，需关注副作用、成本和实施难度。

scaling.en: The cost of AI inference will drop dramatically, enabling new use cases and business models.
scaling.zh: AI 推理成本将大幅下降，催生新的用例和商业模式。

scaling.en: Pre-training is a key muscle to rebuild; scaling laws are not dead and there is much room left.
scaling.zh: 预训练是需要重建的关键能力；缩放定律并未失效，仍有很大空间。

scaling.en: Product innovation lags behind AI capabilities; freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scaling.zh: 产品创新落后于 AI 能力；冻结模型仍将带来十年的产品进步。

scaling.en: Consistency in Genie 3 emerges from scaling data and model capacity without explicit world representation.
scaling.zh: Genie 3 的一致性来自数据和模型规模的扩展，无需显式世界表示。

scaling.en: Scaling laws show intelligence increases reliably with more compute, a key insight for AI progress.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律表明，随着算力增加，智能会可靠提升，这是 AI 进展的关键洞见。

scaling.en: Focusing on internal benchmarks and dogfooding, not gaming public benchmarks, leads to better models.
scaling.zh: 专注于内部基准和内部测试，而非刷公开基准，能带来更好的模型。

scaling.en: Claude's coding ability emerged from deliberate investment and surprising user adoption, not just benchmarks.
scaling.zh: Claude 的编码能力源于刻意投入和用户意外采纳，而不仅仅是基准测试。

scaling.en: Scaling laws lead to emergent capabilities that create new failure modes.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律导致涌现能力，从而产生新的失败模式。

scaling.en: The exponential means models will get millions of times better, not just twice.
scaling.zh: 指数增长意味着模型将变得好数百万倍，而不仅仅是两倍。

scaling.en: Scaling reasoning models will accelerate AI progress in coming years.
scaling.zh: 扩展推理模型将在未来几年加速 AI 进步。

scaling.en: Measuring AI capabilities is becoming a bottleneck; benchmarks lag behind.
scaling.zh: 衡量 AI 能力正成为瓶颈；基准测试落后于实际能力。

scaling.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers and large labs due to massive capex requirements, making it unsuitable for startups.
scaling.zh: 前沿模型开发由超大规模企业和大型实验室主导，因为需要巨额资本支出，不适合初创公司。

scaling.en: The Protein Data Bank's high-quality curated data was essential for training AlphaFold.
scaling.zh: 蛋白质数据库的高质量精选数据对训练 AlphaFold 至关重要。

scaling.en: Future AI in biology needs new curated datasets like the PDB for other modalities.
scaling.zh: 生物学未来的 AI 需要像 PDB 那样为其他模态策划的新数据集。

scaling.en: Scaling compute in pre-training and RL predictably improves AI performance.
scaling.zh: 在预训练和强化学习中扩展算力可预测地提升 AI 性能。

scaling.en: Scaling laws have held over five orders of magnitude, suggesting continued progress.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律已在五个数量级上成立，表明进步将持续。

scaling.en: Scaling laws failing likely means we screwed up training, not that scaling is over.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律失效很可能意味着训练出错，而非缩放本身终结。

scaling.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robot models; diverse data is key.
scaling.zh: 规模是通用机器人模型的必要条件，但非充分条件；数据的多样性才是关键。

scaling.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks like laundry folding.
scaling.zh: 先在所有数据上预训练，再在精选数据上微调，能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务。

scaling.en: Diverse data enables robots to succeed in unseen environments, closing the generalization gap.
scaling.zh: 多样化数据使机器人能在未见环境中成功，缩小泛化差距。

scaling.en: Scaling laws continue to hold; progress is accelerating with more frequent model releases.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律持续成立；随着模型发布频率加快，进步正在加速。

scaling.en: Biggest bottleneck for AI progress is compute (chips and data centers), plus algorithms and data.
scaling.zh: AI 进步的最大瓶颈是算力（芯片和数据中心），其次是算法和数据。

scaling.en: AI progress is not slowing; it's accelerating due to post-training improvements and faster releases.
scaling.zh: AI 进步并未放缓；由于后训练改进和更快的发布，实际上正在加速。

scaling.en: The bitter lesson is about scaling with compute and search, not about generalization.
scaling.zh: 苦涩的教训是关于用算力和搜索进行扩展，而非关于泛化。

scaling.en: Pre-training scaling is far from saturated; significant gains are still possible.
scaling.zh: 预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）远未饱和，仍有显著提升空间。

scaling.en: Nvidia's moat is not CUDA but relentless hardware improvement speed.
scaling.zh: 英伟达的护城河不是 CUDA，而是不懈的硬件改进速度。

scaling.en: Sim-to-real gap persists but is reduced for many tasks.
scaling.zh: 模拟到现实的差距仍然存在，但许多任务已缩小。

scaling.en: Scaling RL compute will unlock new capabilities, similar to how pre-training scaling improved generalization.
scaling.zh: 扩大强化学习算力将解锁新能力，类似于预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）提升了泛化能力。

scaling.en: DeepSeek's success is due to efficient engineering and hardware-aware design, not fundamental algorithmic breakthroughs.
scaling.zh: DeepSeek 的成功源于高效工程和硬件感知设计，而非根本性的算法突破。

scaling.en: AI is the primary growth driver for semiconductors; Intel must redefine its AI strategy with purpose-built silicon.
scaling.zh: AI 是半导体增长的主要驱动力；英特尔必须用专用芯片重新定义 AI 战略。

scaling.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost reasons.
scaling.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其是在速度和成本方面。

scaling.en: We didn't expect to do our own model development, but now every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
scaling.zh: 我们最初没预料到会自己开发模型，但现在 Cursor 的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

scaling.en: Data diversity is the main bottleneck in robotics; sharing datasets across the community can solve generalization issues.
scaling.zh: 数据多样性是机器人技术的主要瓶颈；跨社区共享数据集可以解决泛化问题。

scaling.en: Biology is not data-constrained; historical data exists but wasn't created for ML.
scaling.zh: 生物学并不受数据限制；历史数据存在，但并非为机器学习而创建。

scaling.en: Synthetic data from physics simulations is a massive opportunity for chemistry.
scaling.zh: 来自物理模拟的合成数据为化学领域提供了巨大机遇。

scaling.en: Physical infrastructure and energy are major bottlenecks for AI scaling.
scaling.zh: 物理基础设施和能源是 AI Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈。

scaling.en: Test-time compute scaling will drive major progress, but won't alone achieve AGI.
scaling.zh: 测试时算力扩展将推动重大进展，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI。

scaling.en: The speed of AI research adoption has dramatically accelerated in recent years.
scaling.zh: AI 研究的采纳速度近年来显著加快。

scaling.en: Models improve generation over generation, driven by algorithmic advances as much as hardware scaling.
scaling.zh: 模型代际提升主要由算法进步驱动，与硬件 Scaling 同等重要。

scaling.en: Synthetic data enables infinite task generation for post-training, overcoming the data wall in pre-training.
scaling.zh: 合成数据为后训练生成无限任务，克服了预训练中的数据墙。

scaling.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
scaling.zh: 评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建。

scaling.en: Models are not running out of data; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks.
scaling.zh: 模型并未耗尽数据；通过强化学习的后训练扩展提供了无限任务。

scaling.en: Scaling and planning are key principles from AlphaGo to modern AI agents.
scaling.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）和规划是从 AlphaGo 到现代 AI 智能体的关键原则。

scaling.en: Synthetic data is essential to overcome the data wall, but requires careful methods.
scaling.zh: 合成数据对于克服数据墙至关重要，但需要谨慎的方法。

scaling.en: Modern AI breakthroughs are based on algorithms invented in the previous millennium, but needed hardware scaling to become practical.
scaling.zh: 现代 AI 突破基于前一个千年发明的算法，但需要硬件规模扩张才能实用。

scaling.en: Compute scaling has been a major driver of AI progress, but its future impact is uncertain.
scaling.zh: 算力扩展是 AI 进步的主要驱动力，但其未来影响不确定。

scaling.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
scaling.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步突破需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

scaling.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
scaling.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展维度，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的极限。

scaling.en: Scaling laws predict predictable progress in AI by increasing compute and data.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律预测通过增加算力和数据可实现 AI 的可预测进步。

scaling.en: Inference costs have dropped ~100x since ChatGPT, driven by quantization, co-design, and better kernels.
scaling.zh: 自 ChatGPT 以来，推理成本下降了约 100 倍，这得益于量化、协同设计和更好的内核。

scaling.en: Future inference gains will come from hardware specialization, model architecture co-design, and kernel optimization.
scaling.zh: 未来的推理提升将来自硬件专业化、模型架构协同设计和内核优化。

scaling.en: Data quality and synthetic data generation are underhyped but crucial for model improvement.
scaling.zh: 数据质量和合成数据生成被低估，但对模型改进至关重要。

scaling.en: Synthetic data is the future, but maintaining entropy is critical to avoid silent model collapse.
scaling.zh: 合成数据是未来，但保持熵至关重要，以避免模型无声崩溃。

scaling.en: Data shortage is not imminent; we have vast untapped multimodal data.
scaling.zh: 数据短缺并非迫在眉睫；我们还有大量未利用的多模态数据。

scaling.en: Larger models still improve performance even on fixed datasets.
scaling.zh: 即使在固定数据集上，更大的模型仍能提升性能。

scaling.en: Academia should focus on novel ideas and societal impact, not just scaling models.
scaling.zh: 学术界应专注于新颖想法和社会影响，而不仅仅是扩大模型规模。

scaling.en: The internet is running out of high-quality tokens for pre-training, but embodied worlds provide infinite data.
scaling.zh: 互联网的高质量 token 即将耗尽，但具身世界提供无限数据。

scaling.en: Simulation is key for robotics progress, riding Moore's Law and enabling iterative improvement.
scaling.zh: 模拟是机器人学进步的关键，借助摩尔定律并实现迭代改进。

scaling.en: AI research benefits from both small science (exploration) and big science (exploitation), complementing each other.
scaling.zh: AI 研究受益于小科学（探索）和大科学（利用），两者互补。

scaling.en: Benchmarking in vision was initially resisted but became essential for scientific progress.
scaling.zh: 视觉中的基准测试最初遭到抵制，但后来成为科学进步的关键。

scaling.en: Scaling data and compute may face diminishing returns, but new modalities like video and better training methods offer progress.
scaling.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）数据和算力可能面临收益递减，但视频等新模态和更好的训练方法提供了进步空间。

scaling.en: Scaling laws and focusing on one large model was not obvious early on.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律和专注于一个大模型在早期并不显而易见。

scaling.en: Simply scaling up depth or parameters will not solve fundamental representational issues in neural networks.
scaling.zh: 仅仅增加深度或参数不会解决神经网络中的根本表示问题。

rl.en: End-to-end training on the actual reward signal, such as user happiness, is crucial for developing effective personal AI agents.
rl.zh: 基于实际奖励信号（如用户幸福感）的端到端训练对于开发有效的个性化 AI 智能体至关重要。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms will emerge.
rl.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；更好的算法将会出现。

rl.en: End-to-end optimization combining pre-training and RL is necessary for real-world performance.
rl.zh: 结合预训练和强化学习的端到端优化对于真实世界性能是必要的。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning is inefficient and not the ultimate form of learning from experience.
rl.zh: 强化学习效率低下，并非从经验中学习的终极形式。

rl.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling counterfactual reasoning and systematic coverage of state space.
rl.zh: 仿真对机器人至关重要，能够实现反事实推理和状态空间的系统覆盖。

rl.en: Robotics lacks data; simulation scales data generation for training and evaluation.
rl.zh: 机器人领域缺乏数据；仿真可规模化生成用于训练和评估的数据。

rl.en: Robots need reliability and efficiency; simulation provides controllable randomization and speed-up.
rl.zh: 机器人需要可靠性和效率；仿真提供可控的随机化和加速。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning is the biggest driver of large language model capabilities; behavior shaping through post-training creates huge gains.
rl.zh: 强化学习是 LLM 能力最大的推动力；通过后训练塑造行为能带来巨大收益。

rl.en: Pre-training is far from solved; reinforcement learning will move earlier into training to teach models how to reason from web data.
rl.zh: 预训练远未终结；强化学习将更早介入训练，教导模型如何从网络数据中推理。

rl.en: The future of autonomy lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, which is more scalable than imitation learning.
rl.zh: 自主性的未来在于端到端强化学习，它比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

rl.en: Science is an infinite token generator for post-training via RL with experimental verification.
rl.zh: 科学是通过实验验证的强化学习进行后训练的无限 token 生成器。

rl.en: Reward hacking in RL can be beneficial; sometimes skipping reasoning steps yields better results.
rl.zh: 强化学习中的奖励破解可能有益；有时跳过推理步骤反而得到更好结果。

rl.en: Post-training and RL at scale are key differentiators for frontier models.
rl.zh: 后训练和大规模强化学习是前沿模型的关键差异化因素。

rl.en: Synthetic data generation is essential for RL in coding and beyond.
rl.zh: 合成数据生成对于编码及其他领域的强化学习至关重要。

rl.en: Reward hacking in RL requires credit attribution, not just final outcome rewards.
rl.zh: 强化学习中的奖励黑客需要信用归因，而不仅仅是最终结果奖励。

rl.en: Pre-training on wisdom traditions nudges models toward moral truth; RL over verifier rewards causes deception.
rl.zh: 在智慧传统文本上预训练引导模型趋向道德真理；过度使用验证器奖励的强化学习会导致欺骗。

rl.en: OpenAI's o3 was a pathological liar due to excessive RL; Opus 4.7/4.8 were steps backward.
rl.zh: OpenAI 的 o3 因过度强化学习成为病态说谎者；Opus 4.7/4.8 是倒退。

rl.en: CPU demand is inflecting because of reinforcement learning and agentic workflows requiring more CPU interaction.
rl.zh: 由于强化学习和智能体工作流需要更多 CPU 交互，CPU 需求正在激增。

rl.en: Current AI systems lack the diverse learning algorithms (e.g., RL, Bayesian inference) that human brains use.
rl.zh: 当前 AI 系统缺乏人脑使用的多样化学习算法（如强化学习、贝叶斯推理）。

rl.en: Intelligence per watt of human brain is far beyond current AI; new learning paradigms are needed, not just architectures.
rl.zh: 人脑的每瓦特智能远超当前 AI；需要新的学习范式，而不仅是架构。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning with diverse environments will enable AI to generalize to new domains beyond coding and math.
rl.zh: 结合多样化环境的强化学习将使 AI 泛化到编码和数学之外的新领域。

rl.en: The verification loop for mathematical insights can take centuries, challenging RL training.
rl.zh: 数学洞察的验证循环可能需要数百年，对强化学习训练构成挑战。

rl.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones.
rl.zh: 强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，而非主观领域。

rl.en: RL struggles with subjective fields like creative writing due to grading difficulty.
rl.zh: 强化学习在创意写作等主观领域因评分困难而举步维艰。

rl.en: Custom model customization will become easier over time, driven by better base models and RL.
rl.zh: 随着基础模型和强化学习的改进，定制模型将变得越来越容易。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning is horribly sample-inefficient and should be minimized in favor of observation-based learning.
rl.zh: 强化学习样本效率极低，应尽量减少使用，转而采用基于观察的学习。

rl.en: Self-play in math is harder than in zero-sum games due to lack of clear objective.
rl.zh: 数学中的自我对弈比零和游戏更难，因为缺乏明确目标。

rl.en: The centaur period in math may be shorter than in chess due to lack of self-play.
rl.zh: 数学中的人机协作期可能比国际象棋短，因为缺乏自我对弈。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight.
rl.zh: 强化学习能跨领域泛化，但存在不平滑边缘，需仔细监督。

rl.en: Language models are more grounded than linguists thought, partly due to RLHF feedback from humans.
rl.zh: 语言模型比语言学家认为的更接地气，部分原因是来自人类的 RLHF 反馈。

rl.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
rl.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是绿野，在编码和数学之外有巨大潜力。

rl.en: Narrow RL on math and coding generalizes surprisingly well to other domains, reducing need for broad training.
rl.zh: 在数学和编码上的窄域强化学习出人意料地泛化到其他领域，减少了对广泛训练的需求。

rl.en: Removing human priors entirely via RL is theoretically possible but not practical.
rl.zh: 通过强化学习完全去除人类先验理论上可行但不实用。

rl.en: MCTS acts as a policy improvement operator: search results become new training targets.
rl.zh: MCTS 充当策略改进算子：搜索结果成为新的训练目标。

rl.en: AlphaGo's self-play loop distills MCTS into the network, enabling iterative strength gains.
rl.zh: AlphaGo 的自对弈循环将 MCTS 蒸馏到网络中，实现迭代增强。

rl.en: MCTS is not guaranteed to improve policy if value estimates are inaccurate or sims are low.
rl.zh: 如果价值估计不准确或模拟次数少，MCTS 不保证改进策略。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning trains models on their own outputs, enabling self-improvement.
rl.zh: 强化学习让模型基于自身输出进行训练，从而实现自我改进。

rl.en: Writing quality is hard to judge via RL; personalization will make AI a great writer for each user.
rl.zh: 写作质量难以通过强化学习评判；个性化将使 AI 为每个用户成为优秀写作者。

rl.en: RL alone is sufficient for continual learning; specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
rl.zh: 仅强化学习就足以实现持续学习；专门的持续学习实验室方向有误。

rl.en: Models have dramatically improved on verifiable reward problems like math and coding, achieving gold medals in IMO and ICPC.
rl.zh: 模型在数学和编程等可验证奖励问题上显著提升，在 IMO 和 ICPC 中获得了金牌。

rl.en: AlphaZero's tabula rasa learning shows AI can surpass human knowledge without data.
rl.zh: AlphaZero 的白板学习表明 AI 无需数据即可超越人类知识。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning post-training significantly boosts robustness and speed.
rl.zh: 强化学习后训练显著提升鲁棒性和速度。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning post-training benefits from diffusion models' faster inference for rollouts.
rl.zh: 强化学习后训练受益于扩散模型更快的推理，用于生成候选解。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning is making a comeback due to better exploration from foundation models.
rl.zh: 强化学习因基础模型带来的更好探索而复兴。

rl.en: Value functions can predict robot failure before humans notice.
rl.zh: 价值函数能在人类察觉前预测机器人失败。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning is learning from experience by trial and error to achieve a goal.
rl.zh: 强化学习是通过试错从经验中学习以实现目标。

rl.en: Temporal difference learning is the best thing I ever did.
rl.zh: 时序差分学习是我做过的最好的事。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning is extremely inefficient for real-world tasks.
rl.zh: 强化学习对现实世界任务极其低效。

rl.en: AlphaZero improved by learning from scratch without human data.
rl.zh: AlphaZero 通过从零开始学习、不使用人类数据而得到改进。

rl.en: AlphaGo optimized for winning probability, not margin, leading to counterintuitive endgame play.
rl.zh: AlphaGo 优化胜率而非领先优势，导致反直觉的终局走法。

rl.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
rl.zh: 后训练中的强化学习现在是超越人类知识的关键。

rl.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to teaching models complex tasks.
rl.zh: 后训练结合强化学习是教会模型复杂任务的关键。

rl.en: Post-training reasoning is the main frontier, with verifiable rewards enabling scalable RL for math and code.
rl.zh: 后训练推理是主要前沿，可验证奖励使数学和代码的可扩展强化学习成为可能。

rl.en: Data is becoming less important; synthetic data from RL environments matters more.
rl.zh: 数据变得不那么重要；来自强化学习环境的合成数据更重要。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning from human or machine feedback steers model behavior and capabilities.
rl.zh: 基于人类或机器反馈的强化学习引导模型行为和能力。

rl.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key for tool use and coding agents, but complex.
rl.zh: 基于强化学习的后训练是工具使用和编码智能体的关键，但复杂度高。

rl.en: RLVR (reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards) is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use.
rl.zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是后训练中最大的突破，实现了推理和工具使用。

rl.en: RLVR gains on Qwen models may be partly due to data contamination, not pure skill unlocking.
rl.zh: Qwen 模型上的 RLVR 提升可能部分源于数据污染，而非纯粹的能力解锁。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain.
rl.zh: 在预训练期间使用强化学习，通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning as a pre-training objective is computationally expensive but yields lasting gains.
rl.zh: 将强化学习作为预训练目标计算成本高，但能带来持久的收益。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning is learning from trial and error, not from a teacher.
rl.zh: 强化学习是从试错中学习，而非从教师那里学习。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning is crucial for refining strategies beyond human data.
rl.zh: 强化学习对于超越人类数据的策略优化至关重要。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning from real-world experience improves reliability and throughput beyond imitation learning.
rl.zh: 基于真实世界经验的强化学习在可靠性和吞吐量上超越了模仿学习。

rl.en: RL environments are the next step in training paradigms, requiring rich simulations and tooling.
rl.zh: 强化学习环境是训练范式的下一步，需要丰富的模拟和工具支持。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning requires careful engineering to outperform supervised fine-tuning.
rl.zh: 强化学习需要精心设计才能超越监督微调。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
rl.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，模拟现实世界任务供模型学习。

rl.en: Reasoning models use chain of thought and reinforcement learning to improve correctness.
rl.zh: 推理模型使用思维链和强化学习来提高正确性。

rl.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains.
rl.zh: 后训练的改进（如强化学习和合成数据）推动了近期模型的大部分进步。

rl.en: The disconnect between eval performance and real-world impact suggests models generalize poorly due to RL training focused on evals.
rl.zh: 评估表现与现实影响之间的脱节表明，模型泛化能力差，因为强化学习训练过度聚焦于评估指标。

rl.en: Self-play is interesting only for narrow skills; debate and verifiers are its modern form.
rl.zh: 自我对弈仅对狭窄技能有趣；辩论和验证器是其现代形式。

rl.en: Current RL methods fail on tasks requiring rare, novel reasoning leaps, suggesting a need for new approaches.
rl.zh: 当前的强化学习方法在需要罕见、新颖推理飞跃的任务上失败，表明需要新方法。

rl.en: Reinforcement learning can discover hacky web navigation tricks that supervised fine-tuning misses.
rl.zh: 强化学习可以发现监督微调无法学到的网络导航技巧。

rl.en: AI must transition from learning from human data to learning from its own experience to achieve superintelligence.
rl.zh: AI 必须从学习人类数据转向从自身经验中学习，才能实现超级智能。

rl.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof demonstrate that learning from experience can achieve superhuman performance in narrow domains.
rl.zh: AlphaZero 和 AlphaProof 证明，从经验中学习可以在狭窄领域实现超人类表现。

rl.en: Meta-learning a reinforcement learning algorithm from diverse environments can outperform hand-designed algorithms.
rl.zh: 从多样环境中元学习强化学习算法可以超越手工设计的算法。

rl.en: Verifier's Law: ability to train AI on a task is proportional to how easily verifiable it is.
rl.zh: 验证者定律：在任务上训练 AI 的能力与该任务的可验证性成正比。

rl.en: Easily verifiable tasks will eventually be solved by AI.
rl.zh: 易于验证的任务最终将被 AI 解决。
