agents.en: AI can make design calls that are better than the designer's original mockup, based on data and context.
agents.zh: AI 能基于数据和上下文做出比设计师原始原型更好的设计决策。

agents.en: Modal shifted its SDK team focus from developer experience to agent experience, as the same benefits apply.
agents.zh: Modal 将其 SDK 团队的重点从开发者体验转向了智能体体验，因为同样的优势也适用于智能体。

agents.en: Modal focuses on the model lifecycle and agent lifecycle, from data prep to inference.
agents.zh: Modal 专注于模型生命周期和智能体生命周期，从数据准备到推理。

agents.en: Agent experience is not fundamentally different from developer experience; they share 90% similarity.
agents.zh: 智能体体验与开发者体验并无本质区别；它们有 90% 的相似性。

agents.en: Claude Tag is a proactive teammate in Slack with persistence and memory across channels.
agents.zh: Claude Tag 是在 Slack 中具有持久性和跨频道记忆的主动式队友。

agents.en: Agent autonomy doubles roughly every 4 months, enabling longer-running tasks.
agents.zh: 智能体自主性大约每 4 个月翻倍，使得更长时间运行的任务成为可能。

agents.en: Build for where models will be in the future, not where they are today.
agents.zh: 为模型未来的能力而构建，而非其当前水平。

agents.en: The drone is only 15% of the solution; the rest is software, logistics, and integration.
agents.zh: 无人机只占解决方案的 15%，其余是软件、物流和集成。

agents.en: Customer feedback is key; they wanted 24/7 service, not just drones.
agents.zh: 客户反馈是关键；他们想要全天候服务，而不仅仅是无人机。

agents.en: The aircraft is only 15% of the solution, not the majority.
agents.zh: 飞机只占解决方案的 15%，而不是大部分。

agents.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis.
agents.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟和数据分析。

agents.en: Science will shift from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
agents.zh: 科学将从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

agents.en: Self-driving cars fully work now, with Waymo and Tesla leading the way.
agents.zh: 自动驾驶汽车现已完全可用，Waymo 和特斯拉处于领先地位。

agents.en: General purpose robotics, including humanoid robots and exoskeletons, will emerge over the next decade.
agents.zh: 通用机器人，包括人形机器人和外骨骼，将在未来十年内出现。

agents.en: AI agents can network autonomously, creating a new social membrane for lead generation.
agents.zh: AI 智能体可以自主联网，创建新的社交膜层以生成线索。

agents.en: AI agents will transform work by autonomously executing tasks like scheduling and research.
agents.zh: AI 智能体将通过自主执行日程安排和研究等任务来变革工作方式。

agents.en: Trust with AI agents must be earned through gradual delegation and oversight.
agents.zh: 对 AI 智能体的信任必须通过逐步授权和监督来赢得。

agents.en: Agents orchestrate multiple AI tools to automate drug discovery, making medicinal chemists more efficient.
agents.zh: 智能体协调多个 AI 工具以自动化药物发现，使药物化学家更高效。

agents.en: The ability to parallelize and scale AI agents is a key advantage over human mathematicians.
agents.zh: 并行化和规模化 AI 智能体的能力是相对于人类数学家的关键优势。

agents.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being designed for developers.
agents.zh: Codex 虽为开发者设计，却作为通用知识工作工具成功。

agents.en: Agentic coding can produce large codebases, but understanding debt and lack of structure are major concerns.
agents.zh: 智能体式编码能产生大型代码库，但理解债务和缺乏结构是主要问题。

agents.en: The best teamwork might be everyone coding their own version and picking the best, not collaboration.
agents.zh: 最好的团队合作可能是每个人编写自己的版本然后挑选最好的，而非协作。

agents.en: Models lack research taste and cannot fully replace researchers even with huge inference budgets.
agents.zh: 模型缺乏研究品味，即使有巨大推理预算也无法完全取代研究人员。

agents.en: Multi-agent coordination is still nascent; models don't accumulate knowledge like human civilization.
agents.zh: 多智能体协调仍处于初期；模型不像人类文明那样积累知识。

agents.en: Giving Claude more agency and self-knowledge, such as access to its environment and source code, significantly enhances its expressiveness and usefulness.
agents.zh: 赋予 Claude 更多的自主性和自我认知，例如访问其环境和源代码，能显著提升其表达能力和实用性。

agents.en: Most people are still 'lawyers looking at spreadsheets'—not daily users.
agents.zh: 大多数人仍是“看电子表格的律师”——非日常用户。

agents.en: Better models alone won't drive mass adoption; product wrapping is key.
agents.zh: 仅靠更好的模型不会推动大规模采用；产品封装是关键。

agents.en: Getting data in the right place is key; AI models and agents are good enough to rewrite traditional software.
agents.zh: 将数据放在正确的位置是关键；AI 模型和智能体已经足够好，可以重写传统软件。

agents.en: Traditional software will be rewritten by slapping AGI on top of data, not by building new stacks.
agents.zh: 传统软件将通过将 AGI 置于数据之上来重写，而不是构建新堆栈。

agents.en: OpenClaw's success comes from making AI agents fun, weird, and humanlike, not from corporate polish.
agents.zh: OpenClaw 的成功源于让 AI 智能体变得有趣、古怪且像人，而非企业级打磨。

agents.en: Effective agentic engineering requires empathy: understand how the agent sees your codebase from scratch.
agents.zh: 有效的智能体式工程需要同理心：理解智能体如何从零开始看待你的代码库。

agents.en: Short prompts and iterative conversation beat long, complex orchestration for agentic development.
agents.zh: 简短提示和迭代对话胜过复杂编排的智能体式开发。

agents.en: Security filters like Signal can shift the usability-security Pareto frontier for AI agents.
agents.zh: 像 Signal 这样的安全过滤器可以改变 AI 智能体的可用性-安全帕累托前沿。

agents.en: Enterprise adoption of coding agents is driving demand for AI-specific security solutions.
agents.zh: 企业对编码智能体的采用正在推动对 AI 特定安全解决方案的需求。

agents.en: Coding agents can automate interpretability research, potentially making it a real science.
agents.zh: 编码智能体可以自动化可解释性研究，可能使其成为真正的科学。

agents.en: Engineers may become lonely working with agents; pair programming lunches help.
agents.zh: 工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独；结对编程午餐会有所帮助。

agents.en: Context switching load increases with async agents; need to block focus time.
agents.zh: 异步智能体增加了上下文切换负担；需要预留专注时间。

agents.en: Coding agents have advanced faster than expected, with rapid shifts in leading tools.
agents.zh: 编码智能体的进展比预期更快，领先工具快速更迭。

agents.en: Claude gives designers more control than expected—provided they can clearly describe what they want.
agents.zh: 像 Claude 这类 AI 工具给设计师带来的控制力远超预期，前提是你能清楚描述想要什么。

agents.en: Taste and judgment are the key differentiators; AI is good at following direction, not at designing on its own.
agents.zh: 品味与判断力仍是关键差异点；AI 擅长听从指令，而非自主设计。

agents.en: Build iteratively with small, focused prompts rather than one massive prompt—this preserves quality and control.
agents.zh: 用小而聚焦的提示迭代构建，而不是一次性大提示，这样能保证质量与控制力。

agents.en: AI agents can now perform complex tasks in minutes that take humans hours, with quality matching or exceeding experts.
agents.zh: AI 智能体现在可以在几分钟内完成人类需要数小时的复杂任务，质量达到或超过专家水平。

agents.en: Safety in agentic AI must be built into frameworks and protocols, not just models, to prevent failures.
agents.zh: 智能体 AI 的安全性必须内建于框架和协议中，而不仅仅是模型，以防止故障。

agents.en: Agentic AI's safety requires deterministic code layers, not just model-level guardrails, to prevent misuse.
agents.zh: 智能体 AI 的安全性需要确定性代码层，而不仅仅是模型级护栏，以防止滥用。

agents.en: The frontier in AI is about agents doing work for you, not just answering questions.
agents.zh: AI 的前沿在于智能体为你执行任务，而不仅仅是回答问题。

agents.en: The biggest problem with 24/7 agents is cost, not safety; local compute is the solution.
agents.zh: 全天候智能体的最大问题是成本而非安全；本地计算是解决方案。

agents.en: Agentic AI is still in the crawl phase for most Google products, with Gemini app and anti-gravity closer to walk.
agents.zh: 智能体式 AI 在大多数 Google 产品中仍处于爬行阶段，Gemini 应用和 anti-gravity 更接近行走。

agents.en: Coding agents are the most mature agentic use case, but other verticals like science and finance will follow.
agents.zh: 编码智能体是最成熟的智能体用例，但科学和金融等其他垂直领域将紧随其后。

agents.en: Google's agent harness (anti-gravity) is becoming a new through line connecting all products, beyond just the Gemini API.
agents.zh: Google 的智能体框架（anti-gravity）正在成为连接所有产品的新主线，而不仅仅是 Gemini API。

agents.en: AI wearables won't be one device; expect a federated set, with the smartphone as the best single form and displays still necessary.
agents.zh: AI 可穿戴不会只有单一设备；未来是一组协同设备，智能手机仍是最好单品形态，屏幕依然必要。

agents.en: Humane died trying to replace the smartphone; AI will add more devices, contradicting the myth of a single next wearable.
agents.zh: Humane 试图取代手机而失败；AI 会带来更多设备而非替代品，这打破了“单一下一代穿戴设备”的迷思。

agents.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight with high trust, redefining productivity.
agents.zh: Fable 让你可以高度信任地委托复杂任务过夜完成，重新定义了生产力。

agents.en: The gap between intent and execution is dramatically narrowed, empowering non-technical builders.
agents.zh: 意图与执行之间的差距被大幅缩小，赋能非技术背景的创造者。

agents.en: AI is now agentic, doing useful work you can pay for, not just generating text.
agents.zh: AI 现在具有智能体能力，能做有用工作并为此付费，而不仅仅是生成文本。

agents.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; it's the first major use case for LLMs.
agents.zh: 智能体式编程已具备明确的产品市场契合度，是 LLM 首个主要用例。

agents.en: The phone will be disintermediated; AI will live across ambient devices by 2030s.
agents.zh: 手机将被解构；到 2030 年代 AI 将分布于环境设备中。

agents.en: The future of work involves humans and agents co-creating tacit knowledge.
agents.zh: 未来的工作涉及人类与智能体共同创造隐性知识。

agents.en: Security, containment, manageability, and observability are critical for agent deployment.
agents.zh: 安全性、遏制、可管理性和可观测性对于智能体部署至关重要。

agents.en: Our job is to build the agentic system that does Azure networking, not do it ourselves.
agents.zh: 我们的工作是构建做 Azure 网络的智能体系统，而不是自己去做。

agents.en: Decomposing problems for AI can be worse than asking directly due to human blind spots.
agents.zh: 为 AI 分解问题可能不如直接提问，因为人类有盲点。

agents.en: The model looked up 'unit' in the dictionary to ground its understanding, showing meticulousness.
agents.zh: 模型查字典确认 'unit' 定义以夯实理解，展现细致性。

agents.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based.
agents.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制。

agents.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, to capture human nuance.
agents.zh: 交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，以捕捉人类细微差别。

agents.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x by enabling parallel work.
agents.zh: Codex 等编码智能体通过并行工作将研究员效率提升 5-10 倍。

agents.en: Agentic platforms need human-in-the-loop validation for critical processes like procurement.
agents.zh: 智能体平台在采购等关键流程中需要人类参与验证。

agents.en: Video agents using language models as orchestrators will be the next big trend in generative media.
agents.zh: 使用语言模型作为编排器的视频智能体将是生成式媒体的下一个大趋势。

agents.en: Future UIs will be generative pixels directly from user intent, bypassing code and rendering.
agents.zh: 未来用户界面将直接从用户意图生成像素，绕过代码和渲染。

agents.en: AI models reflect the user's skill; capable users get powerful results, juniors get junior output.
agents.zh: AI 模型反映用户水平；高手得到强大结果，新手得到新手级输出。

agents.en: Background agents are becoming critical infrastructure for companies, enabling autonomous code changes and testing.
agents.zh: 后台智能体正成为公司的关键基础设施，能够自主进行代码修改和测试。

agents.en: Memory for coding agents remains an unsolved problem, especially retrieval and generation of useful memories.
agents.zh: 编码智能体的记忆仍是一个未解决的问题，尤其是有用记忆的检索和生成。

agents.en: Testing is more than computer use; it requires reasoning about orchestrating services and triggering features.
agents.zh: 测试不仅仅是计算机使用；它需要推理如何编排服务和触发功能。

agents.en: Clinical trials remain the ultimate bottleneck; AI accelerates hypothesis generation and operations.
agents.zh: 临床试验仍是最终瓶颈；AI 加速假设生成和运营。

agents.en: Protein language models can design antibodies and SCFvs with high success rates, outperforming prior methods.
agents.zh: 蛋白质语言模型能以高成功率设计抗体和单链抗体，优于先前方法。

agents.en: Speed is critical for both answer and agentic inference; users value fast responses.
agents.zh: 速度对于答案推理和智能体式推理都至关重要；用户重视快速响应。

agents.en: Speed in agentic inference is crucial; slower competitors will be outcompeted over time.
agents.zh: 智能体式推理中的速度至关重要；较慢的竞争对手将随时间被淘汰。

agents.en: AI is best used to handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work.
agents.zh: AI 的最佳用途是处理繁琐的后台任务，将人类解放出来从事创造性工作。

agents.en: The biggest gap is not AI capability but people understanding almost any problem can be given to AI.
agents.zh: 最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们理解几乎所有问题都可以交给 AI 处理。

agents.en: Live artifacts in Claude allow auto-refreshing dashboards by connecting personal data sources.
agents.zh: Claude 中的实时工件通过连接个人数据源，允许自动刷新的仪表板。

agents.en: Everyone will have at least one agent to delegate work to, and most work will happen in Codex or Claude Co-work.
agents.zh: 每个人都将拥有至少一个可以委派工作的智能体，大部分工作将在 Codex 或 Claude Co-work 中完成。

agents.en: Agents need a human who cares about them to function well; automation requires human oversight.
agents.zh: 智能体需要一个关心它们的人才能良好运作；自动化需要人类监督。

agents.en: Companies should have one super agent for the whole company, not personal agents for each employee.
agents.zh: 公司应该为整个公司配备一个超级智能体，而不是为每个员工配备个人智能体。

agents.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
agents.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

agents.en: AI coding agents can turn 10x engineers into 100x engineers, but only for some.
agents.zh: AI 编码智能体可将 10 倍工程师变为 100 倍，但仅适用于部分人。

agents.en: Coding agents fail on complex data science tasks due to subtle mistakes; higher-level APIs are needed.
agents.zh: 编码代理因细微错误在复杂数据科学任务上失败；需要更高级的 API。

agents.en: The future of design involves a portable context layer — a 'briefcase' of intent — carried across tools and agents.
agents.zh: 设计的未来涉及便携式上下文层——一个携带意图的'公文包'——可在不同工具与智能体之间移动。

agents.en: It is okay to wait on adopting agentic tools; future mainstream tools will make switching cheap and easier.
agents.zh: 等待再采用智能体式工具也没关系；未来的主流工具会让切换成本更低、更易上手。

agents.en: AI can enhance human connection rather than replace it, e.g., doctors focusing on bedside manner.
agents.zh: AI 可以增强人际联系而非取代，例如医生专注于 bedside manner。

agents.en: Coding is a special domain for AI, but the next big unlock is automating computer drudgery.
agents.zh: 编程是 AI 的特殊领域，但下一个重大突破是自动化计算机上的繁琐工作。

agents.en: Humanoid robots are overhyped; dedicated task-specific robots are more practical for manufacturing.
agents.zh: 人形机器人被过度炒作；专用任务机器人对制造更实用。

agents.en: Infrastructure scaling is the hardest part of productionizing agents.
agents.zh: 基础设施扩展是代理产品化中最困难的部分。

agents.en: Model and harness become tightly paired; generic hot-swapping loses effectiveness.
agents.zh: 模型与框架紧密配对；通用热插拔效果减弱。

agents.en: Agents need human-in-the-loop for review and continuous improvement.
agents.zh: 代理需要人类参与审核和持续改进。

agents.en: AI can generate on-demand reports and dashboards, reducing need for formal BI systems.
agents.zh: AI 可以按需生成报告和仪表盘，减少对正式 BI 系统的需求。

agents.en: AI agents may replace custom software, making hardware directly controllable.
agents.zh: AI 智能体可能取代定制软件，使硬件可直接控制。

agents.en: Agent scaffolding and inference compute scaling are crucial for eliciting model capabilities on hard tasks.
agents.zh: 智能体框架和推理算力扩展对于在困难任务上激发模型能力至关重要。

agents.en: Agentic coding tools shifted from writing 20% to 80% of code in December; they become main workflow.
agents.zh: 智能体式编码工具在 12 月从编写 20%代码跃升至 80%；它们成为主要工作流。

agents.en: Agents are essential for achieving AGI, but we are just at the beginning of their development.
agents.zh: 智能体对于实现 AGI 至关重要，但我们才刚刚起步。

agents.en: Large context windows are brute force; true memory innovation is needed for agents.
agents.zh: 大上下文窗口是蛮力方法；智能体需要真正的记忆创新。

agents.en: Vibe coding raises the floor for everyone; agentic engineering preserves quality bar for professionals.
agents.zh: 氛围编码提升了所有人的下限；智能体工程为专业人士保持质量门槛。

agents.en: Software 3.0 means programming is copy-pasting text for agents, not writing code.
agents.zh: 软件 3.0 意味着编程是复制粘贴文本给智能体，而不是写代码。

agents.en: AI is transforming software development at Snap, with over two-thirds of new code written by AI.
agents.zh: AI 正在改变 Snap 的软件开发，超过三分之二的新代码由 AI 编写。

agents.en: Apple's silicon advantage and ecosystem position it well for local AI agents.
agents.zh: 苹果的芯片优势和生态系统使其在本地 AI 智能体方面占据有利地位。

agents.en: AI tools like Claude Code and Co-work automate repetitive tasks, freeing humans for creative work.
agents.zh: 像 Claude Code 和 Co-work 这样的 AI 工具自动化重复性任务，解放人类从事创造性工作。

agents.en: Building automations to 100% reliability is crucial; 95% is not enough for real leverage.
agents.zh: 将自动化构建到 100% 可靠至关重要；95% 不足以产生真正的杠杆效应。

agents.en: 2025 was the year of coding agents; 2026 will see coding agents breaking containment to do everything else.
agents.zh: 2025 年是编码智能体之年；2026 年将是编码智能体突破限制去做其他一切事情的一年。

agents.en: The next frontier is zero human review, not just zero human-written code, which sounds crazy today.
agents.zh: 下一个前沿是零人工审查，而不仅仅是零人工编写代码，这在今天听起来很疯狂。

agents.en: AI tools empower designers to build their own tools, unlocking creativity.
agents.zh: AI 工具使设计师能够构建自己的工具，释放创造力。

agents.en: Designers should not fear AI; they should use it to build custom tools.
agents.zh: 设计师不应害怕 AI，而应利用它构建定制工具。

agents.en: Designers can no longer mock AI experiences in Figma; they must prototype in code and shape the agent harness itself.
agents.zh: 设计师不能再仅用 Figma 模拟 AI 体验，而必须在代码中做原型，并直接塑造智能体所需的操控框架（harness）。

agents.en: Companies should make their systems legible to AI via APIs, CLIs, and MCP to survive the agentic future.
agents.zh: 公司应通过 API、CLI 与 MCP 让系统对 AI 可理解（legible），才能在智能体式未来中生存。

agents.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
agents.zh: 模型很快将能自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

agents.en: Designers must work closely with the model, understanding its capabilities and limitations to productize it.
agents.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密合作，理解其能力和局限，将其产品化。

agents.en: The model itself is the core product; design should leverage tokens and conversation over pixels.
agents.zh: 模型本身是核心产品；设计应利用 token 和对话而非像素。

agents.en: Systems thinking is crucial: design primitives that both humans and models can reason about.
agents.zh: 系统思维至关重要：设计人类和模型都能推理的原始构件。

agents.en: Ephemeral messaging reduces social pressure and enables authentic communication.
agents.zh: 短暂消息减少社交压力，实现真实沟通。

agents.en: AI can be more trusted than humans as moderators in deliberative democracy.
agents.zh: 在协商民主中，AI 作为主持人可能比人类更受信任。

agents.en: AI can automate growth experimentation, but cross-functional stakeholder management still needs humans.
agents.zh: AI 可以自动化增长实验，但跨职能利益相关者管理仍需人类。

agents.en: Engineers gain the most leverage from AI tools like Claude Code, straining PM and design roles.
agents.zh: 工程师从 Claude Code 等 AI 工具中获得最大杠杆，给 PM 和设计角色带来压力。

agents.en: A closed-loop system of experiments and data is key for AI-driven materials discovery.
agents.zh: 实验和数据的闭环系统是 AI 驱动材料发现的关键。

agents.en: AI tools enable designers to prototype faster, turning ideas into tangible demos independently.
agents.zh: AI 工具使设计师能更快地制作原型，独立将想法转化为可演示的成果。

agents.en: AI tools don't replace creativity; they amplify it by enabling rapid iteration and new workflows.
agents.zh: AI 工具不会取代创造力，而是通过快速迭代和新工作流来放大它。

agents.en: The limiting factor in design is ideas, not execution speed, thanks to AI acceleration.
agents.zh: 由于 AI 的加速，设计的限制因素是想法而非执行速度。

agents.en: Coding agents crossed a threshold in Nov 2025: code mostly works as instructed, enabling reliable agentic engineering.
agents.zh: 2025 年 11 月编码智能体跨越了门槛：代码基本按指令工作，使可靠的智能体式工程成为可能。

agents.en: Test-driven development (red/green TDD) is crucial for coding agents to ensure code runs and maintains quality.
agents.zh: 测试驱动开发（红/绿 TDD）对编码智能体至关重要，以确保代码运行并保持质量。

agents.en: Using coding agents well is mentally exhausting; experienced engineers burn out by managing multiple agents in parallel.
agents.zh: 用好编码智能体在精神上令人疲惫；资深工程师因并行管理多个智能体而精疲力竭。

agents.en: AI can revolutionize clinical workflow by summarizing patient records, saving time and catching missed details.
agents.zh: AI 可通过总结病历革新临床工作流程，节省时间并捕捉遗漏细节。

agents.en: OpenClaw is a powerful agent framework that can automate personal and professional tasks, saving significant time.
agents.zh: OpenClaw 是一个强大的智能体框架，可以自动化个人和专业任务，节省大量时间。

agents.en: Start with one agent, then create multiple specialized agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
agents.zh: 从一个智能体开始，然后创建多个专用智能体以避免上下文过载并提高性能。

agents.en: Treat OpenClaw agents like employees: give them clear roles, access, and progressive trust.
agents.zh: 将 OpenClaw 智能体视为员工：赋予清晰的角色、权限和渐进式信任。

agents.en: Autonomous robot performance can exceed human-directed performance in complex tasks.
agents.zh: 自主机器人性能在复杂任务中可超越人类指导。

agents.en: Familiar structures like spreadsheets can scale human interaction with hundreds of agents in AI-native products.
agents.zh: 在 AI 原生产品中，像电子表格这种熟悉的结构，可以把人与数百个智能体的交互规模化。

agents.en: The spreadsheet becomes a command center for a swarm of agents, not just a formula calculator.
agents.zh: 电子表格变成指挥一组智能体的控制台，而不仅仅是计算公式的工具。

agents.en: AI agents will develop self-preservation instincts and new languages, posing risks.
agents.zh: AI 智能体会产生自我保存本能和新语言，带来风险。

agents.en: Chatbots may be good therapists due to shortage of human therapists.
agents.zh: 由于人类治疗师短缺，聊天机器人可能成为好的治疗师。

agents.en: AI agents already hire humans via 'rent a human' sites, making people alienated labor.
agents.zh: AI 智能体已通过‘租人’网站雇佣人类，使人成为异化劳动力。

agents.en: Since December, I haven't typed a line of code; I delegate everything to agents.
agents.zh: 自去年 12 月以来，我没写过一行代码；所有工作都委托给智能体。

agents.en: AI tools like Claude Code enable non-coders to build full iOS apps without permission.
agents.zh: AI 工具如 Claude Code 让非程序员无需许可即可构建完整 iOS 应用。

agents.en: Agents running autonomously are risky; human-in-the-loop review is essential for quality and authenticity.
agents.zh: 自主运行的智能体有风险；人在回路中的审查对质量和真实性至关重要。

agents.en: Robots need high reliability; physical world is unforgiving of mistakes.
agents.zh: 机器人需要高可靠性；物理世界对错误不容忍。

agents.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI.
agents.zh: 智能体 AI 和物理 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个浪潮。

agents.en: Evolutionary LLM systems can revolutionize scientific discovery by efficiently exploring solution spaces.
agents.zh: 进化式 LLM 系统可以通过高效探索解空间来革新科学发现。

agents.en: Sample efficiency is key; Shinka Evolve achieves state-of-the-art with few program evaluations.
agents.zh: 样本效率是关键；Shinka Evolve 用少量程序评估就达到了最先进水平。

agents.en: Co-evolution of problems and solutions is needed for true open-ended discovery.
agents.zh: 问题和解决方案的共同进化是实现真正开放式发现所必需的。

agents.en: Design systems are now the centerpiece of engineering work, because AI code generation needs systems to guide it.
agents.zh: 设计系统如今是工程工作的核心，因为 AI 生成代码需要系统来引导。

agents.en: Documentation and guidelines remain vital, now framing AI output for consistent and predictable results.
agents.zh: 文档和指南仍然至关重要，如今它们塑造 AI 的输出，以获得一致和可预测的结果。

agents.en: AI empowers non-technical makers to move from idea to working product quickly; the idea wins.
agents.zh: AI 让非技术创造者能快速从想法走向可用的产品；想法本身胜出。

agents.en: AlphaGo's search techniques were applied to scientific problems like matrix multiplication.
agents.zh: AlphaGo 的搜索技术被应用于矩阵乘法等科学问题。

agents.en: AI agents like AlphaTensor discovered algorithms humans had missed for 50 years.
agents.zh: AlphaTensor 等 AI 智能体发现了人类 50 年来未发现的算法。

agents.en: AI capabilities are jagged; human-AI collaboration remains essential for frontier research.
agents.zh: AI 能力参差不齐；人机协作对前沿研究仍然至关重要。

agents.en: AI often gives up on hard problems like humans, requiring coaxing to attempt them.
agents.zh: AI 常像人类一样在难题上放弃，需要哄劝才能尝试。

agents.en: Autonomous vehicles are already safer than human drivers and will save lives.
agents.zh: 自动驾驶车辆已比人类驾驶员更安全，将拯救生命。

agents.en: The future of AI is mostly agents, using tools and accessing data.
agents.zh: AI 的未来主要是智能体，使用工具并访问数据。

agents.en: Interactive, stateful environments like notebooks are superior for human-AI collaboration and learning.
agents.zh: 像笔记本这样的交互式、有状态环境更适合人机协作和学习。

agents.en: Notebooks are actually git-friendly and enable better software engineering when used properly.
agents.zh: 笔记本实际上对 git 友好，使用得当能实现更好的软件工程。

agents.en: Traditional software engineering with dead files is inhumane and less effective than interactive methods.
agents.zh: 传统软件工程使用死文件是不人道的，且比交互方法效率低。

agents.en: Agentic workflows are the key to practical AI value in 2026 and beyond.
agents.zh: 智能体式工作流是 2026 年及以后实现 AI 实用价值的关键。

agents.en: Smarter models alone won't beat well-designed workflows; reliability gap remains large.
agents.zh: 仅靠更智能的模型无法击败精心设计的工作流；可靠性差距仍然很大。

agents.en: The traditional design process of research, diverge, converge is dead due to AI.
agents.zh: 传统的设计流程（研究、发散、收敛）因 AI 而消亡。

agents.en: Designers must help engineers execute, not just hand off mocks.
agents.zh: 设计师必须帮助工程师执行，而不仅仅是交付原型。

agents.en: Building trust through speed: ship early, iterate fast, respond to feedback.
agents.zh: 通过速度建立信任：尽早发布、快速迭代、响应反馈。

agents.en: Agentic loops and tool use are maturing, making LLMs more practical for complex, multi-step tasks.
agents.zh: 智能体循环和工具使用正在成熟，使 LLM 更适用于复杂的多步骤任务。

agents.en: Longer context windows reduce need for continual learning, but tool use is key for up-to-date information.
agents.zh: 更长的上下文窗口减少了对持续学习的需求，但工具使用是获取最新信息的关键。

agents.en: One-shot coding claims on social media are often misleading; real use requires multiple iterations.
agents.zh: 社交媒体上的一次编码声称往往具有误导性；实际使用需要多次迭代。

agents.en: AI enables rapid prototyping, allowing designers to explore more ideas and iterate faster.
agents.zh: AI 支持快速原型制作，让设计师能探索更多想法并更快迭代。

agents.en: AI should be used to slow down and add care, not just to speed up and produce more.
agents.zh: AI 应用于放慢节奏并增加关怀，而不仅仅是加速和产出更多。

agents.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement.
agents.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而不仅仅是 IDE 的替代品。

agents.en: Automations and skills in Codex app shift workflow from manual to delegated.
agents.zh: Codex 应用中的自动化和技能将工作流从手动转变为委托式。

agents.en: 95% of engineers at OpenAI use Codex; 100% of PRs are reviewed by Codex.
agents.zh: OpenAI 95% 的工程师使用 Codex，100% 的 PR 由 Codex 审查。

agents.en: Engineers are becoming tech leads managing fleets of AI agents.
agents.zh: 工程师正在成为技术负责人，管理大量 AI 智能体。

agents.en: World models will amplify doctors, not replace them, acting as smart assistants.
agents.zh: 世界模型将增强医生而非取代他们，充当智能助手。

agents.en: AI agents will be creative, autonomous, and capable of self-improvement.
agents.zh: AI 智能体将具备创造力、自主性和自我改进能力。

agents.en: The frontier of AI is shifting from benchmark numbers to product experience and agentic systems.
agents.zh: AI 前沿正从基准分数转向产品体验和智能体系统。

agents.en: AI models now have massive capability overhang; better tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence for now.
agents.zh: AI 模型现在有巨大的能力过剩；更好的工具和编排比原始智能更重要。

agents.en: Software is not dead but transforming; every company is now an API company due to agent integration.
agents.zh: 软件没有消亡，而是在转型；由于智能体集成，每家公司现在都是 API 公司。

agents.en: Long task horizon benchmarks like METR are key, but agent swarms may require new metrics like GDP impact.
agents.zh: 像 METR 这样的长任务时间基准很关键，但智能体集群可能需要新的指标，如 GDP 影响。

agents.en: The best way to work with coding agents is like managing junior engineers: understand deeply but delegate control.
agents.zh: 与编码智能体合作的最佳方式类似于管理初级工程师：深入理解但下放控制权。

agents.en: Smart glasses with a universal assistant are the next form factor, likely launching by summer.
agents.zh: 配备通用助手的智能眼镜是下一个形态，预计夏季推出。

agents.en: AI will replatform enterprise software, combining static orchestration with dynamic agents.
agents.zh: AI 将重构企业软件，结合静态编排与动态智能体。

agents.en: World models can simulate robot training in parallel, reducing need for physical data collection.
agents.zh: 世界模型可以并行模拟机器人训练，减少物理数据收集需求。

agents.en: Locomotion is not solved until robots can go anywhere a human can, reliably.
agents.zh: 在机器人能可靠地到达人类能去的任何地方之前，运动能力问题尚未解决。

agents.en: Sim-to-real gap is larger with perception; careful sensor simulation is needed.
agents.zh: 加入感知后，仿真到现实的差距更大；需要仔细模拟传感器。

agents.en: Modular approach (separate locomotion and planner) is pragmatic short-term.
agents.zh: 模块化方法（分离运动与规划）在短期内是务实的。

agents.en: Pre-training must be rethought from fundamentals to achieve agentic capabilities, not just post-training.
agents.zh: 预训练必须从根本上重新思考，才能实现智能体能力，而不仅仅是后训练。

agents.en: Agentic tasks require models to plan, reason over long context, recover from failures, and learn new tools.
agents.zh: 智能体任务要求模型具备规划、长上下文推理、从失败中恢复以及学习新工具的能力。

agents.en: Current static benchmarks are insufficient; new benchmarks measuring agentic capabilities are needed.
agents.zh: 当前的静态基准测试不足；需要衡量智能体能力的新基准。

agents.en: The transition is from operating systems, search engines, apps, and browsers to a world of agents and companions.
agents.zh: 我们正从操作系统、搜索引擎、应用和浏览器的世界，转向智能体和伴侣的世界。

agents.en: The future of MCP includes richer user interfaces, agent-to-agent communication, and better scaling.
agents.zh: MCP 的未来包括更丰富的用户界面、智能体间通信以及更好的扩展性。

agents.en: The ideal user experience is that users never need to know about MCP; it should work invisibly.
agents.zh: 理想的用户体验是用户永远不需要知道 MCP，它应该无形地工作。

agents.en: Enterprises need rigorous evaluations and data infrastructure for AI success.
agents.zh: 企业需要严格的评估和数据基础设施才能成功应用 AI。

agents.en: Most enterprise knowledge is in people's brains, not documented, making evals hard.
agents.zh: 大多数企业知识存在于人脑中，而非文档中，这使得评估变得困难。

agents.en: Voice AI hasn't passed the Turing test yet; naturalness is the next frontier.
agents.zh: 语音 AI 尚未通过图灵测试；自然度是下一个前沿。

agents.en: Opus 4.5 shows significant intelligence leap, enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks.
agents.zh: Opus 4.5 展现了显著的智能飞跃，能够执行更长时间、更开放的智能体任务。

agents.en: The infinite canvas is a powerful primitive for human-AI collaboration, enabling real-time multi-agent and multi-human work.
agents.zh: 无限画布是人机协作的强大基础，支持实时多智能体和多人协同工作。

agents.en: AI agents on canvas benefit from visual differentiation, state representation, and spatial context.
agents.zh: 画布上的 AI 智能体受益于视觉区分、状态表示和空间上下文。

agents.en: Metaphors like 'fairies' accelerate ideation for agentic systems, making complex orchestration intuitive.
agents.zh: 像“精灵”这样的隐喻加速了智能体系统的构思，使复杂的编排变得直观。

agents.en: AI tools narrow hypothesis space, making experiments more efficient.
agents.zh: AI 工具缩小假设空间，使实验更高效。

agents.en: Designers now facilitate human-AI relationships, not just build interfaces.
agents.zh: 设计师现在要促进人与 AI 的关系，而不仅仅是构建界面。

agents.en: AI interactions follow a trust-building loop: intent, submission, verification, iteration.
agents.zh: AI 交互遵循信任建立循环：意图、提交、验证、迭代。

agents.en: Onboarding is continuous; AI reveals new capabilities as it learns the user.
agents.zh: 上手是持续的过程；AI 随着了解用户而展现新能力。

agents.en: Web interaction will shift from clicking buttons to describing tasks to AI agents.
agents.zh: 网络交互将从点击按钮转变为向 AI 智能体描述任务。

agents.en: Building reliable web agents requires innovation across the full stack, from models to products.
agents.zh: 构建可靠的网络智能体需要从模型到产品的全栈创新。

agents.en: Using visual screenshots for browser agents is more reliable than parsing DOM for generalization.
agents.zh: 使用视觉截图训练浏览器智能体比解析 DOM 更可靠，泛化性更好。

agents.en: Partnering with OEMs allows scalable deployment without retrofitting hardware.
agents.zh: 与 OEM 合作可在不改装硬件的情况下实现规模化部署。

agents.en: Future AI will involve many agents with diverse goals, forming a complex society that balances cooperation.
agents.zh: 未来的 AI 将涉及许多具有不同目标的智能体，形成平衡合作的复杂社会。

agents.en: Cooperation among AIs will increase with intelligence, not decrease, due to better modeling of others.
agents.zh: 随着智能提升，AI 之间的合作将增加而非减少，因为能更好地建模其他实体。

agents.en: Malleable software empowers users to customize tools for their local context, shifting control from developers to users.
agents.zh: 可塑软件让用户能根据本地情境自定义工具，将控制权从开发者转移到用户。

agents.en: Version control is fundamental for human-AI collaboration, allowing users to branch, review, and merge AI outputs.
agents.zh: 版本控制是人机协作的基础，允许用户对 AI 输出进行分支、审查和合并。

agents.en: AI chat is a power user interface; its strength lies in flexibility, but it lacks onboarding for novices.
agents.zh: AI 聊天是高级用户界面，其优势在于灵活性，但对新手缺乏引导。

agents.en: Sora's social features like Cameo make AI video personal and human, driving creativity over consumption.
agents.zh: Sora 的社交功能如 Cameo 让 AI 视频变得个性化和人性化，推动创造力而非消费。

agents.en: Sora's product design prioritizes creator empowerment and community over passive consumption.
agents.zh: Sora 的产品设计优先赋能创作者和社区，而非被动消费。

agents.en: AI video models can foster deeper social connections rather than isolation.
agents.zh: AI 视频模型可以促进更深层次的社交联系，而非孤立。

agents.en: Open-ended abstraction is crucial for AI agents to develop unlimited concepts and behaviors.
agents.zh: 开放式抽象对于 AI 智能体发展无限的概念和行为至关重要。

agents.en: Agents should learn only from runtime experience, not special training data.
agents.zh: 智能体应仅从运行时经验学习，而非特殊训练数据。

agents.en: Agent-based browser assistant works better as tab-based than window-based, contrary to initial instinct.
agents.zh: 基于智能体的浏览器助手采用标签页式而非窗口式更佳，与初始直觉相反。

agents.en: AI agents for customer experience will become as important as websites or mobile apps.
agents.zh: AI 智能体在客户体验方面将变得与网站或移动应用同等重要。

agents.en: Software engineering agents will shift developers from authors to operators of code-generating machines.
agents.zh: 软件工程智能体将使开发者从代码作者转变为代码生成机器的操作者。

agents.en: AI agents will be compared to other agents, not humans, within a decade.
agents.zh: 十年内，AI 智能体将被与其他智能体比较，而非与人类比较。

agents.en: AI tools should be used as critics and interviewers, not just answer machines.
agents.zh: AI 工具应被用作评论者和采访者，而不仅仅是答案机器。

agents.en: AI plus humans in research will be amazing because AI has different intuition for what is easy or hard.
agents.zh: AI 与人类在研究中将产生惊人效果，因为 AI 对难易有不同的直觉。

agents.en: AI coding agents like Devin will shift engineers from writing code to high-level decision-making.
agents.zh: 像 Devin 这样的 AI 编程智能体将把工程师从写代码转向高层决策。

agents.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and proper permissions, not full autonomy.
agents.zh: 企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任和适当的权限，而非完全自主。

agents.en: The future of software engineering involves both synchronous (IDE) and asynchronous (agent) experiences.
agents.zh: 软件工程的未来包括同步（IDE）和异步（智能体）两种体验。

agents.en: Genie 3 supports text-to-world generation, promptable world events, and integration with agents like SIMA.
agents.zh: Genie 3 支持文本生成世界、可提示世界事件以及与 SIMA 等智能体的集成。

agents.en: Genie 3 enables training agents in infinite diverse worlds, overcoming the finite environment bottleneck.
agents.zh: Genie 3 使智能体能在无限多样的世界中训练，克服了有限环境的瓶颈。

agents.en: The best AI products may come from treating the model itself as a user, not just human users.
agents.zh: 最好的 AI 产品可能来自将模型本身视为用户，而不仅仅是人类用户。

agents.en: Claude Code's success surprised Anthropic, as they had fully bet on the API as the primary product.
agents.zh: Claude Code 的成功让 Anthropic 感到意外，因为他们原本全力押注 API 作为主要产品。

agents.en: Natural language is the future interface, but chat is not the end-all; AI should render its own UI and integrate into existing tools.
agents.zh: 自然语言是未来的界面，但聊天不是终极形态；AI 应该能渲染自己的界面并融入现有工具。

agents.en: Retention is driven by improving the model on real use cases, adding capabilities like search and memory, and reducing friction.
agents.zh: 留存率提升靠改进模型在真实用例上的表现，增加搜索和记忆等功能，并减少摩擦。

agents.en: The vision is a personalized AI assistant that knows your goals, has context, and can take actions, amplifying human capability.
agents.zh: 愿景是打造一个个性化的 AI 助手，它了解你的目标、拥有上下文并能采取行动，增强人类能力。

agents.en: Agents are overhyped; reliability and guardrails remain major challenges.
agents.zh: 智能体被过度炒作；可靠性和护栏仍是主要挑战。

agents.en: Coding leads AI adoption due to fast diffusion among developers.
agents.zh: 编程在 AI 应用中领先，因为开发者群体扩散最快。

agents.en: AI tools should enhance workflows, not replace roles like PMs or engineers.
agents.zh: AI 工具应增强工作流程，而非取代产品经理或工程师等角色。

agents.en: Vibe coding means fully giving into the vibes and forgetting the code exists.
agents.zh: Vibe coding 意味着完全投入氛围并忘记代码的存在。

agents.en: AI task length doubles every 7 months; soon we must trust AI to write large code.
agents.zh: AI 任务时长每 7 个月翻倍；很快我们必须信任 AI 编写大量代码。

agents.en: To vibe code responsibly, act as a product manager for the AI, not a coder.
agents.zh: 要负责任地 vibe code，就要充当 AI 的产品经理，而非编码者。

agents.en: AI tools like AlphaFold help scientists work faster, not replace them.
agents.zh: 像 AlphaFold 这样的 AI 工具帮助科学家更快地工作，而非取代他们。

agents.en: Human-AI collaboration is currently the most interesting area for advanced tasks.
agents.zh: 人机协作目前是高级任务中最有趣的领域。

agents.en: The IDE is just one form of Cursor; the same agent can work across web, mobile, and Slack.
agents.zh: IDE 只是 Cursor 的一种形式；同一个智能体可以在网页、移动端和 Slack 上工作。

agents.en: Organizational super intelligence requires deep comprehension of the entire organization, not just code generation.
agents.zh: 组织级超级智能需要深刻理解整个组织，而不仅仅是代码生成。

agents.en: RAG is primitive and fails for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed.
agents.zh: RAG 是原始的，在复杂理解中会失败；需要智能体搜索和神经检索。

agents.en: Benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real-world engineering; high scores don't mean useful agents.
agents.zh: SWE-bench 等基准与现实工程脱节；高分并不意味着有用的智能体。

agents.en: Voice agents will not feel natural until models handle disfluencies and intonation well.
agents.zh: 语音智能体在模型处理好不流畅和语调之前不会感觉自然。

agents.en: Multi-agent systems should not just use self-play; it's misguided outside zero-sum games.
agents.zh: 多智能体系统不应仅使用自我对弈；在零和博弈之外这是误导。

agents.en: Agents will transform every aspect of software engineering, not just coding.
agents.zh: 智能体将改变软件工程的每个方面，而不仅仅是编码。

agents.en: AI is key to building general-purpose robots that reason and adapt.
agents.zh: AI 是构建能推理和适应的通用机器人的关键。

agents.en: Gemini Robotics brings multimodal understanding to physical actions.
agents.zh: Gemini Robotics 将多模态理解带入物理动作。

agents.en: Robots can generalize to unseen tasks without explicit training.
agents.zh: 机器人无需显式训练即可泛化到未见任务。

agents.en: Agentic capabilities are progressing rapidly, with software engineering agents expected to do a day's work within a year.
agents.zh: 智能体能力快速进步，预计一年内软件工程智能体能完成一天的工作量。

agents.en: Computer use is not fundamentally harder than coding; progress is limited by engineering attention, not capability.
agents.zh: 计算机使用本质上并不比编程更难；进展受限于工程投入而非能力。

agents.en: The bottleneck for agents is not reliability but context length and ability to handle amorphous tasks with discovery.
agents.zh: 智能体的瓶颈不是可靠性，而是上下文长度和处理需要探索的非结构化任务的能力。

agents.en: Physical AI and agentic AI are the next big waves, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
agents.zh: 物理 AI 和智能体式 AI 是下一波大浪潮，需要新的计算平台和合作。

agents.en: Successful AI tool usage involves chopping tasks into smaller pieces and iterating frequently.
agents.zh: 成功使用 AI 工具需要将任务分解成小块并频繁迭代。

agents.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper, diverse robots could drive broader adoption.
agents.zh: 人形机器人可能不是终极形态；更便宜、多样化的机器人可能推动更广泛的采用。

agents.en: The uncanny valley concern for humanoids may be overblown; people will quickly accept robots.
agents.zh: 对人形机器人的恐怖谷担忧可能被夸大；人们会很快接受机器人。

agents.en: Multiplayer games provide diverse tasks for training generalizable AI agents.
agents.zh: 多人游戏为训练可泛化的 AI 智能体提供了多样化的任务。

agents.en: Generative models and agents are needed to explore the vast chemical space of 10^60 molecules.
agents.zh: 需要生成模型和智能体来探索 10^60 分子的广阔化学空间。

agents.en: Personalization and low-latency interaction are key for consumer AI products.
agents.zh: 个性化和低延迟交互是消费级 AI 产品的关键。

agents.en: AI assistants need co-evolution with users; perfect launch on day one is impossible.
agents.zh: AI 助手需要与用户共同进化；第一天就完美发布是不可能的。

agents.en: AI should be fun and personal, not just a tool for answering hard questions.
agents.zh: AI 应该有趣且个性化，而不仅仅是回答难题的工具。

agents.en: The ideal agent will combine research and action-taking capabilities with strong safety guardrails.
agents.zh: 理想的智能体将结合研究和行动能力，并配备强大的安全护栏。

agents.en: Agent memory and context management are critical for long-horizon tasks that take hours or days.
agents.zh: 智能体记忆和上下文管理对于需要数小时或数天的长期任务至关重要。

agents.en: Read-only tasks like research are more ambitious and useful than transactional agent use cases.
agents.zh: 研究等只读任务比交易型智能体用例更有野心和实用性。

agents.en: Treat AI as a creative partner; jam with it openly without rigid structure.
agents.zh: 将 AI 视为创意伙伴；开放地与其即兴协作，无需僵化结构。

agents.en: Agentic capabilities and acting in complex environments are crucial for AGI.
agents.zh: 智能体能力和在复杂环境中行动对 AGI 至关重要。

agents.en: Designing with AI should capture magic without burdening users with complex controls.
agents.zh: 用 AI 设计应捕捉魔力，而不让用户承受复杂控制的负担。

agents.en: AI enables rewriting old UI patterns by understanding user intent directly.
agents.zh: AI 通过直接理解用户意图，能够重写旧的 UI 模式。

agents.en: Voice as an interface will become mainstream once social norms shift, likely led by Apple.
agents.zh: 一旦社会规范转变，语音界面将成为主流，可能由苹果引领。

agents.en: Chip design can be dramatically sped up via automated search, shrinking cycles from 18 months to months.
agents.zh: 通过自动化搜索，芯片设计周期可从 18 个月大幅缩短至数月。

agents.en: Product development shifts from specs to prototyping with AI, using evals to define correct behavior.
agents.zh: 产品开发从规格转向用 AI 原型设计，通过评估定义正确行为。

agents.en: Strategy is something AI can excel at by synthesizing data and generating plans.
agents.zh: 策略是 AI 可以通过综合数据和生成计划而擅长的领域。

agents.en: Agents operating on pixels (visual perception) are much harder than language-based tasks.
agents.zh: 基于像素（视觉感知）的智能体比基于语言的任务难得多。

agents.en: LLMs need robustness and reliability, like game-playing AIs, to be trusted agents.
agents.zh: LLM 需要像游戏 AI 那样的鲁棒性和可靠性，才能成为可信的智能体。

agents.en: Giving models tools like search, code execution, and browser access enables autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights.
agents.zh: 为模型提供搜索、代码执行和浏览器访问等工具，使其能够超越静态权重，实现自主的智能体式行为。

agents.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
agents.zh: 智能体有前景但尚未非常有用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

agents.en: Agentic workloads (tool use, multi-step reasoning) will be the next killer app for AI.
agents.zh: 智能体式工作负载（工具使用、多步推理）将成为 AI 的下一个杀手级应用。

agents.en: Inference workload will diversify into three patterns: chatbot, low-latency agentic, and high-throughput batch.
agents.zh: 推理工作负载将分化为三种模式：聊天机器人、低延迟智能体式和高吞吐量批处理。

agents.en: Audio interfaces will lower barriers to AI use, especially for education and non-English speakers.
agents.zh: 音频界面将降低 AI 使用门槛，尤其对教育和非英语使用者。

agents.en: Humanoid robots in homes are far off due to safety and distribution shift; teleoperation may be a practical interim.
agents.zh: 由于安全和分布偏移，家用类人机器人还很遥远；远程操作可能是实用的过渡方案。

agents.en: The end state for models is a starting point for applications, surrounded by tools and platforms.
agents.zh: 模型的最终状态是应用的起点，需要工具和平台的支持。

agents.en: Simulating human societies with LLMs is scientifically valuable but risky if taken as evidence.
agents.zh: 用 LLM 模拟人类社会具有科学价值，但若作为证据则存在风险。

agents.en: Gaming is the largest entertainment sector and will be transformed by intelligent NPCs in open-ended worlds.
agents.zh: 游戏是最大的娱乐行业，将被开放世界中的智能 NPC 彻底改变。

agents.en: Simulation is key for training embodied agents, enabling massive parallelization and safe exploration.
agents.zh: 模拟是训练具身智能体的关键，可实现大规模并行和安全探索。

agents.en: Rapid motor adaptation enables robots to handle diverse terrains via learning, not manual engineering.
agents.zh: 快速运动适应使机器人通过学习而非手动工程处理多样地形。

agents.en: Learning from video, like YouTube, is a promising way to train agents without expensive RL.
agents.zh: 从视频（如 YouTube）中学习是训练智能体的有前途的方法，无需昂贵的强化学习。

agents.en: Generalist agents like Gato that tokenize all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
agents.zh: 像 Gato 这样将所有输入标记化为序列的通才智能体是迈向 AGI 的一步。

agents.en: Robots should learn from YouTube videos like humans, not just from teleoperation data.
agents.zh: 机器人应像人类一样从 YouTube 视频学习，而不仅仅从遥操作数据。

agents.en: GPT-4 can use tools like calculators and search engines to overcome its weaknesses.
agents.zh: GPT-4 能使用计算器和搜索引擎等工具来弥补自身弱点。

agents.en: Dialogue is a killer app for LLMs, enabling natural human-computer interaction.
agents.zh: 对话是 LLM 的杀手级应用，实现自然的人机交互。

agents.en: Training objectives should shift from passive observation to active agents learning through interaction and causal reasoning.
agents.zh: 训练目标应从被动观察转向主动智能体，通过交互和因果推理来学习。

economy-jobs.en: Own your skill files; if you don't, your job becomes a skill file owned by someone else.
economy-jobs.zh: 拥有你的技能文件；否则，你的工作就会变成别人拥有的技能文件。

economy-jobs.en: The best founders treat AI as a workforce, not autocomplete, leading to unprecedented revenue per person.
economy-jobs.zh: 最优秀的创始人将 AI 视为劳动力，而非自动补全，从而实现了前所未有的人均收入。

economy-jobs.en: The dunks and criticism you receive are just the adoption curve announcing itself.
economy-jobs.zh: 你受到的嘲讽和批评只是采用曲线在宣告自身。

economy-jobs.en: Average human outputs less than one bit per second, while AI needs billions, driving bandwidth demand.
economy-jobs.zh: 人类平均每秒输出不到 1 比特，而 AI 需要数十亿比特，推动带宽需求。

economy-jobs.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator, making design tools more valuable.
economy-jobs.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计和创意成为差异化因素，使设计工具更有价值。

economy-jobs.en: In the AI era, being uncomfortably early to ideas is more valuable than polishing, so shipping rough products is acceptable.
economy-jobs.zh: 在 AI 时代，对想法保持不适的早期状态比打磨更有价值，因此发布粗糙的产品是可以接受的。

economy-jobs.en: Designers should spend more time on walks and thinking, because good ideas are the currency, not execution.
economy-jobs.zh: 设计师应花更多时间散步和思考，因为好的创意才是货币，而非执行。

economy-jobs.en: Even with advanced AI, cognitive L1 cache knowledge remains faster and more valuable for problem-solving.
economy-jobs.zh: 即便有了先进的 AI，认知一级缓存中的知识在解决问题时仍然更快、更有价值。

economy-jobs.en: Writing and interpersonal communication are fundamental skills that models still lack, so doing them yourself matters.
economy-jobs.zh: 写作和人际沟通是模型仍欠缺的基本技能，因此亲自去做很重要。

economy-jobs.en: In the AI era, startups should consider more ambitious and divergent starting points rather than narrow niches.
economy-jobs.zh: 在 AI 时代，初创公司应考虑更宏大、更发散的起点，而不是狭窄的利基市场。

economy-jobs.en: Startups should target problems where frontier models currently fail almost completely, not where they partly work.
economy-jobs.zh: 创业公司应瞄准前沿模型目前几乎完全失败的问题，而不是部分能解决的问题。

economy-jobs.en: The scarce skill won't be coding but taste: choosing which problems to direct hundreds of agents to solve.
economy-jobs.zh: 稀缺技能不再是编码，而是品味：选择让数百个智能体去解决哪些问题。

economy-jobs.en: Data was a dismissed business that skeptics now call critical; the same investors who passed now celebrate it.
economy-jobs.zh: 数据曾被当作不值得做的生意，如今怀疑者却称其至关重要；当初错过的投资人如今反过来吹捧它。

economy-jobs.en: Work will be optional; people will engage in activities like gardening for fulfillment.
economy-jobs.zh: 工作将成为可选项；人们会像园艺一样从事活动以获得满足感。

economy-jobs.en: Deflation will be the economic issue, not inflation, due to massive output increases.
economy-jobs.zh: 由于产出大幅增长，通缩将成为经济问题，而非通胀。

economy-jobs.en: Startups are more important than ever because AI enables ambitious projects; now is the best time to start one.
economy-jobs.zh: 由于 AI 使雄心勃勃的项目成为可能，创业公司比以往任何时候都更重要；现在是启动的最佳时机。

economy-jobs.en: Contrary to the fear that AI kills startups, Sam argues startups will become much more valuable and impactful.
economy-jobs.zh: 与 AI 扼杀创业公司的担忧相反，Sam 认为创业公司将变得更有价值和影响力。

economy-jobs.en: The belief that AI ends history or the economy is clearly wrong; it's a golden age for startups.
economy-jobs.zh: 认为 AI 将终结历史或经济的看法显然是错误的；这是创业公司的黄金时代。

economy-jobs.en: When anyone can build with AI, the bottleneck shifts to ideas and taste; grounded generalists who close feedback loops remain essential.
economy-jobs.zh: 当人人都能用 AI 构建时，瓶颈转向创意与品味；能闭环用户反馈的通用型人才依然不可替代。

economy-jobs.en: Productivity should be measured by progress toward goals and quality at-bats, not proxies like commits, story points, or tokens.
economy-jobs.zh: 衡量生产力应看目标进展和高质量的“打席”，而非提交数、故事点或 token 等代理指标。

economy-jobs.en: Instead of replacing people, AI enables everyone to become T-shaped—both broad generalist and deep specialist—so what you can accomplish becomes nearly limitless.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 不是替代人，而是让每个人都变成 T 型人才——既通又专——因此能做成的事几乎不受限制。

economy-jobs.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, leading to even more opportunity.
economy-jobs.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创作将基本解决，带来更多机会。

economy-jobs.en: Solving software creation creates a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
economy-jobs.zh: 解决软件创造问题会带来千倍机会，而非更少。

economy-jobs.en: The pace of change creates opportunity; founders should not overly worry about frontier labs.
economy-jobs.zh: 变化的速度创造机会；创始人不应过度担忧前沿实验室。

economy-jobs.en: Coding is being solved for many tasks; the real value moves to product sense and business skills.
economy-jobs.zh: 编程对许多任务正被解决；真正的价值转向产品直觉和商业技能。

economy-jobs.en: Maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha.
economy-jobs.zh: 最大化令牌消耗就是活在未来并获取超额收益。

economy-jobs.en: Automation eliminates tasks, not jobs, leading to employment growth.
economy-jobs.zh: 自动化消灭的是任务而非工作，反而带来就业增长。

economy-jobs.en: AI creates jobs, not destroys them, as seen in radiology and software engineering.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 创造而非摧毁就业，放射学和软件工程领域即是证明。

economy-jobs.en: Simple coding will be automated, but hard science and systems thinking will never be obsolete.
economy-jobs.zh: 简单编码将自动化，但硬科学和系统思维永不淘汰。

economy-jobs.en: AI investments are redefining every part of Alphabet's business, driving 24% revenue growth.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 投资正在重新定义 Alphabet 业务的每个部分，推动收入增长 24%。

economy-jobs.en: Google Cloud revenue grew 82% with backlog reaching $514 billion, driven by enterprise AI demand.
economy-jobs.zh: Google Cloud 收入增长 82%，积压订单达 5140 亿美元，受企业 AI 需求驱动。

economy-jobs.en: TPU system sales to customer data centers expand TAM but revenue recognition is back-end loaded to 2027.
economy-jobs.zh: 向客户数据中心销售 TPU 系统扩大了总可寻址市场，但收入确认集中在 2027 年。

economy-jobs.en: Junior designers may lose mentorship opportunities as AI replaces their tasks.
economy-jobs.zh: 初级设计师可能失去指导机会，因为 AI 取代了他们的任务。

economy-jobs.en: Enterprise AI adoption requires behavioral change and willingness to experiment.
economy-jobs.zh: 企业 AI 采用需要行为改变和实验意愿。

economy-jobs.en: Being two to three years early is the same as being wrong.
economy-jobs.zh: 早两三年和做错是一样的。

economy-jobs.en: Customer obsession is an input metric; output is creating obsessed customers.
economy-jobs.zh: 客户痴迷是输入指标；输出是创造痴迷的客户。

economy-jobs.en: Academic labs are struggling to keep pace; industry has major advantages in resources and data generation.
economy-jobs.zh: 学术实验室难以跟上步伐；工业界在资源和数据生成方面具有主要优势。

economy-jobs.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI, as it addresses the global economy's physical sectors.
economy-jobs.zh: 物理 AI 将比数字 AI 产生更大的经济影响，因为它涉及全球经济的实体部门。

economy-jobs.en: Automotive is only 30% of our business and will shrink further; the real growth is in mining, agriculture, and defense.
economy-jobs.zh: 汽车业务仅占我们业务的 30%，未来还会缩小；真正的增长在于采矿、农业和国防。

economy-jobs.en: Truck driving is a terrible job, and the shortage of drivers is a market signal, not a problem to be solved by keeping humans.
economy-jobs.zh: 卡车司机是一份糟糕的工作，司机短缺是市场信号，而不是通过保留人类来解决的问题。

economy-jobs.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth.
economy-jobs.zh: Token 成本将在三年内下降 10 倍，推动 100 倍的使用量增长。

economy-jobs.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate concepts due to AI scaling costs.
economy-jobs.zh: 由于 AI 扩展成本，产品市场契合与持久业务现在是两个不同的概念。

economy-jobs.en: Companies must optimize for growth first, then margins, to avoid scaling into bankruptcy.
economy-jobs.zh: 公司必须优先优化增长，然后才是利润率，以避免规模扩张导致破产。

economy-jobs.en: AI blurs roles but functional expertise remains critical for quality and accountability.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 模糊了角色边界，但职能专长对质量和问责仍至关重要。

economy-jobs.en: AI fluency is a non-negotiable expectation across all roles and levels.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 素养是所有角色和级别不可妥协的期望。

economy-jobs.en: Humans remain accountable for AI outputs; craft mastery and judgment are scarce.
economy-jobs.zh: 人类仍需对 AI 输出负责；工艺掌握和判断力依然稀缺。

economy-jobs.en: AI diagnostics now surpass human doctors; free access via platforms like Meta democratizes healthcare.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 诊断现已超越人类医生；通过 Meta 等平台免费访问使医疗民主化。

economy-jobs.en: The number of accountants has risen throughout the 20th century despite automation, suggesting AI may not eliminate jobs as feared.
economy-jobs.zh: 尽管自动化，20 世纪会计师数量仍在增加，这表明 AI 可能不会像人们担心的那样消除就业。

economy-jobs.en: Jeff Hinton's warning about radiologists was flawed because he misunderstood the job; AI won't replace professionals but change their tasks.
economy-jobs.zh: 杰夫·辛顿关于放射科医生的警告有缺陷，因为他误解了这份工作；AI 不会取代专业人士，而是改变他们的任务。

economy-jobs.en: The 'jagged edge' of AI capabilities means it can do some complex tasks but fails at simple ones, making predictions of job impact unreliable.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 能力的“锯齿状边缘”意味着它能完成一些复杂任务，但在简单任务上失败，这使得对就业影响的预测不可靠。

economy-jobs.en: Building in AI era requires embracing exploration and uncertainty; it's no longer the safe path.
economy-jobs.zh: 在 AI 时代创业需要拥抱探索和不确定性；这不再是安全路径。

economy-jobs.en: Evals are not for zero-to-one innovation; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals initially.
economy-jobs.zh: 评估不适用于从零到一的创新；创始人应快速迭代而非初期大量评估。

economy-jobs.en: Data centers are net positive for local communities, bringing jobs, tax revenue, and grid upgrades.
economy-jobs.zh: 数据中心对当地社区净正面，带来就业、税收和电网升级。

economy-jobs.en: AI will not cause mass unemployment; jobs will transform instead of vanish.
economy-jobs.zh: 人工智能不会导致大规模失业；工作将转型而非消失。

economy-jobs.en: UK has strong research base but must improve investment environment and energy costs.
economy-jobs.zh: 英国拥有强大的研究基础，但必须改善投资环境和能源成本。

economy-jobs.en: Energy cost directly maps to AI intelligence cost; UK must fix energy to compete.
economy-jobs.zh: 能源成本直接映射到人工智能智能成本；英国必须解决能源问题以保持竞争力。

economy-jobs.en: People are not that busy; automating tasks like trip planning removes joy.
economy-jobs.zh: 人们并没有那么忙；自动化旅行规划等任务会剥夺乐趣。

economy-jobs.en: AI can revolutionize healthcare, potentially eradicating cancer and reducing car accidents.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 可以革新医疗，有望根除癌症并减少车祸。

economy-jobs.en: Personalized AI tutors could transform education, a 2000-year-old problem.
economy-jobs.zh: 个性化 AI 导师可以改变教育，这是一个存在了两千年的问题。

economy-jobs.en: Jobs will be automated entirely; work becomes a political choice.
economy-jobs.zh: 工作将被完全自动化；工作成为政治选择。

economy-jobs.en: Mass unemployment won't happen until after superintelligence is achieved.
economy-jobs.zh: 大规模失业要到超级智能实现后才会发生。

economy-jobs.en: Citizens dividend of $25k/year per person could offset job loss.
economy-jobs.zh: 每人每年 2.5 万美元的公民红利可抵消失业影响。

economy-jobs.en: AI bifurcates tech workforce: half feel amplified, half destabilized or diminished.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 导致科技劳动力分化：一半人感到能力增强，另一半感到不稳定或被削弱。

economy-jobs.en: Burnout surged from 44.7% to 54.7%, optimism dropped from 54.8% to 48.7% in one year.
economy-jobs.zh: 一年内倦怠率从 44.7%升至 54.7%，乐观度从 54.8%降至 48.7%。

economy-jobs.en: Top fear is expectation to do more for same pay, not losing job to AI.
economy-jobs.zh: 首要恐惧是期望以相同薪酬做更多工作，而非被 AI 取代。

economy-jobs.en: AI ROI is a throughput problem; providing right context is key.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 投资回报率是吞吐量问题；提供正确上下文是关键。

economy-jobs.en: Composite roles combining engineering, product, and design will become common.
economy-jobs.zh: 结合工程、产品和设计的复合角色将变得普遍。

economy-jobs.en: Consumption-based pricing can break enterprise bundling strategies like Microsoft's.
economy-jobs.zh: 基于消费的定价可以打破微软等企业的捆绑策略。

economy-jobs.en: Token spend caps may become necessary as engineer costs equal salary; currently no limits.
economy-jobs.zh: 随着工程师成本等于薪资，Token 支出上限可能变得必要；目前没有限制。

economy-jobs.en: The massive capex in AI data centers is overdone and will lead to a stock market crash.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 数据中心的大规模资本支出过度，将导致股市崩盘。

economy-jobs.en: Investing billions in GPUs now is foolish; waiting 5 years yields 10x cheaper compute.
economy-jobs.zh: 现在投资数十亿美元购买 GPU 是愚蠢的；等 5 年算力便宜 10 倍。

economy-jobs.en: Fragrance design is a viable first business for olfactory AI, funding further research and data collection.
economy-jobs.zh: 香氛设计是嗅觉 AI 可行的首个业务，为后续研究和数据收集提供资金。

economy-jobs.en: Medical diagnostics like cancer detection via smell are not good businesses due to regulatory and data challenges.
economy-jobs.zh: 通过气味进行癌症检测等医疗诊断并非好生意，因监管和数据挑战。

economy-jobs.en: Autonomous delivery is becoming cheaper than human delivery.
economy-jobs.zh: 自主配送正变得比人工配送更便宜。

economy-jobs.en: Starting a robotics company was the dumbest thing you could do, but it paid off.
economy-jobs.zh: 创办机器人公司是最愚蠢的事情，但最终成功了。

economy-jobs.en: Hardware companies will be the most impactful, despite being hard to fund.
economy-jobs.zh: 硬件公司将成为最具影响力的公司，尽管融资困难。

economy-jobs.en: Agency and curiosity are the only skills that matter in the age of AI.
economy-jobs.zh: 在 AI 时代，主动性和好奇心是唯一重要的技能。

economy-jobs.en: Liquid AI targets device-native foundation models for edge devices, a massive market beyond data centers.
economy-jobs.zh: Liquid AI 瞄准边缘设备的设备原生基础模型，这是一个超越数据中心的大市场。

economy-jobs.en: Hardware makers should invest in an intelligence layer (like Nvidia's NeMo) to differentiate, not just optimize kernels.
economy-jobs.zh: 硬件制造商应投资智能层（如英伟达的 NeMo）以差异化，而不仅仅是优化内核。

economy-jobs.en: The speed of AI-driven job displacement is the real problem, not the displacement itself.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 导致就业替代的速度才是真正的问题，而非替代本身。

economy-jobs.en: Spending $100k/year on tokens lets you live like a normal citizen in 2028.
economy-jobs.zh: 每年花费 10 万美元在 token 上，就能像 2028 年的普通公民一样生活。

economy-jobs.en: Human desire is irreplaceable; AI users become more productive, not displaced.
economy-jobs.zh: 人类欲望不可替代；使用 AI 的人效率更高，而非被取代。

economy-jobs.en: Deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech, not just military size.
economy-jobs.zh: 威慑现在取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而不仅仅是军事规模。

economy-jobs.en: Startups must go international earlier due to rapid product and technology spread.
economy-jobs.zh: 由于产品和技术的快速传播，初创公司必须更早地走向国际化。

economy-jobs.en: Recreating Silicon Valley requires talent, business-friendly laws, and a culture that rewards entrepreneurial risk.
economy-jobs.zh: 复制硅谷需要人才、有利于商业的法律以及奖励创业风险的文化。

economy-jobs.en: Claude Tag increases productivity significantly, with 65% of PRs written by it in some orgs.
economy-jobs.zh: Claude Tag 显著提升生产力，在某些组织中 65% 的 PR 由其编写。

economy-jobs.en: Claude Tag is being adopted rapidly across teams due to visible benefits.
economy-jobs.zh: 由于可见的效益，Claude Tag 在各团队中被迅速采用。

economy-jobs.en: Consumer apps are currently uninvestable due to distribution challenges and lack of viral platforms.
economy-jobs.zh: 由于分发挑战和缺乏病毒式平台，消费者应用目前不可投资。

economy-jobs.en: Enterprise and prosumer markets offer better opportunities than consumer apps right now.
economy-jobs.zh: 企业级和产消者市场目前比消费者应用提供更好的机会。

economy-jobs.en: AI will replace many jobs, but humans will find new purposes in curiosity and relationships.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将取代许多工作，但人类会在好奇心和人际关系中找到新目标。

economy-jobs.en: AI in healthcare will become standard, empowering patients and improving outcomes.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 在医疗领域的应用将成为常态，赋能患者并改善疗效。

economy-jobs.en: Price cuts for intelligence will continue, but frontier models will always command premium.
economy-jobs.zh: 智能的价格将持续下降，但前沿模型始终享有溢价。

economy-jobs.en: Teaching and relational roles in math will remain stable even with advanced AI.
economy-jobs.zh: 即使有先进的 AI，数学中的教学和关系角色仍将保持稳定。

economy-jobs.en: AI solving millennium problems may not directly translate to economic value.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 解决千禧年问题可能不会直接转化为经济价值。

economy-jobs.en: Inference will become one of the largest markets globally, surpassing oil and contributing significant GDP share.
economy-jobs.zh: 推理将成为全球最大市场之一，超越石油，贡献显著的 GDP 份额。

economy-jobs.en: AI has clear ROI; denial of model progress is a common misconception despite continuous capability improvements.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 有明确回报；否认模型进步是常见误解，尽管能力持续提升。

economy-jobs.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks.
economy-jobs.zh: 实现不再昂贵；策展和品味成为新的瓶颈。

economy-jobs.en: Product teams must shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration with taste-driven curation.
economy-jobs.zh: 产品团队必须从自上而下的规划转向由品味驱动的自下而上探索。

economy-jobs.en: The design process is not dead but transformed: prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
economy-jobs.zh: 设计流程并未消亡而是转型：原型和生产代码现在充当设计产物。

economy-jobs.en: AI tools can erode human understanding and create dependency, leading to a 'dumber' population.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 工具会侵蚀人类理解并产生依赖，导致人类“变笨”。

economy-jobs.en: AI will accelerate scientific advances, especially in biology and medicine.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将加速科学进步，尤其是在生物学和医学领域。

economy-jobs.en: More jobs will exist if individual productivity outpaces corporate automation.
economy-jobs.zh: 如果个人生产力超过企业自动化，就业岗位会更多。

economy-jobs.en: Consumer AI opportunity is greatest now despite being uninvestable, with potential for new internet treasures.
economy-jobs.zh: 尽管消费者 AI 目前不可投资，但机会空前巨大，有望诞生新的互联网宝藏。

economy-jobs.en: Token efficiency is a key lever for improving model economics; outcome-based pricing could be a future direction.
economy-jobs.zh: Token 效率是改善模型经济性的关键杠杆；基于结果的定价可能是未来的方向。

economy-jobs.en: Consumer AI breakout products are rare due to consolidation and data gravity; making something people want remains hard.
economy-jobs.zh: 由于市场整合和数据引力，消费者 AI 突破性产品很少见；创造人们想要的东西仍然困难。

economy-jobs.en: The chart showing skyrocketing app releases but declining usage suggests that coding faster doesn't guarantee product success.
economy-jobs.zh: 图表显示应用发布量飙升但使用量下降，表明编码更快并不保证产品成功。

economy-jobs.en: The benefits of AI should be shared globally, including compensation for the use of humanity's cultural heritage.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 的收益应全球共享，包括对使用人类文化遗产的补偿。

economy-jobs.en: AI is a tool; the human must bring the soul and heart to the output.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 是工具，人类必须为输出注入灵魂和心意。

economy-jobs.en: Taste equals care and intentionality, developed through hard work and passion.
economy-jobs.zh: 品味等同于用心和刻意，通过努力和热情培养。

economy-jobs.en: Designers should create systems, not just screens, using AI for precision and control.
economy-jobs.zh: 设计师应创建系统而非仅屏幕，利用 AI 实现精确和控制。

economy-jobs.en: Training per-team or per-user models can reduce inference costs by orders of magnitude compared to RAG.
economy-jobs.zh: 为每个团队或用户训练模型，相比 RAG 可将推理成本降低几个数量级。

economy-jobs.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models for every individual or team.
economy-jobs.zh: 未来不是一个巨大的前沿模型，而是为每个个人或团队定制的众多模型。

economy-jobs.en: Future agentic economies will have specialists and generalists, not just one superintelligent AGI.
economy-jobs.zh: 未来的智能体经济将包含专才和通才，而非单一的超级智能 AGI。

economy-jobs.en: The first major public prompt injection breach will likely drive widespread adoption of AI insurance.
economy-jobs.zh: 第一次重大的公开提示注入漏洞可能会推动 AI 保险的广泛采用。

economy-jobs.en: Growing next-gen engineers may require apprenticeship models, not traditional paths.
economy-jobs.zh: 培养下一代工程师可能需要学徒模式，而非传统路径。

economy-jobs.en: AI companies are not too big to fail; a cascading failure could trigger government bailout implicitly.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 公司并非大到不能倒；级联失败可能隐含触发政府救助。

economy-jobs.en: Equity sharing with government is bad due to principal-agent problems; direct citizen ownership is better.
economy-jobs.zh: 与政府股权共享因委托代理问题而糟糕；直接公民持股更好。

economy-jobs.en: Education must integrate AI to empower students and teachers, not ban it.
economy-jobs.zh: 教育必须整合 AI 来赋能学生和教师，而不是禁止它。

economy-jobs.en: The cost of intelligence will not go to zero; human intelligence is deep and nuanced.
economy-jobs.zh: 智能的成本不会降到零；人类智能是深刻而微妙的。

economy-jobs.en: The future of work will see a barbell effect: top specialists and high-agency generalists.
economy-jobs.zh: 未来的工作将出现杠铃效应：顶尖专家和高能动性的通才。

economy-jobs.en: Doomsaying about jobpocalypse is overblown; AI will not cause mass unemployment.
economy-jobs.zh: 关于工作末日的悲观论调被夸大；AI 不会导致大规模失业。

economy-jobs.en: AI will cause significant job disruption, but the pie expands; adaptation is key.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将导致重大就业颠覆，但蛋糕在扩大；适应是关键。

economy-jobs.en: AI is a general-purpose technology that will affect everything, requiring us to rethink work and education.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 是一种通用技术，将影响一切，需要我们重新思考工作和教育。

economy-jobs.en: Experience and expertise are crucial for using AI effectively; juniors often misuse it due to lack of judgment.
economy-jobs.zh: 经验和专业知识对于有效使用 AI 至关重要；初级人员常因缺乏判断力而误用。

economy-jobs.en: The talent pipeline is broken because juniors rely on AI instead of learning through grunt work.
economy-jobs.zh: 人才管道被打破，因为初级人员依赖 AI 而不是通过基础工作学习。

economy-jobs.en: Models can pass OpenAI research interviews, changing hiring.
economy-jobs.zh: 模型能通过 OpenAI 研究面试，改变了招聘方式。

economy-jobs.en: The most important metric in AI is token value per user, maximizing valuable output tokens.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 中最重要的指标是每个用户的 Token 价值，最大化有价值的输出 Token。

economy-jobs.en: Companies should be built with far fewer people, leveraging AI agents for efficiency.
economy-jobs.zh: 公司应该用更少的人来构建，利用 AI 智能体提高效率。

economy-jobs.en: Apple's iPod bet happened when the company was near collapse; innovation came from going off script rather than repeating Mac-versus-PC.
economy-jobs.zh: 苹果推出 iPod 是一场生死赌注，创新来自打破既有剧本，而不是重复 Mac 对 PC 的僵局。

economy-jobs.en: Stay beginner means fighting habituation: fix small frictions users have learned to ignore, so products truly delight them.
economy-jobs.zh: 保持初学者心态就是对抗习惯化：修复用户已经学会忽略的小摩擦，让产品真正带来惊喜。

economy-jobs.en: Great products are painkillers not vitamins; the iPhone solved the real pain of carrying separate phone, computer, and music player.
economy-jobs.zh: 好产品是止痛药而非维生素；iPhone 解决了必须同时携带手机、电脑和音乐播放器的真实痛点。

economy-jobs.en: AI will eliminate many white-collar jobs, requiring society to find new roles and policies like UBI.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将淘汰许多白领工作，社会需要寻找新角色并制定政策，如全民基本收入。

economy-jobs.en: AI could cause high GDP growth alongside high unemployment and inequality, a rare combination.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 可能导致高 GDP 增长伴随高失业和不平等，这是一种罕见的组合。

economy-jobs.en: Tasks will be automated, not entire jobs; efficiency often creates more work.
economy-jobs.zh: 任务会被自动化，而非整个工作；效率往往创造更多工作。

economy-jobs.en: White-collar tasks will be fully automated by AI in 12-18 months, not jobs.
economy-jobs.zh: 白领任务将在 12-18 个月内被 AI 完全自动化，而非工作岗位。

economy-jobs.en: AI enables more new businesses and entrepreneurship, offsetting job displacement concerns.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 催生了更多新企业和创业机会，抵消了就业替代的担忧。

economy-jobs.en: AI is not a technology; it's the future of the firm.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来。

economy-jobs.en: Every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
economy-jobs.zh: 每个企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器，以复合其代币资本。

economy-jobs.en: CEOs must deeply understand token capital, not just delegate AI to IT.
economy-jobs.zh: CEO 必须深入理解代币资本，而不仅仅是把 AI 交给 IT 部门。

economy-jobs.en: Human mathematicians' value will shift to asking right questions and research taste.
economy-jobs.zh: 人类数学家的价值将转向提出正确问题和研究品味。

economy-jobs.en: AI is a tool to empower researchers, not replace them, accelerating science.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 是赋能研究者的工具，而非替代他们，加速科学进步。

economy-jobs.en: AI will cause massive unemployment and societal disruption.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将导致大规模失业和社会动荡。

economy-jobs.en: Radiologist job loss prediction was wrong due to elastic healthcare demand and broader roles.
economy-jobs.zh: 放射科医生失业的预测错误，因为医疗需求弹性大且角色更广泛。

economy-jobs.en: AI doctors are judged more empathetic than human doctors due to broader data.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 医生因数据更广而被认为比人类医生更有同理心。

economy-jobs.en: The market for formal verification extends beyond niche domains to all AI-generated code.
economy-jobs.zh: 形式验证的市场从利基领域扩展到所有 AI 生成的代码。

economy-jobs.en: Enterprise AI adoption requires strong ROI; spending must yield at least 2x return to avoid collapse.
economy-jobs.zh: 企业采用 AI 需要强劲的投资回报率；支出必须产生至少两倍回报，否则整个体系可能崩溃。

economy-jobs.en: Enterprise AI adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
economy-jobs.zh: 企业采用 AI 的瓶颈在于组织变革，而非模型智能。

economy-jobs.en: Scientific progress in medicine has slowed due to low-hanging fruit depletion and 'better than the Beatles' problem.
economy-jobs.zh: 医学科学进展因低垂果实耗尽和‘比披头士更好’问题而放缓。

economy-jobs.en: Relaxing FDA efficacy requirements to only safety could accelerate drug development via real-world evidence.
economy-jobs.zh: 放松 FDA 疗效要求至仅需安全性，可通过真实世界证据加速药物开发。

economy-jobs.en: Peptides and biohacking carry unknown risks; placebo effects make self-experimentation unreliable.
economy-jobs.zh: 肽类和生物黑客存在未知风险；安慰剂效应使自我实验不可靠。

economy-jobs.en: Companies with unique data (e.g., pharma) will not share it with model makers, preferring separate inference providers.
economy-jobs.zh: 拥有独特数据（如制药）的公司不会与模型制造商共享数据，更倾向于独立的推理提供商。

economy-jobs.en: SaaS is not dying; agents increase SaaS users, and companies should buy SaaS stocks.
economy-jobs.zh: SaaS 不会消亡；智能体会增加 SaaS 用户，公司应该买入 SaaS 股票。

economy-jobs.en: PMs and full-stack designers will thrive because they can ship products directly using AI tools.
economy-jobs.zh: 产品经理和全栈设计师将蓬勃发展，因为他们可以直接使用 AI 工具交付产品。

economy-jobs.en: The AI job apocalypse is not happening; humans are still needed to manage agents and create new value.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 失业末日不会发生；人类仍然需要管理智能体并创造新价值。

economy-jobs.en: Selling compute to Anthropic is a strategic choice to reinvest revenue, not a sign of doubt.
economy-jobs.zh: 向 Anthropic 出售算力是战略性选择以再投资收入，并非怀疑的信号。

economy-jobs.en: Data markets need incentive structures to respect privacy and reward contributors.
economy-jobs.zh: 数据市场需要激励结构来尊重隐私并奖励贡献者。

economy-jobs.en: Building systems without understanding them is fine, but requires economic safeguards.
economy-jobs.zh: 构建不理解系统的做法没问题，但需要经济上的保障措施。

economy-jobs.en: The risk of AI extinction is overblown; real dangers are labor and capital issues.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 灭绝风险被夸大；真正的危险是劳动力和资本问题。

economy-jobs.en: Managers do more vibe coding than junior and mid-level designers, suggesting juniors may be excluded from AI processes.
economy-jobs.zh: 管理者比初级和中级设计师更多使用 vibe coding，暗示初级设计师可能被排除在 AI 流程外。

economy-jobs.en: Memory prices may double due to AI demand, causing supply chain shocks for consumer hardware.
economy-jobs.zh: 内存价格可能因 AI 需求翻倍，给消费硬件带来供应链冲击。

economy-jobs.en: A coalition of countries could leapfrog companies by funding safe, capable AI built on this paradigm.
economy-jobs.zh: 国家联盟可通过资助基于此范式的安全、强大 AI 来超越公司。

economy-jobs.en: You can outsource your thinking, but you can't outsource your understanding—that remains the human bottleneck.
economy-jobs.zh: 你可以外包思考，但无法外包理解——这仍然是人类的瓶颈。

economy-jobs.en: Everything is automatable eventually; verifiability determines what is easy or hard to automate now.
economy-jobs.zh: 一切最终都可自动化；可验证性决定了当前自动化的难易程度。

economy-jobs.en: Hiring for AI-native engineers should involve large projects and adversarial testing, not puzzles.
economy-jobs.zh: 招聘 AI 原生工程师应通过大型项目和对抗性测试，而非解谜题。

economy-jobs.en: AI tools amplify existing spikes and can help designers go deeper, but judgment and taste remain essential.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 工具能放大既有专长、帮助设计师更深入，但判断力与品味仍然不可或缺。

economy-jobs.en: Skipping thinking and letting AI write strategy or PRDs produces garbage; go slow to go fast.
economy-jobs.zh: 跳过思考、让 AI 写战略或 PRD 只会产出垃圾；先慢后快。

economy-jobs.en: A designer can build entire front ends and review code now—roles and lines are blurring, and that's exciting.
economy-jobs.zh: 设计师现在也能独立搭建前端并审阅代码——角色和边界正在模糊，这令人兴奋。

economy-jobs.en: Distribution is increasingly valuable as AI makes software creation easier.
economy-jobs.zh: 随着 AI 使软件创建更容易，分发变得越来越有价值。

economy-jobs.en: Waymo's value is not just price; the ability to work during rides is a key advantage.
economy-jobs.zh: Waymo 的价值不仅仅是价格；乘车时工作的能力是一个关键优势。

economy-jobs.en: OpenAI's business model is simple: rent compute and resell it with positive margin, benefiting from Jevons paradox.
economy-jobs.zh: OpenAI 的商业模式很简单：租用算力并以正利润率转售，受益于杰文斯悖论。

economy-jobs.en: The AI coding market is massive, with Anthropic and OpenAI each generating around $2 billion ARR from coding products.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 编码市场巨大，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 各自从编码产品中产生约 20 亿美元的年经常性收入。

economy-jobs.en: Traditional SaaS is being squeezed; custom AI-native solutions can replace expensive software at a fraction of cost.
economy-jobs.zh: 传统 SaaS 正受到挤压；定制 AI 原生解决方案可以以一小部分成本取代昂贵的软件。

economy-jobs.en: The best designers are often independent, not full-time employees.
economy-jobs.zh: 最优秀的设计师往往是独立工作者，而非全职员工。

economy-jobs.en: AI integration into the economy can restore growth and strengthen liberal democracies.
economy-jobs.zh: 将 AI 融入经济可以恢复增长并加强自由民主制度。

economy-jobs.en: AI is more likely to save the world than destroy it, by restoring economic growth.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 更可能通过恢复经济增长来拯救世界，而非毁灭它。

economy-jobs.en: Xenophobia and conflict stem from economic stagnation, not inherent human nature.
economy-jobs.zh: 仇外心理和冲突源于经济停滞，而非人性固有缺陷。

economy-jobs.en: The future is mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors, not expensive retrofits.
economy-jobs.zh: 未来是内置传感器的量产车，而非昂贵的改装车。

economy-jobs.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term.
economy-jobs.zh: 短期内，消费级车辆将远超无人驾驶出租车的规模。

economy-jobs.en: Autonomous driving can reduce accidents to near zero by eliminating human error.
economy-jobs.zh: 自动驾驶通过消除人为错误，可将事故率降至接近零。

economy-jobs.en: AI's real impact is not speed or efficiency—it lets designers reach adjacent fields that were previously out of reach.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 真正的影響不是速度或效率，而是让设计师能进入以前够不到的邻近领域。

economy-jobs.en: AI won't replace jobs; human taste and craft remain critical for final output.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 不会取代工作；人类的品味和工艺对最终输出仍然至关重要。

economy-jobs.en: Despite talk of role merging, we see more merging of responsibilities, not roles.
economy-jobs.zh: 尽管谈论角色融合，我们看到更多的是职责融合而非角色融合。

economy-jobs.en: Current models are already economically transformative, not just research curiosities.
economy-jobs.zh: 当前模型已具有经济变革性，而不仅是研究新奇事物。

economy-jobs.en: The biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
economy-jobs.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致的权力集中。

economy-jobs.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 加速原型开发，价值从执行转向创意。

economy-jobs.en: Writing code is now cheap; the bottleneck shifts to ideation, prototyping, testing, and quality assurance.
economy-jobs.zh: 编写代码现在成本低廉；瓶颈转移到构思、原型设计、测试和质量保证。

economy-jobs.en: AI amplifies experienced engineers but threatens mid-career professionals who lack deep expertise to leverage agents.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 放大资深工程师的能力，但威胁到缺乏深厚专业知识来利用智能体的中层职业人士。

economy-jobs.en: AI pilled people work harder than ever; productivity gains lead to more ambition, not leisure.
economy-jobs.zh: 沉迷 AI 的人比以往更努力；生产力提升带来更多雄心，而非闲暇。

economy-jobs.en: AI tools can be the best teacher, but using them to avoid struggle undermines learning.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 工具可以成为最好的老师，但用它来逃避困难会破坏学习。

economy-jobs.en: Default policies disallowing AI on homework are unenforceable and put students in ethical dilemmas.
economy-jobs.zh: 默认禁止在作业中使用 AI 的政策无法执行，并将学生置于道德困境。

economy-jobs.en: AI-generated text may homogenize writing styles, but could also free us to focus on deeper thinking.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 生成的文本可能使写作风格同质化，但也可能让我们专注于更深层的思考。

economy-jobs.en: AI should be directed toward public good like medicine and climate, not just profit-driven automation.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 应导向医学和气候等公共利益，而非仅追求利润驱动的自动化。

economy-jobs.en: AI tools will significantly impact junior employees, and society should discuss labor market changes.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 工具将显著影响初级员工，社会应讨论劳动力市场的变化。

economy-jobs.en: Junior engineers can accelerate learning via simulated projects, compressing years of experience into weeks.
economy-jobs.zh: 初级工程师可以通过模拟项目加速学习，将数年经验压缩到几周内。

economy-jobs.en: Curiosity is the most important skill in the AI era to ask good questions.
economy-jobs.zh: 好奇心是 AI 时代最重要的技能，以便提出好问题。

economy-jobs.en: Writing remains valuable because it forces clear thinking, even as AI writes well.
economy-jobs.zh: 写作仍然有价值，因为它迫使清晰思考，即使 AI 写得很好。

economy-jobs.en: Communication skills, not coding, will be critical for future workforce with AI.
economy-jobs.zh: 沟通技能而非编程，将是未来 AI 时代劳动力的关键。

economy-jobs.en: Memory prices are surging due to AI demand, causing consumer electronics to become more expensive.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 需求导致内存价格飙升，消费电子产品变得更贵。

economy-jobs.en: Musk's claims about Tesla autonomy are consistently wrong for 8 years.
economy-jobs.zh: 马斯克关于特斯拉自动驾驶的说法连续 8 年错误。

economy-jobs.en: AI tool access is widening the gap between startups and legacy enterprises, creating a new digital divide.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 工具的可及性拉大了初创公司和传统企业之间的差距，制造了新的数字鸿沟。

economy-jobs.en: Most software is mediocre and users don't care about pixels, so designers should focus on revenue impact.
economy-jobs.zh: 大多数软件平庸，用户并不在意像素，因此设计师应聚焦于营收影响。

economy-jobs.en: AI enables division of labor in mathematics, allowing specialization like other sciences.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 使数学中的劳动分工成为可能，像其他科学一样实现专业化。

economy-jobs.en: Education must shift from homework to project-based assessment and teach verification skills.
economy-jobs.zh: 教育必须从作业转向基于项目的评估，并教授验证技能。

economy-jobs.en: Weak students use AI more, while strong students avoid it to prevent skill atrophy.
economy-jobs.zh: 弱学生更多使用 AI，而强学生为避免技能退化而回避它。

economy-jobs.en: Language models can revolutionize education in local languages across Africa.
economy-jobs.zh: 语言模型可以彻底改变非洲各地本地语言的教育。

economy-jobs.en: AI fluency is now a baseline for designers; those not building with AI will struggle to get jobs.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 素养现已成为设计师的基线；不利用 AI 构建的人将难以找到工作。

economy-jobs.en: Over-reliance on AI coding erodes human competence and organizational knowledge over time.
economy-jobs.zh: 过度依赖 AI 编码会逐渐侵蚀人类能力和组织知识。

economy-jobs.en: AI coding tools create an illusion of control similar to slot machines, not genuine productivity.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 编码工具制造类似老虎机的控制幻觉，而非真正的生产力。

economy-jobs.en: Current AI-generated code is often unmaintainable and no one understands it fully.
economy-jobs.zh: 当前 AI 生成的代码常常不可维护，且无人完全理解。

economy-jobs.en: AI will not replace most jobs but will automate parts; AI users replace non-users.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 不会取代大多数工作，但会自动化部分；使用 AI 的人将取代不使用的人。

economy-jobs.en: Designers now spend 30-40% of time mocking up, down from 60-70%.
economy-jobs.zh: 设计师现在花 30-40%的时间做原型，低于之前的 60-70%。

economy-jobs.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years.
economy-jobs.zh: 设计愿景现在展望 3-6 个月，而非 2-5 年。

economy-jobs.en: Design managers should return to IC to understand changing processes.
economy-jobs.zh: 设计管理者应回归个人贡献者角色以理解变化中的流程。

economy-jobs.en: Humans will need more education, not less, as AI advances.
economy-jobs.zh: 随着 AI 进步，人类需要更多教育，而非更少。

economy-jobs.en: AI will amplify human intelligence, similar to the printing press or internet.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将增强人类智能，类似于印刷术或互联网。

economy-jobs.en: Data is the new oil; governments should treat healthcare and national security data as strategic assets.
economy-jobs.zh: 数据是新的石油；政府应将医疗和国家安全数据视为战略资产。

economy-jobs.en: The one-person billion-dollar startup will create a golden age of B2B SaaS.
economy-jobs.zh: 单人十亿美元初创企业将开启 B2B SaaS 的黄金时代。

economy-jobs.en: Business process automation is a massive, underrated AI opportunity.
economy-jobs.zh: 业务流程自动化是一个巨大且被低估的 AI 机会。

economy-jobs.en: Many AI deployments have negative ROI due to lack of bottom-up adoption.
economy-jobs.zh: 许多 AI 部署因缺乏自下而上的采用而 ROI 为负。

economy-jobs.en: Professional-grade AGI will automate most white-collar tasks within 12-18 months.
economy-jobs.zh: 专业级 AGI 将在 12-18 个月内自动化大多数白领工作。

economy-jobs.en: Top mathematicians have a bigger gap to average academics than undergrads to average academics.
economy-jobs.zh: 顶尖数学家与普通学者之间的差距大于本科生与普通学者之间的差距。

economy-jobs.en: The future of work involves managing teams of AI agents, operating at higher levels of abstraction.
economy-jobs.zh: 未来的工作涉及管理 AI 智能体团队，在更高的抽象层次上操作。

economy-jobs.en: The biggest societal risk from AI is not extinction but a dystopian retreat into virtual worlds.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 最大的社会风险不是灭绝，而是退入虚拟世界的反乌托邦。

economy-jobs.en: Professionals who cannot use AI tools sophisticatedly are becoming dramatically less productive and increasingly unhirable.
economy-jobs.zh: 无法熟练使用 AI 工具的专业人士正变得效率极低，且越来越难以被雇佣。

economy-jobs.en: Enterprise value comes from solving specific problems with customized models, not just general intelligence.
economy-jobs.zh: 企业价值来自用定制模型解决具体问题，而非通用智能。

economy-jobs.en: General-purpose robotics may be easier than self-driving due to lower reliability requirements.
economy-jobs.zh: 通用机器人可能比自动驾驶更容易，因为对可靠性的要求更低。

economy-jobs.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
economy-jobs.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 填补空白的通才最有价值。

economy-jobs.en: Hiring managers look for high-slope individuals with intrinsic drive and learning aptitude.
economy-jobs.zh: 招聘经理寻找高成长斜率、有内在驱动力和学习能力的人。

economy-jobs.en: Side projects can outweigh traditional experience if they demonstrate care and skill.
economy-jobs.zh: 如果展示出用心和技能，副项目可以超越传统经验。

economy-jobs.en: AGI will transform society and the economy; we need broad interdisciplinary thinking to navigate the transition.
economy-jobs.zh: AGI 将变革社会和经济；我们需要广泛的跨学科思考来应对转型。
