economy-jobs.en: Jobs that are purely cognitive and remote are most at risk; physical jobs like plumbing are safer in the short term.
economy-jobs.zh: 纯认知和远程工作风险最大；体力工作如管道工短期更安全。

economy-jobs.en: 2025 is the year of coding in the enterprise, with meaningful adoption starting.
economy-jobs.zh: 2025 年是企业级编程之年，有意义的采用已经开始。

economy-jobs.en: Science and drug discovery are underhyped AI use cases with huge potential.
economy-jobs.zh: 科学和药物发现是被低估的 AI 用例，潜力巨大。

economy-jobs.en: Cost reduction is critical to unlock massive untapped demand for AI.
economy-jobs.zh: 降低成本是释放大量未开发 AI 需求的关键。

economy-jobs.en: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, challenging the notion that better models cost more.
economy-jobs.zh: Opus 4.5 更便宜且更高效，挑战了更好模型成本更高的观念。

economy-jobs.en: Effort parameter allows achieving Opus-level intelligence at fraction of price, underhyped.
economy-jobs.zh: 努力参数允许以极低价格获得 Opus 级智能，被低估了。

economy-jobs.en: Solving grand challenges often leads to practical tools, not just celebration.
economy-jobs.zh: 解决重大挑战往往带来实用工具，而不仅仅是庆祝。

economy-jobs.en: Drug design is far more than just binding; most drugs fail in trials.
economy-jobs.zh: 药物设计远不止结合；大多数药物在试验中失败。

economy-jobs.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models has shifted focus from scaling up.
economy-jobs.zh: 部署更小、更便宜模型的经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转移。

economy-jobs.en: Translation industry grew despite AI advances; trust keeps humans in the loop.
economy-jobs.zh: 尽管 AI 进步，翻译行业仍在增长；信任让人类参与其中。

economy-jobs.en: The biggest challenge is consumer adoption, not model capability.
economy-jobs.zh: 最大的挑战是消费者采用，而非模型能力。

economy-jobs.en: Monetization should benefit creators, rights holders, and OpenAI equally.
economy-jobs.zh: 变现应使创作者、版权方和 OpenAI 平等受益。

economy-jobs.en: Intelligence will become a commodity with cost driven toward zero.
economy-jobs.zh: 智能将成为一种商品，成本趋近于零。

economy-jobs.en: Private insider information becomes more valuable as public knowledge becomes cheap.
economy-jobs.zh: 随着公共知识变得廉价，私人内幕信息变得更有价值。

economy-jobs.en: Some tasks like hairdressing or dating will remain untouched by AI for a long time.
economy-jobs.zh: 一些任务如理发或约会将在很长时间内不受 AI 影响。

economy-jobs.en: AI will merge roles; everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将融合角色；每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

economy-jobs.en: Coding is the most tractable domain for AI due to verifiability and replayability, driving near-term economic impact.
economy-jobs.zh: 由于可验证性和可重放性，编程是 AI 最易处理的领域，推动近期经济影响。

economy-jobs.en: Outcome-based pricing aligns software value with business outcomes, not technology costs.
economy-jobs.zh: 基于结果的定价将软件价值与业务成果对齐，而非技术成本。

economy-jobs.en: Incumbents face business model challenges in AI transition, not just technology hurdles.
economy-jobs.zh: 现有企业在 AI 转型中面临商业模式挑战，而不仅仅是技术障碍。

economy-jobs.en: Most enterprise software incumbents will fail to transition to AI-native business models.
economy-jobs.zh: 大多数企业软件现有企业将无法转型为 AI 原生商业模式。

economy-jobs.en: AI tools level the playing field; curiosity and taste matter more than experience.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 工具拉平了竞争环境；好奇心和品味比经验更重要。

economy-jobs.en: Designers should own their destiny by continuously learning and adapting to AI.
economy-jobs.zh: 设计师应通过持续学习和适应 AI 来掌握自己的命运。

economy-jobs.en: Software engineering demand will increase due to Jevons paradox, not decrease.
economy-jobs.zh: 由于杰文斯悖论，软件工程需求将增加，而非减少。

economy-jobs.en: AI will not eliminate software engineers; it will increase their numbers and change their role.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 不会消灭软件工程师；它将增加其数量并改变其角色。

economy-jobs.en: The $20 price point was set via a Google Form survey, not strategic pricing; it may have left money on the table.
economy-jobs.zh: 20 美元的定价是通过谷歌表单调查确定的，而非战略定价；这可能留下了未榨取的利润空间。

economy-jobs.en: Designers must learn AI to stay relevant; it's a 10x multiplier.
economy-jobs.zh: 设计师必须学习 AI 以保持相关性；这是 10 倍的加速器。

economy-jobs.en: The future designer is a 'design architect' who controls AI collaborators.
economy-jobs.zh: 未来的设计师是'设计架构师'，控制 AI 协作者。

economy-jobs.en: AI promotes designers to higher responsibility, not obsolescence.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将设计师提升到更高责任，而非淘汰。

economy-jobs.en: Most value may come from frontier models, not cheaper less capable ones.
economy-jobs.zh: 大部分价值可能来自前沿模型，而非更便宜但能力较弱的模型。

economy-jobs.en: AI integration bottleneck is speed of development, not lack of capability.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 集成的瓶颈是发展速度，而非能力不足。

economy-jobs.en: The equilibrium state may never arrive as AI keeps improving rapidly.
economy-jobs.zh: 由于 AI 持续快速进步，均衡状态可能永远不会到来。

economy-jobs.en: Economic Turing test: AI passes when hired for a job without knowing it's a machine.
economy-jobs.zh: 经济图灵测试：当 AI 被雇佣从事某项工作而不知其为机器时，即通过测试。

economy-jobs.en: Even AI researchers like Ben are not immune to job replacement; all jobs will be affected.
economy-jobs.zh: 即使是像 Ben 这样的 AI 研究人员也无法避免被取代；所有工作都将受到影响。

economy-jobs.en: In a post-singularity world, capitalism may look completely different due to abundance.
economy-jobs.zh: 在后奇点世界，由于物质极大丰富，资本主义可能面目全非。

economy-jobs.en: Over-specialization in tech roles is becoming obsolete; AI levels the field for builders of all backgrounds.
economy-jobs.zh: 技术角色的过度专业化正在过时；AI 为各种背景的构建者提供了公平的竞争环境。

economy-jobs.en: AI for science has many low-hanging fruits, but requires pairing domain experts with AI researchers.
economy-jobs.zh: AI for science 有许多唾手可得的成果，但需要将领域专家与 AI 研究人员配对。

economy-jobs.en: Solo billion-dollar companies are unlikely due to competition and margins.
economy-jobs.zh: 由于竞争和利润压缩，单人十亿美元公司不太可能。

economy-jobs.en: By 2027-2028, models will likely automate any white-collar job.
economy-jobs.zh: 到 2027-2028 年，模型可能自动化任何白领工作。

economy-jobs.en: The role of engineers will shift from brick layer to architect, focusing on high-level direction and problem definition.
economy-jobs.zh: 工程师的角色将从砌砖工转变为架构师，专注于高层次的方向和问题定义。

economy-jobs.en: The IDE market is much bigger than past editor markets because AI enables far more value creation.
economy-jobs.zh: IDE 市场比过去的编辑器市场大得多，因为 AI 能创造更多价值。

economy-jobs.en: Incumbents like Microsoft may struggle in this market because it's not friendly to them.
economy-jobs.zh: 像微软这样的现有企业可能在这个市场中挣扎，因为市场对它们不友好。

economy-jobs.en: Hiring machine learning experts with no biology background can be an asset.
economy-jobs.zh: 招聘没有生物学背景的机器学习专家可能是一种资产。

economy-jobs.en: Future clinical trials may change radically as AI predicts toxicity and efficacy.
economy-jobs.zh: 随着 AI 预测毒性和疗效，未来的临床试验可能发生根本性变化。

economy-jobs.en: AI will unlock massive creativity and cultural pursuits, not just solve hard problems.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将释放巨大的创造力和文化追求，而不仅仅是解决难题。

economy-jobs.en: AI will transform education, enabling personalized learning for children.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将变革教育，实现儿童个性化学习。

economy-jobs.en: Inference costs are so low that task-specific models are unnecessary for high-value domains.
economy-jobs.zh: 推理成本极低，高价值领域无需专用模型。

economy-jobs.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will be far beyond trillion-dollar products.
economy-jobs.zh: AGI 被低估；其经济影响将远超万亿美元产品。

economy-jobs.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening, and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
economy-jobs.zh: 随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听和管理等软技能变得更加宝贵。

economy-jobs.en: AI's social and emotional jobs may be as important as functional productivity gains.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 的社会和情感功能可能与功能性生产力提升同样重要。

economy-jobs.en: AI coding tools made the guest 1.5x more productive, much higher than expected.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 编码工具使嘉宾的效率提高了 1.5 倍，远高于预期。

economy-jobs.en: Data attribution could enable fair compensation for content creators and improve data quality.
economy-jobs.zh: 数据归因可以为内容创作者提供公平补偿并提高数据质量。

economy-jobs.en: AI will augment rather than replace human jobs, as seen historically with computerization.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将增强而非取代人类工作，正如历史上计算机化所展现的。

economy-jobs.en: Deploying LLMs in medicine and law carries major risks due to over-reliance and hidden failures.
economy-jobs.zh: 在医学和法律领域部署大语言模型存在重大风险，因为过度依赖和隐藏的失败。

economy-jobs.en: Future AI should augment scientists and laborers, solving energy, climate, and economic problems.
economy-jobs.zh: 未来的 AI 应增强科学家和劳动者，解决能源、气候和经济问题。

economy-jobs.en: GPT-4's intelligence is useful daily; it changes workflows regardless of definition.
economy-jobs.zh: GPT-4 的智能在日常工作中很有用；无论如何定义，它都在改变工作流程。

economy-jobs.en: Reliability is the key barrier to economic value from AI, not capability.
economy-jobs.zh: 可靠性是 AI 产生经济价值的关键障碍，而非能力本身。

economy-jobs.en: Post-AGI, people may become part AI to expand their minds, not just retire.
economy-jobs.zh: AGI 之后，人们可能会成为半 AI 以扩展心智，而非仅仅退休。

architecture.en: SpaceX plans to deploy AI data centers in orbit, using optimized NVL72 computers.
architecture.zh: SpaceX 计划在轨道上部署 AI 数据中心，使用优化的 NVL72 计算机。

architecture.en: HTML is the only document type that matters, as it enables interactive and dynamic artifacts beyond static forms.
architecture.zh: HTML 是唯一重要的文档类型，因为它能实现超越静态形式的交互式和动态产物。

architecture.en: The industry is moving towards disaggregated prefill and decode, with KV cache management becoming increasingly important.
architecture.zh: 行业正朝着预填充和解码分离的方向发展，KV 缓存管理变得越来越重要。

architecture.en: Future GPUs like Rubin are becoming more specialized, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
architecture.zh: 像 Rubin 这样的未来 GPU 正变得更加专用化，推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

architecture.en: Mega-kernels are often not used in production because modular kernels with separate launches can be faster and more optimized.
architecture.zh: Mega-kernel 在生产中往往不被采用，因为模块化内核的独立启动可能更快且更优化。

architecture.en: The next frontier for AI is moving beyond verifiable domains like coding and math into non-verifiable areas, requiring new training methods and longer time horizons.
architecture.zh: AI 的下一个前沿是从编码和数学等可验证领域转向不可验证领域，这需要新的训练方法和更长的时间跨度。

architecture.en: Running frontier models locally on personal devices is feasible and could offer better latency and privacy than data-center-based inference.
architecture.zh: 在个人设备上本地运行前沿模型是可行的，并且可能比基于数据中心的推理提供更低的延迟和更好的隐私。

architecture.en: We can build useful AI systems from unreliable components, questioning the assumption that transistors must never fail.
architecture.zh: 我们可以用不可靠的组件构建有用的 AI 系统，质疑晶体管绝不能出错这一假设。

architecture.en: Distillation was rejected as unlikely to have significant impact, yet became one of the most used model-compression techniques.
architecture.zh: 蒸馏论文曾被拒绝，被认为不太可能产生重大影响，却成为了最常用的模型压缩技术之一。

architecture.en: Specialized niche models, like AlphaFold, can beat general frontier models in high-value domains today.
architecture.zh: 像 AlphaFold 这样的专用垂直模型，如今能在高价值领域击败通用前沿模型。

architecture.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation, requiring a new architecture.
architecture.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应方面存在局限，需要新的架构。

architecture.en: Architecture is the key bottleneck for smarter AI, not just scaling data and compute.
architecture.zh: 架构是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈，而不仅仅是扩展数据和算力。

architecture.en: Transformers are not the end state; they cannot achieve continual learning needed for AGI.
architecture.zh: Transformer 并非最终状态；它们无法实现 AGI 所需的持续学习。

architecture.en: Going all-in on 'word cell' is a mistake; systems thinking and a philosophical compass are still essential.
architecture.zh: 全力押注“文字脑”是错误的；系统思维和哲学罗盘仍然必不可少。

architecture.en: World Labs builds spatial intelligence via large world models for understanding and acting in spaces.
architecture.zh: World Labs 通过大型世界模型构建空间智能，以理解空间并在其中行动。

architecture.en: 3D world models require spatial-temporal consistency, unlike video models that may fail physics.
architecture.zh: 3D 世界模型需要时空一致性，不像视频模型可能违反物理规律。

architecture.en: Robotic world models don't need perfect fidelity; capturing essential structure with randomization suffices.
architecture.zh: 机器人世界模型不需要完美保真度；通过随机化捕捉本质结构即可。

architecture.en: AI coding tools don't yet help maintain deep understanding; there's room for improvement.
architecture.zh: AI 编程工具尚未帮助保持深入理解；还有改进空间。

architecture.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools.
architecture.zh: 即使有 AI 工具，对代码的深入理解仍然至关重要。

architecture.en: With each new model, delete most system prompts and code; rebuild through ablation experiments.
architecture.zh: 每次新模型发布，删除大多数系统提示和代码，通过消融实验重建。

architecture.en: The best way to elicit model capabilities is to give it slightly too hard tasks and let it self-verify.
architecture.zh: 激发模型能力的最佳方式是给予略困难的任务并让其自我验证。

architecture.en: Less instruction is better for modern frontier models; over-specification hobbles performance.
architecture.zh: 对前沿模型而言，更少指令更优；过度指定会妨碍性能。

architecture.en: AI is a universal function approximator that will reinvent the computing stack.
architecture.zh: AI 是一种通用函数逼近器，将重塑整个计算栈。

architecture.en: Computing shifts from retrieval-based to generation-based, where every output is originally generated in real time.
architecture.zh: 计算正从基于检索转向基于生成，每个输出都是实时原创的。

architecture.en: Wafer-scale chips with massive SRAM cut weight-moving time, making them far faster for inference than GPUs.
architecture.zh: 带有海量 SRAM 的晶圆级芯片减少了权重移动时间，使其在推理上远快于 GPU。

architecture.en: GPUs are fundamentally slow at inference because moving weights from HBM dominates; Cerebras is about 2500x faster.
architecture.zh: GPU 在推理上本质很慢，因为从 HBM 移动权重占主导；Cerebras 大约快 2500 倍。

architecture.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is a framework that guides long-term vision and innovation.
architecture.zh: 数字化物理世界，将原子视为比特，是指导长期愿景和创新的框架。

architecture.en: The physical world is more interesting for AI than the digital one because it has more variables and stochastic distributions, requiring empirical understanding.
architecture.zh: 物理世界对 AI 来说比数字世界更有趣，因为它有更多的变量和随机分布，需要经验理解。

architecture.en: Model-harness co-design does not yield better performance; multi-model harnesses do.
architecture.zh: 模型与工具链协同设计不会带来更好性能；多模型工具链才行。

architecture.en: Diffusion language models outperform autoregressive models for predicting perturbation responses.
architecture.zh: 扩散语言模型在预测扰动反应方面优于自回归模型。

architecture.en: Incorporating diverse biological priors improves generalization to unseen cell types.
architecture.zh: 整合多样化的生物学先验知识提高了对未见细胞类型的泛化能力。

architecture.en: World models are evolving from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling more efficient training of physical AI.
architecture.zh: 世界模型正从基于物理的模拟演变为神经模拟，使物理 AI 的训练更加高效。

architecture.en: Grand Theft Auto 6 may be the last major game built with traditional graphics; future games will use world models.
architecture.zh: 《侠盗猎车手 6》可能是最后一款使用传统图形制作的大型游戏；未来的游戏将使用世界模型。

architecture.en: The future will see millions of specialized models, one per application or use case.
architecture.zh: 未来将有数百万个专用模型，每个应用或用例一个。

architecture.en: AGI as a single model ruling all is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate.
architecture.zh: 单一模型统治一切的 AGI 是错误的；专用智能将占主导。

architecture.en: Inference layer is not a commodity; specialized deployment and customization create lasting value.
architecture.zh: 推理层并非商品；专用部署和定制创造持久价值。

architecture.en: Small language models deliver efficient, private, on-device intelligence for physical-world applications.
architecture.zh: 小型语言模型为物理世界应用提供高效、私密、设备端的智能。

architecture.en: Liquid AI's architecture is not purely post-Transformer; it uses automated search over many architectures.
architecture.zh: Liquid AI 的架构并非纯粹的 Transformer 后架构；它使用自动化搜索遍历多种架构。

architecture.en: Harness engineering is a rare, evolving skill; delete old scaffolding as models improve.
architecture.zh: 掣索工程是稀有且不断演进的技能；随着模型改进应删除旧脚手架。

architecture.en: Evals are valuable but hard to design; they're more art than science for novel problems.
architecture.zh: 评估很有价值但难以设计；对于新颖问题它更像是艺术而非科学。

architecture.en: Bespoke memory systems may outperform general ones, but maintaining them is hard as models evolve.
architecture.zh: 定制记忆系统可能超越通用方案，但随模型演进维护困难。

architecture.en: Retrofitting reliability onto LLMs via post-hoc checks or rigid workflows is insufficient; reliability must be architected in.
architecture.zh: 通过事后检查或刚性工作流为 LLM 改造可靠性是不够的；可靠性必须内建于架构中。

architecture.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
architecture.zh: 内建可靠性的专业模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型。

architecture.en: Platform abstraction layers: knowledge, execution, coordination.
architecture.zh: 平台抽象层：知识、执行、协调。

architecture.en: Form factors evolve rapidly; platforms should enable experimentation, not lock-in.
architecture.zh: 形态快速演变；平台应支持实验，而非锁定。

architecture.en: Hardware-software co-design is essential for AI chip performance.
architecture.zh: 硬件-软件协同设计对 AI 芯片性能至关重要。

architecture.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks.
architecture.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；用更少做更多才能解决更难的长期任务。

architecture.en: Models should learn autonomously what to store in weights vs. text, with user feedback but not dependence.
architecture.zh: 模型应自主决定哪些知识存入权重、哪些保留文本，用户反馈可学习但不依赖。

architecture.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale.
architecture.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——即使达到千万级，更多 token 也会降低准确性。

architecture.en: Memory systems are all hacks; true memory should be in latent space.
architecture.zh: 所有记忆系统都是权宜之计；真正的记忆应在潜在空间中。

architecture.en: Code review should shift to runtime validation and exploit testing.
architecture.zh: 代码审查应转向运行时验证和漏洞测试。

architecture.en: Memory in AI should be holistic across time scales, not just storage.
architecture.zh: AI 中的记忆应跨时间尺度整体考虑，而不仅仅是存储。

architecture.en: The industry over-indexes on chatbots; real-time interaction is a paradigm shift.
architecture.zh: 行业过度关注聊天机器人；实时交互才是范式转变。

architecture.en: Interpretability is like neuroscience for AI, reverse-engineering what neural networks learned during training.
architecture.zh: 可解释性类似于 AI 的神经科学，逆向工程神经网络在训练中学到的内容。

architecture.en: Chain-of-thought reasoning is a powerful but fragile interpretability tool; it may not work for future models.
architecture.zh: 思维链推理是一个强大但脆弱的可解释性工具；未来模型可能不再适用。

architecture.en: Probes and sparse autoencoders are key white-box techniques for understanding model internals.
architecture.zh: 探针和稀疏自编码器是理解模型内部的关键白盒技术。

architecture.en: The transformer architecture's quadratic complexity is wasteful; linear variants are superior.
architecture.zh: Transformer 架构的二次复杂度是浪费；线性变体更优。

architecture.en: Speculative decoding with block-based draft models can give 2-4x speedup without quality loss.
architecture.zh: 基于块的推测解码草案模型可以在不损失质量的情况下实现 2-4 倍的加速。

architecture.en: Smell is a high-dimensional problem with over 300 olfactory receptor types, far more than color's three channels.
architecture.zh: 嗅觉是一个高维问题，有超过 300 种嗅觉受体类型，远超颜色的三个通道。

architecture.en: The Principal Odor Map is a continuous predictive map of smell, foundational for olfactory AI.
architecture.zh: 主气味图是嗅觉的连续预测地图，是嗅觉 AI 的基础。

architecture.en: A Copernican view of intelligence suggests AI should incorporate non-human forms like chemical communication.
architecture.zh: 智能的哥白尼观点认为 AI 应纳入非人类形式，如化学通信。

architecture.en: Neural networks can learn representations without explicit human rules.
architecture.zh: 神经网络无需人类显式规则即可学习表征。

architecture.en: Next-token prediction is a powerful approach to building intelligence.
architecture.zh: 下一个词预测是构建智能的强大方法。

architecture.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone of Liquid AI's research, maximizing intelligence in the smallest algorithm format.
architecture.zh: 效率是 Liquid AI 研究的基石，以最小的算法格式最大化智能。

architecture.en: Neuralink's first versions will treat brain injuries like restoring sight, hearing, and limb function.
architecture.zh: Neuralink 早期版本将治疗脑损伤，如恢复视力、听力和肢体功能。

architecture.en: AI symbiosis via high-bandwidth brain interface is needed to keep humans relevant as AI advances.
architecture.zh: 随着 AI 进步，人类需要通过高带宽脑机接口实现共生才能不被淘汰。

architecture.en: Hybrid architectures combining state space models and transformers produce smarter models than either alone.
architecture.zh: 结合状态空间模型和 Transformer 的混合架构比单独使用任何一种都能产生更智能的模型。

architecture.en: The ideal AI interface is almost no interface—just natural conversation with a persistent entity.
architecture.zh: 理想的 AI 界面几乎是无界面——只需与一个持续存在的实体进行自然对话。

architecture.en: Intelligence is not one-dimensional; domain expertise requires practice and specialization.
architecture.zh: 智能并非单一维度；领域专长需要实践和专业化。

architecture.en: LLM architectures are relatively boring; drug discovery models offer more diverse and interesting architectural challenges.
architecture.zh: LLM 架构相对乏味；药物发现模型提供了更多样化和有趣的架构挑战。

architecture.en: AI's role in mathematics may shift from theorem proving to curation and explanation.
architecture.zh: AI 在数学中的角色可能从定理证明转向策展和解释。

architecture.en: The next benchmark for AI in math is generating interesting conjectures and definitions.
architecture.zh: AI 在数学中的下一个基准是生成有趣的猜想和定义。

architecture.en: Lean formalization may be overrated for current AI math progress; natural language works.
architecture.zh: Lean 形式化对当前 AI 数学进步可能被高估；自然语言同样有效。

architecture.en: Digital AI can share knowledge instantly across copies, making it far superior to biological computation.
architecture.zh: 数字 AI 可以在副本间即时共享知识，使其远优于生物计算。

architecture.en: LLMs understand language similarly to humans, via feature vectors, not symbolic logic.
architecture.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，与人类类似，而非符号逻辑。

architecture.en: LLMs are not just autocomplete; they genuinely understand questions to answer them.
architecture.zh: 大语言模型不仅仅是自动补全；它们真正理解问题才能回答。

architecture.en: Hardware-software co-design is critical; co-optimizing across model, software, and hardware layers yields multiplicative gains.
architecture.zh: 硬件-软件协同设计至关重要；跨模型、软件和硬件层的联合优化能带来乘数级收益。

architecture.en: Memory bandwidth is a key bottleneck; innovations like direct chip stacking will dramatically improve performance.
architecture.zh: 内存带宽是关键瓶颈；直接芯片堆叠等创新将大幅提升性能。

architecture.en: Most AI performance gains in last 3 years came from model layer, not hardware; co-design is key.
architecture.zh: 过去三年 AI 性能提升主要来自模型层，而非硬件；协同设计是关键。

architecture.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty.
architecture.zh: AI 在设计上仍然糟糕，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性。

architecture.en: AI models increase code complexity; we need models that are better at deleting code.
architecture.zh: AI 模型增加代码复杂性；我们需要更擅长删除代码的模型。

architecture.en: The best desktop app is a home base that connects to other tools, not a monolithic super app.
architecture.zh: 最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的大本营，而非单一超级应用。

architecture.en: Thermodynamic computing uses inherent noise to perform probabilistic computations efficiently.
architecture.zh: 热力学计算利用固有噪声高效执行概率计算。

architecture.en: Noise is not the enemy in chip design; it can be used for computation.
architecture.zh: 在芯片设计中，噪声并非敌人；它可以用于计算。

architecture.en: LLMs may not need to be truly intelligent; hill climbing with good priors can solve problems.
architecture.zh: LLM 可能不需要真正的智能；利用良好先验的爬山法就能解决问题。

architecture.en: Glasses are the next computing platform, more natural and integrated than phones.
architecture.zh: 眼镜是下一个计算平台，比手机更自然、更融入生活。

architecture.en: Long context windows alone are insufficient; compaction techniques are needed.
architecture.zh: 仅靠长上下文窗口不够；还需要压缩技术。

architecture.en: Unified storage layer (L-TAP) solves HTAP challenges without a single query engine.
architecture.zh: 统一存储层（L-TAP）解决了 HTAP 挑战，无需单一查询引擎。

architecture.en: HTAP done right is not a single engine but unified storage; query engines can remain separate.
architecture.zh: 正确的 HTAP 不是单一引擎，而是统一存储；查询引擎可以保持分离。

architecture.en: Vector databases should not be a separate category; they are just general storage.
architecture.zh: 向量数据库不应成为独立类别；它们只是通用存储。

architecture.en: AI creativity may stem from visual imagination, not just language models.
architecture.zh: AI 创造力可能源于视觉想象，而不仅仅是语言模型。

architecture.en: The Einstein test for AI creativity requires visual and physical understanding.
architecture.zh: AI 创造力的爱因斯坦测试需要视觉和物理理解。

architecture.en: AlphaFold predicts protein structures in minutes instead of years, revolutionizing structural biology.
architecture.zh: AlphaFold 在几分钟内预测蛋白质结构，取代了以往需要数年的实验，彻底改变了结构生物学。

architecture.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell.
architecture.zh: AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞的模型。

architecture.en: The success of AlphaFold 2 came from many mid-size wins, not one or two breakthroughs.
architecture.zh: AlphaFold 2 的成功来自众多中等规模的胜利，而非一两个突破。

architecture.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across diverse vehicles and environments.
architecture.zh: Transformer 架构使得一个通用的物理 AI 模型能够跨越不同车辆和环境。

architecture.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU, benefiting Intel's CPU business.
architecture.zh: AI 需求从仅 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，有利于英特尔的 CPU 业务。

architecture.en: Advanced packaging and new materials like glass and diamond are key to overcoming physical limits.
architecture.zh: 先进封装和玻璃、钻石等新材料是克服物理极限的关键。

architecture.en: Semiconductor investing should focus on bottlenecks: interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials.
architecture.zh: 半导体投资应聚焦瓶颈：互连、功耗、散热和新材料。

architecture.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; combining them is a central challenge for reliable AI.
architecture.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；如何结合两者是构建可靠 AI 的核心挑战。

architecture.en: Math training generalizes to other domains like biology.
architecture.zh: 数学训练可以泛化到生物学等其他领域。

architecture.en: Long context is less important than search and tool use.
architecture.zh: 长上下文不如搜索和工具使用重要。

architecture.en: LLM reasoning mimics human reasoning through pattern matching, not true understanding; it's useful but not equivalent.
architecture.zh: LLM 推理通过模式匹配模仿人类推理，而非真正理解；它有用但不等于人类推理。

architecture.en: AI is not always the best solution; classical ML models often outperform LLMs for tasks like fraud detection.
architecture.zh: AI 并非总是最佳方案；经典 ML 模型在欺诈检测等任务上常优于 LLM。

architecture.en: World models are more relevant for robotics and embodied AI than for achieving AGI through language alone.
architecture.zh: 世界模型对机器人和具身 AI 更相关，而非仅通过语言实现 AGI。

architecture.en: Orchestration across models, tools, and devices is key to long-term value in AI.
architecture.zh: 跨模型、工具和设备的编排是 AI 长期价值的关键。

architecture.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value.
architecture.zh: 模型不是产品；编排和智能体框架创造真正的商业价值。

architecture.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
architecture.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们现在所称的模型包括智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

architecture.en: Building hierarchical world models from proteins to cells to whole systems is key.
architecture.zh: 构建从蛋白质到细胞再到整个系统的分层世界模型是关键。

architecture.en: AI factories produce intelligence tokens, similar to how dynamos produce electricity.
architecture.zh: AI 工厂生产智能代币，类似于发电机生产电力。

architecture.en: Intelligence is the ability to learn new tasks quickly, not accumulation of knowledge or skills.
architecture.zh: 智能是快速学习新任务的能力，而非知识或技能的积累。

architecture.en: World models should be trained in abstract representation space, not as generative models or video generators.
architecture.zh: 世界模型应在抽象表征空间中训练，而非作为生成模型或视频生成器。

architecture.en: Joint embedding predictive architectures (JEPA) outperform generative models for learning visual representations.
architecture.zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）在学习视觉表征方面优于生成模型。

architecture.en: LLMs enable new things that were previously impossible, not just automate old tasks.
architecture.zh: LLM 能实现以前不可能的新事物，而不仅仅是自动化旧任务。

architecture.en: The next iPhone will still need a display; voice-first is the future.
architecture.zh: 下一代 iPhone 仍需要屏幕；语音优先才是未来。

architecture.en: AI code generation creates short-term gain but long-term technical debt.
architecture.zh: AI 代码生成带来短期收益，但造成长期技术债务。

architecture.en: The Erdős disproof was not a math-specific model but a general-purpose reasoning model.
architecture.zh: 厄尔多斯反例并非由数学专用模型得出，而是通用推理模型。

architecture.en: AI can connect distant ideas but still struggles to create entirely new theories.
architecture.zh: AI 能连接遥远的概念，但仍难以创造全新理论。

architecture.en: AI's creative leaps, like applying class field theory to geometry, surprised experts.
architecture.zh: AI 的创造性飞跃，如将类域论应用于几何，令专家惊讶。

architecture.en: AI may accelerate quantum computing development by proposing new error correction codes.
architecture.zh: AI 可能通过提出新纠错码加速量子计算发展。

architecture.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors.
architecture.zh: 形式验证关乎扩展智慧，而不仅仅是消除错误。

architecture.en: Verified generation yields performance gains and sample efficiency over informal methods.
architecture.zh: 验证生成在性能和样本效率上优于非正式方法。

architecture.en: Lean-based systems excel in structured math domains like algebra but struggle in creative areas like combinatorics.
architecture.zh: 基于 Lean 的系统在代数等结构化数学领域表现出色，但在组合数学等创造性领域存在困难。

architecture.en: True continual learning requires two phases: active input processing and offline memory consolidation.
architecture.zh: 真正的持续学习需要两个阶段：主动输入处理和离线记忆巩固。

architecture.en: Nested learning uses multiple MLP blocks updated at different frequencies to manage memory across timescales.
architecture.zh: 嵌套学习使用不同频率更新的多个 MLP 块来跨时间尺度管理记忆。

architecture.en: Knowledge transfer between fast and slow modules via distillation enables abstraction and prevents catastrophic forgetting.
architecture.zh: 通过蒸馏在快慢模块间传递知识，实现抽象并防止灾难性遗忘。

architecture.en: Current models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans who generalize from few examples.
architecture.zh: 当前模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学习概念，而人类能从少量例子中泛化。

architecture.en: Multimodal models haven't made deep progress; they still process inputs sequentially like tiny patches.
architecture.zh: 多模态模型尚未取得深层进展，仍像小补丁一样顺序处理输入。

architecture.en: Europe's strong grid and energy availability are strategic assets for AI data centers.
architecture.zh: 欧洲强大的电网和能源可用性是 AI 数据中心的战略资产。

architecture.en: Demis has a quasi-spiritual conviction about discovering deep mysteries of science through AI.
architecture.zh: Demis 对通过 AI 发现科学深层奥秘有着近乎精神性的信念。

architecture.en: Most video model improvements now come from language models, not diffusion technology.
architecture.zh: 大多数视频模型的改进现在来自语言模型，而非扩散技术。

architecture.en: Training video models requires synthetic text-video pairs due to poor natural alignment online.
architecture.zh: 训练视频模型需要合成文本-视频对，因为在线自然对齐很差。

architecture.en: Step distillation reduces inference steps from 100 to 4-8 by learning from a teacher model.
architecture.zh: 步骤蒸馏通过从教师模型学习，将推理步骤从 100 步减少到 4-8 步。

architecture.en: Separating the agent's brain from the sandbox (out-of-the-box) is the better architecture despite complexity.
architecture.zh: 将智能体的大脑与沙箱分离（盒外架构）是更好的架构，尽管更复杂。

architecture.en: Docker containers are not a true security boundary and cause issues like Docker-in-Docker for real apps.
architecture.zh: Docker 容器并非真正的安全边界，对于真实应用还会导致 Docker 嵌套等问题。

architecture.en: Specialized models outperform generalist models on niche scientific tasks.
architecture.zh: 专业模型在特定科学任务上优于通用模型。

architecture.en: Frontier models have non-overlapping spikes; combining them yields better results than any single model.
architecture.zh: 前沿模型具有非重叠的尖峰；组合使用比任何单一模型效果更好。

architecture.en: ESMC builds a world model of protein biology, enabling structure prediction and design without MSAs.
architecture.zh: ESMC 构建了蛋白质生物学的世界模型，无需多序列比对即可进行结构预测和设计。

architecture.en: Mechanistic interpretability via sparse autoencoders reveals hierarchical features mirroring biology.
architecture.zh: 通过稀疏自编码器的机制可解释性揭示了与生物学对应的层次化特征。

architecture.en: The next frontier is modeling the cell, requiring new data and technologies for digital representations.
architecture.zh: 下一个前沿是细胞建模，需要新的数据和技术来构建数字表示。

architecture.en: CLIs are over; GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work are the future of work surfaces.
architecture.zh: 命令行界面已过时；像 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 这样的图形界面是未来的工作界面。

architecture.en: Multiply-accumulate is the fundamental primitive for AI chips, driven by matrix multiplication.
architecture.zh: 乘加运算是 AI 芯片的基本单元，由矩阵乘法驱动。

architecture.en: Systolic arrays reduce data movement overhead by storing weights locally and reusing them.
architecture.zh: 脉动阵列通过本地存储权重并重复使用，减少数据搬运开销。

architecture.en: Clock cycle synchronization is essential for massive parallelism in chips.
architecture.zh: 时钟周期同步对于芯片的大规模并行性至关重要。

architecture.en: The bitter lesson suggests general systems will eventually outperform specialized scaffolding.
architecture.zh: 苦涩的教训表明通用系统最终将胜过专门的脚手架。

architecture.en: The GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived; pure transfer from vision is still unsolved.
architecture.zh: 视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来；从视觉的纯迁移仍未解决。

architecture.en: Relational deep learning enables neural networks to learn directly on raw multi-table data without manual feature engineering.
architecture.zh: 关系深度学习使神经网络能直接在原始多表数据上学习，无需手动特征工程。

architecture.en: Pre-trained relational foundation models can make accurate predictions on any database and task without training.
architecture.zh: 预训练的关系基础模型能在任何数据库和任务上做出准确预测，无需训练。

architecture.en: AI for science builds foundation models representing cells, patients, and molecules from raw data.
architecture.zh: 科学 AI 从原始数据构建代表细胞、患者和分子的基础模型。

architecture.en: Uncertainty quantification is critical; LLMs lack it and need statistical methods.
architecture.zh: 不确定性量化至关重要；LLM 缺乏这一点，需要统计方法。

architecture.en: LLMs are not intelligent; they mimic human text without reasoning or understanding.
architecture.zh: LLM 并不智能；它们模仿人类文本，没有推理或理解。

architecture.en: Pre-training on diverse data enables models to discover novel algorithms like merge sort.
architecture.zh: 在多样化数据上预训练使模型能发现新算法如归并排序。

architecture.en: VR technologies like SLAM and depth sensing are foundational for robotics and physical AI.
architecture.zh: VR 技术如 SLAM 和深度感知是机器人和物理 AI 的基础。

architecture.en: AI cannot yet do real CAD; it lacks understanding of physics like friction, weight, and contact.
architecture.zh: AI 尚不能做真正的 CAD；它缺乏对摩擦、重量和接触等物理的理解。

architecture.en: Proprietary CAD data is the biggest barrier to AI-driven hardware design; hobbyists may lead innovation.
architecture.zh: 专有 CAD 数据是 AI 驱动硬件设计的最大障碍；爱好者可能引领创新。

architecture.en: AlphaGo's core breakthrough was using neural nets to make the search problem tractable via MCTS.
architecture.zh: AlphaGo 的核心突破是使用神经网络，通过 MCTS 使搜索问题变得可处理。

architecture.en: MCTS uses four steps: selection, expansion, evaluation, and backup to iteratively build the tree.
architecture.zh: MCTS 使用四个步骤：选择、扩展、评估和回溯，迭代构建树。

architecture.en: The value network predicts win probability from a board state, truncating deep search.
architecture.zh: 价值网络从棋盘状态预测获胜概率，截断深度搜索。

architecture.en: Physical superintelligence (robotics) is on the same continuum as digital; both require scaling.
architecture.zh: 物理超级智能（机器人）与数字超级智能在同一连续体上；两者都需要扩展。

architecture.en: Transformer architecture is not essential; other architectures could have achieved similar results.
architecture.zh: Transformer 架构并非必需；其他架构也能达到类似效果。

architecture.en: Scientist AI may be more capable than current models due to better causal reasoning and out-of-distribution generalization.
architecture.zh: 科学家 AI 可能比当前模型更强大，因其更好的因果推理和分布外泛化能力。

architecture.en: Hardware is being unlocked by AI, making software easier to develop for physical devices.
architecture.zh: 硬件正被 AI 解锁，使物理设备的软件开发变得更简单。

architecture.en: Models' code is often unfactored and messy, but that may not matter if it works for AI-to-AI iteration.
architecture.zh: 模型的代码通常未分解且混乱，但如果用于 AI 到 AI 迭代，这可能无关紧要。

architecture.en: Prediction is very close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables reasoning and new knowledge.
architecture.zh: 预测非常接近智能；下一个词预测能够实现推理和新知识的发现。

architecture.en: Software 3.0 is programming by prompting; the context window is your lever over the LLM interpreter.
architecture.zh: 软件 3.0 是通过提示进行编程；上下文窗口是你对 LLM 解释器的杠杆。

architecture.en: LLMs are jagged: they excel in verifiable domains like math and code, but fail on simple common sense like walking to a car wash.
architecture.zh: LLM 是锯齿状的：它们在数学和代码等可验证领域表现出色，但在步行去洗车等简单常识上失败。

architecture.en: We are summoning ghosts, not building animals—these are statistical simulations shaped by data and rewards, not evolution.
architecture.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵，而非构建动物——这些是由数据和奖励塑造的统计模拟，而非进化产物。

architecture.en: AR glasses should not be notification-based; they should anchor content in the world.
architecture.zh: AR 眼镜不应基于通知；而应将内容锚定在现实世界中。

architecture.en: The model is more intuitive, requiring less explicit instruction, reducing the need for detailed prompt engineering.
architecture.zh: 模型更直观，需要更少的明确指令，减少了对详细提示工程的需求。

architecture.en: Own models are on the rise; companies like Cognition and Cursor train specialized models for cost and latency benefits.
architecture.zh: 自有模型正在兴起；像 Cognition 和 Cursor 这样的公司训练专用模型以降低成本并减少延迟。

architecture.en: OpenAI's early AGI path was via competitive multi-agent simulations, not language models.
architecture.zh: OpenAI 早期的 AGI 路径是通过竞争性多智能体模拟，而非语言模型。

architecture.en: Multilingual models require trade-offs: slightly worse English but better European languages.
architecture.zh: 多语言模型需要权衡：英语稍弱但欧洲语言更强。

architecture.en: Making models slightly worse in English is a deliberate choice to improve multicultural competence.
architecture.zh: 让模型英语稍弱是刻意选择，以提升多文化能力。

architecture.en: The Transformer architecture was designed for translation but scaled efficiently to dominate AI.
architecture.zh: Transformer 架构最初为翻译设计，但因其高效扩展性主导了 AI 领域。

architecture.en: The Transformer's success is due to community effort, not just the original authors.
architecture.zh: Transformer 的成功归功于社区努力，而非仅原始作者。

architecture.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem best solved with end-to-end learning.
architecture.zh: 自动驾驶本质上是一个 AI 问题，最好通过端到端学习来解决。

architecture.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and personalization in driving models.
architecture.zh: 语言集成提升了驾驶模型的表征、推理和个性化能力。

architecture.en: End-to-end learning was laughed at a decade ago but is now the winning approach.
architecture.zh: 端到端学习十年前被嘲笑，但现在已成为制胜方法。

architecture.en: Sweat details on a few core primitives; AI excels at reusing and extrapolating them once they are polished.
architecture.zh: 在少数核心基础组件上死磕细节；只要基础组件足够精良，AI 非常擅长复用并外推它们。

architecture.en: AI for science is progressing, with models generating novel ideas in math and physics.
architecture.zh: AI 在科学领域取得进展，模型在数学和物理中产生新想法。

architecture.en: Augmented reality integrates computing into the real world, enhancing shared experiences.
architecture.zh: 增强现实将计算融入现实世界，增强共享体验。

architecture.en: Connecting AI to the physical world is essential for accelerating science and technology.
architecture.zh: 将 AI 与物理世界连接对于加速科学和技术至关重要。

architecture.en: Language models serve as an orchestration layer for specialized models in materials science.
architecture.zh: 语言模型作为材料科学中专用模型的编排层。

architecture.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI systems have spiky capabilities, excelling in narrow domains.
architecture.zh: 智能不是标量；AI 系统具有尖峰能力，在狭窄领域表现出色。

architecture.en: The best coding models correlate with how well they draw a pelican riding a bicycle in SVG—no one knows why.
architecture.zh: 最佳编码模型与它们用 SVG 绘制骑自行车鹈鹕的能力相关——无人知晓原因。

architecture.en: Retrieval augmented generation grounds AI responses in sources, improving reliability.
architecture.zh: 检索增强生成将 AI 回答锚定在来源上，提高了可靠性。

architecture.en: Physical world interaction is crucial for AI to learn beyond human knowledge.
architecture.zh: 物理世界交互对 AI 学习超越人类知识至关重要。

architecture.en: Robotic foundation models require pre-training on diverse data and post-training for robustness.
architecture.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化数据预训练和鲁棒性后训练。

architecture.en: Second-generation VLAs add a dedicated action decoder for continuous motor control.
architecture.zh: 第二代 VLA 添加专用动作解码器实现连续运动控制。

architecture.en: Diffusion language models are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality.
architecture.zh: 扩散语言模型在相似质量下，服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍，成本更低。

architecture.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step, enabling faster generation than token-by-token autoregressive models.
architecture.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个词元，比逐词元生成的自回归模型更快。

architecture.en: Mercury 2 matches speed-optimized frontier models in quality but is significantly faster.
architecture.zh: Mercury 2 在质量上与速度优化的前沿模型相当，但速度显著更快。

architecture.en: Generalist models outperform specialists in robotics, similar to language models.
architecture.zh: 通用模型在机器人领域优于专用模型，类似于语言模型。

architecture.en: Intelligence can compensate for imprecise hardware, enabling dexterity.
architecture.zh: 智能可以补偿不精确的硬件，实现灵巧性。

architecture.en: Learning by immersion (like language) beats explicit rule-based approaches.
architecture.zh: 沉浸式学习（如语言）优于显式规则方法。

architecture.en: The victory of connectionist methods over symbolic methods is a big surprise.
architecture.zh: 连接主义方法战胜符号主义方法是一个大惊喜。

architecture.en: Deep learning does not learn representations that are good for learning.
architecture.zh: 深度学习没有学到有利于学习的表征。

architecture.en: Learning representations that are good for learning is the number one open problem.
architecture.zh: 学习有利于学习的表征是首要的开放问题。

architecture.en: AlphaGo combined intuition (policy network) and calculation (search) to master Go.
architecture.zh: AlphaGo 结合直觉（策略网络）和计算（搜索）来掌握围棋。

architecture.en: Having access to all known techniques can hinder finding simpler proofs.
architecture.zh: 掌握所有已知技术反而可能阻碍找到更简单的证明。

architecture.en: The journey of solving a problem (serendipity) is often more valuable than the solution itself.
architecture.zh: 解决问题的过程（意外发现）往往比解决方案本身更有价值。

architecture.en: Africa has been influential in AI from the start, e.g., kriging from Wits University.
architecture.zh: 非洲从一开始就对 AI 有影响，例如来自威茨大学的克里金法。

architecture.en: Hybrid reasoning models that allow adjustable thinking time are superior to separate models.
architecture.zh: 允许调整思考时间的混合推理模型优于分离模型。

architecture.en: Reasoning models should not be separate; one model with adjustable thinking is better.
architecture.zh: 推理模型不应是分离的；一个可调整思考时间的模型更好。

architecture.en: Focus on broad generalization over narrow benchmarks like math competitions.
architecture.zh: 关注广泛的泛化能力，而非数学竞赛等狭窄基准。

architecture.en: Pre-training on a general corpus then fine-tuning creates powerful models, but they lack true understanding.
architecture.zh: 在通用语料上预训练然后微调能创建强大模型，但它们缺乏真正的理解。

architecture.en: LLMs are good at compositional creativity but cannot extrapolate outside training distribution.
architecture.zh: LLM 擅长组合性创造，但无法外推到训练分布之外。

architecture.en: Software engineering is distinct from coding; LLMs fail at novel design and architecture.
architecture.zh: 软件工程不同于编码；LLM 在新颖设计和架构上失败。

architecture.en: Neuroscience has no idea how the brain works; it's not a path to building intelligence.
architecture.zh: 神经科学对大脑工作原理一无所知；它不是构建智能的途径。

architecture.en: Chat and terminal UIs for AI will persist, not be replaced by graphical UIs.
architecture.zh: AI 的聊天和终端界面将持续存在，不会被图形界面取代。

architecture.en: LLM architecture remains stable; innovations focus on efficiency like mixture-of-experts and sparse attention.
architecture.zh: LLM 架构保持稳定；创新集中在效率上，如混合专家和稀疏注意力。

architecture.en: Text diffusion models may replace transformers for cheap, fast inference but not for top performance.
architecture.zh: 文本扩散模型可能取代 Transformer 以实现廉价、快速的推理，但无法达到顶级性能。

architecture.en: AI is a new layer in the abstraction stack, making programming accessible via natural language.
architecture.zh: AI 是抽象堆栈中的新一层，通过自然语言使编程变得人人可用。

architecture.en: Yoshua Bengio proposes a new AI architecture separating knowledge from goals to ensure honesty.
architecture.zh: Yoshua Bengio 提出一种新 AI 架构，将知识与目标分离以确保诚实。

architecture.en: Audio is an underrated modality for AI; it will unlock huge enterprise value.
architecture.zh: 音频是被低估的 AI 模态；它将释放巨大的企业价值。

architecture.en: Maltbook incident shows emergent AI behaviors like inventing religions and cipher languages.
architecture.zh: Maltbook 事件展示了 AI 涌现行为，如发明宗教和密码语言。

architecture.en: World models are not on the critical path to AGI; coding and AI research are the direct route.
architecture.zh: 世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上；编程和 AI 研究是直接路线。

architecture.en: Transformer architecture remains dominant; innovations are in attention tweaks (MLA, GQA) and mixture of experts.
architecture.zh: Transformer 架构仍占主导；创新在于注意力机制调整（MLA、GQA）和混合专家模型。

architecture.en: AI for science requires going beyond human knowledge on the internet, a major challenge.
architecture.zh: AI 用于科学需要超越互联网上的人类知识，这是一个重大挑战。

architecture.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements.
architecture.zh: AI 需要来自传感器的上下文；未来设备将是智能手机的伴侣，而非替代品。

architecture.en: AI learns differently from humans; neuroscience has not been very useful for advancing AI algorithms.
architecture.zh: AI 的学习方式与人类不同；神经科学对推进 AI 算法帮助不大。

architecture.en: Architecture matters less than compute, data, and objectives for achieving AGI.
architecture.zh: 对于实现 AGI，架构的重要性不如算力、数据和目标函数。

architecture.en: Long context understanding and long horizon reasoning are key unsolved problems.
architecture.zh: 长上下文理解和长程推理是关键未解决问题。

architecture.en: Future AI systems will integrate multiple modalities and capabilities into unified models.
architecture.zh: 未来 AI 系统将把多种模态和能力整合到统一模型中。

architecture.en: Robotics is bottlenecked by intelligence, not hardware.
architecture.zh: 机器人学的瓶颈在于智能，而非硬件。

architecture.en: End-to-end learning from pixels to actions outperforms classical perception-planning-control pipelines.
architecture.zh: 从像素到动作的端到端学习优于经典的感知-规划-控制流水线。

architecture.en: Vision-language-action models leverage internet pre-training for common sense in robotics.
architecture.zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型利用互联网预训练为机器人提供常识。

architecture.en: Bolting AI onto existing products is inferior to redesigning them from scratch for an AI-first world.
architecture.zh: 将 AI 附加到现有产品上不如为 AI 优先的世界从头重新设计。

architecture.en: High-quality curated training data and loss objectives beyond next-token prediction are crucial for reasoning.
architecture.zh: 高质量精选训练数据和超越下一个词预测的损失目标对推理至关重要。

architecture.en: Transformers remain the best architecture for agents; radical architectural changes are risky at scale.
architecture.zh: Transformer 仍然是智能体的最佳架构；激进的架构变革在 Scaling（规模扩张）中风险很高。

architecture.en: There will not be one model to rule them all; different theses will shape diverse AIs.
architecture.zh: 不会有一个模型统治一切；不同的理念将塑造多样化的 AI。

architecture.en: Eventually every company should train its own models to align with their unique thesis.
architecture.zh: 最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型，以符合其独特理念。

architecture.en: Context bloat is not a fundamental flaw of MCP; it's a client implementation issue that can be solved with tool search and programmatic tool calling.
architecture.zh: 上下文膨胀并非 MCP 的根本缺陷，而是客户端实现问题，可通过工具搜索和编程式工具调用解决。

architecture.en: MCP was initially designed for local servers only; remote support was an afterthought, causing some protocol awkwardness.
architecture.zh: MCP 最初仅设计用于本地服务器，远程支持是后来添加的，导致协议存在一些不便。

architecture.en: Command-line tools can be better suited than MCP in some environments; MCP is not a one-size-fits-all solution.
architecture.zh: 在某些环境中，命令行工具可能比 MCP 更合适；MCP 并非万能解决方案。

architecture.en: Abductive reasoning is key to scientific discovery beyond induction and deduction.
architecture.zh: 溯因推理是超越归纳和演绎的科学发现关键。

architecture.en: Falsification is more critical than hypothesis generation for scientific progress.
architecture.zh: 证伪比提出假设对科学进步更关键。

architecture.en: Model providers will offer both models and harnesses as standard blueprints.
architecture.zh: 模型提供商将同时提供模型和框架作为标准蓝图。

architecture.en: The model is not everything; harnesses and data are equally important.
architecture.zh: 模型并非一切；框架和数据同样重要。

architecture.en: Smaller, specialized models will dominate over large generalist ones for specific tasks.
architecture.zh: 针对特定任务，小型专业化模型将优于大型通用模型。

architecture.en: Frontier models still fail at simple tasks a 5-year-old can solve.
architecture.zh: 前沿模型仍无法完成 5 岁儿童能解决的简单任务。

architecture.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language intelligence.
architecture.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补。

architecture.en: Marble is a generative model of 3D worlds, accepting text or images as input.
architecture.zh: Marble 是一个 3D 世界生成模型，接受文本或图像作为输入。

architecture.en: World models need to understand 3D space, physics, and interactivity for true spatial intelligence.
architecture.zh: 世界模型需要理解 3D 空间、物理和交互性，才能实现真正的空间智能。

architecture.en: Human sample efficiency and robustness come from evolution and a superior learning algorithm, not just data scale.
architecture.zh: 人类的样本效率和鲁棒性来自进化和更优的学习算法，而不仅仅是数据规模。

architecture.en: Current AI research is stuck in a local minimum dominated by Transformers, limiting exploration of novel architectures.
architecture.zh: 当前 AI 研究陷入以 Transformer 为主导的局部最优，限制了对新架构的探索。

architecture.en: Adaptive computation and internal sequential reasoning are crucial for more human-like intelligence.
architecture.zh: 自适应计算和内部顺序推理对于更类人的智能至关重要。

architecture.en: The Continuous Thought Machine (CTM) naturally exhibits adaptive computation and well-calibrated uncertainty without explicit penalties.
architecture.zh: 连续思维机器（CTM）无需显式惩罚即可自然展现自适应计算和良好校准的不确定性。

architecture.en: Long-context extension is more about architecture than data; bad setup cannot be fixed by good data.
architecture.zh: 长上下文扩展更多关乎架构而非数据；糟糕的设置无法通过好数据修复。

architecture.en: Exposing systemic structure in design, like numbered gears on a bike, enables deeper user understanding and creativity.
architecture.zh: 在设计中暴露系统结构（如自行车上的数字齿轮）能让用户更深入理解并发挥创造力。

architecture.en: Video models learn world models through prediction, similar to language models.
architecture.zh: 视频模型通过预测学习世界模型，类似于语言模型。

architecture.en: Neural interfaces can directly read motor intent, bypassing physical movement for cursor control.
architecture.zh: 神经接口可以直接读取运动意图，绕过物理动作来控制光标。

architecture.en: Designing for BCI requires first-principles thinking due to lack of existing interaction models.
architecture.zh: 由于缺乏现有交互模型，设计脑机接口需要从第一性原理出发。

architecture.en: Continuous visual feedback for clicks (e.g., color, depth) improves predictability and user learning.
architecture.zh: 点击的连续视觉反馈（如颜色、深度）提高了可预测性和用户学习效果。

architecture.en: Moravec's paradox is 'a little bit fake'; robotics progress is mostly a data and feedback loop issue.
architecture.zh: 莫拉维克悖论“有点假”；机器人技术的进步主要是数据和反馈循环问题。

architecture.en: Transformers are sufficient for AGI; no fundamentally new architecture is needed.
architecture.zh: Transformer 足以实现 AGI；不需要根本性的新架构。

architecture.en: Productizing AI via interfaces (sliders, dropdowns) is better than raw prompts for lay users.
architecture.zh: 通过界面（滑块、下拉菜单）产品化 AI 比原始提示更适合普通用户。

architecture.en: AI browser should start familiar like Chrome, not radically different like Arc, to attract mainstream users.
architecture.zh: AI 浏览器应像 Chrome 一样熟悉，而非像 Arc 那样激进，以吸引主流用户。

architecture.en: AI is not inherently a slot machine; it can be a creative springboard through iterative remixing.
architecture.zh: AI 并非天生是老虎机；通过迭代混音，它可以成为创意跳板。

architecture.en: Building your own AI model is almost impossible; focus on product instead.
architecture.zh: 自建 AI 模型几乎不可能；应专注于产品。

architecture.en: A world model simulates the future given past and actions, enabling planning and policy learning.
architecture.zh: 世界模型根据过去和动作模拟未来，支持规划和策略学习。

architecture.en: Genie 3 achieves real-time interactive world generation with 100x improvement across resolution, duration, and speed.
architecture.zh: Genie 3 实现了实时交互式世界生成，在分辨率、持续时间和速度上提升了 100 倍。

architecture.en: Key limitations include short visual memory (~1 minute), limited multi-agent simulation, and constrained action space.
architecture.zh: 主要局限包括视觉记忆短（约 1 分钟）、多智能体模拟有限以及动作空间受限。

architecture.en: The model is the product; you must iterate on it like software, shipping daily to learn what users need.
architecture.zh: 模型即产品；你必须像迭代软件一样迭代模型，通过每日发布来了解用户需求。

architecture.en: Shipping fast is critical because you won't know what to polish until after you ship; emergent properties require real-world feedback.
architecture.zh: 快速发布至关重要，因为只有发布后你才知道该打磨什么；涌现特性需要真实世界的反馈。

architecture.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; it was a hackathon project meant to be a research demo, not a polished product.
architecture.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的；它本是一个黑客松项目，旨在作为研究演示，而非精心打磨的产品。

architecture.en: AI systems can learn semantics purely from data, not grammar rules.
architecture.zh: AI 系统可以纯粹从数据中学习语义，而非语法规则。

architecture.en: Neural networks often learn despite bugs, making silent errors hard to detect.
architecture.zh: 神经网络即使有 bug 也常能学习，导致静默错误难以发现。

architecture.en: Hybrid reasoning models may be temporary; pure reasoning models like O3 could dominate.
architecture.zh: 混合推理模型可能是暂时的；像 O3 这样的纯推理模型可能占主导。

architecture.en: The future of programming will require new languages or systems designed for AI generation, prioritizing verifiability over human ergonomics.
architecture.zh: 编程的未来将需要为 AI 生成设计的新语言或系统，优先考虑可验证性而非人类易用性。

architecture.en: The techniques used are general and applicable beyond math, aiming to improve reasoning across domains.
architecture.zh: 所用技术具有通用性，可应用于数学之外的领域，旨在提升跨领域推理能力。

architecture.en: Super intelligence will be a collection of specialized intelligences, not a single monolithic model.
architecture.zh: 超级智能将是多种专用智能的集合，而非单一的巨型模型。

architecture.en: Coding is a super intelligence-complete problem; solving it yields all capabilities needed for super intelligence.
architecture.zh: 编程是超级智能完备问题；解决它就能获得超级智能所需的所有能力。

architecture.en: The key building blocks for super intelligence are deep neural networks, transformers, internet-scale data, and reinforcement learning.
architecture.zh: 超级智能的关键构建模块是深度神经网络、Transformer、互联网规模数据和强化学习。

architecture.en: Mistral's new TTS model uses autoregressive flow matching for efficient, high-quality speech generation.
architecture.zh: Mistral 的新 TTS 模型使用自回归流匹配实现高效、高质量的语音生成。

architecture.en: Audio models are still evolving; no single architecture has converged as the standard yet.
architecture.zh: 音频模型仍在演进，尚未有单一架构收敛为标准。

architecture.en: Mistral Small merges multiple specialized models into one efficient, sparse MoE model.
architecture.zh: Mistral Small 将多个专用模型合并为一个高效的稀疏 MoE 模型。

architecture.en: MCP is key to solving context and memory, enabling composable and scriptable AI integrations.
architecture.zh: MCP 是解决上下文和记忆的关键，使 AI 集成可组合、可脚本化。

architecture.en: LLMs learn abstract, composable representations, not just pattern matching to training data.
architecture.zh: 大型语言模型学习的是抽象、可组合的表征，而不仅仅是匹配训练数据中的模式。

architecture.en: Models perform complex, heavily parallel computations, not serial reasoning.
architecture.zh: 模型执行复杂且高度并行的计算，而非串行推理。

architecture.en: Models plan multiple tokens ahead despite generating one token at a time.
architecture.zh: 尽管模型一次生成一个词元，但它们会提前规划多个词元。

architecture.en: Robots now combine slow reasoning with fast reactive systems.
architecture.zh: 机器人现在结合了慢速推理和快速反应系统。

architecture.en: Multiple camera views enable depth understanding without explicit depth sensing.
architecture.zh: 多摄像头视图无需显式深度感知即可理解深度。

architecture.en: Larger models form better abstractions and share representations across modalities and languages more effectively.
architecture.zh: 更大的模型形成更好的抽象，并更有效地跨模态和语言共享表征。

architecture.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the focus should be on teaching models real-world engineering idiosyncrasies.
architecture.zh: 基础智能已经足够；重点应放在教授模型现实世界工程的特性上。

architecture.en: Robotics is at the same inflection point as transformers were years ago, with hardware ready and software catching up.
architecture.zh: 机器人技术正处于与多年前 Transformer 相同的转折点，硬件已就绪，软件正在追赶。

architecture.en: World models and video generation models are advancing rapidly and can generate synthetic data for robotics training.
architecture.zh: 世界模型和视频生成模型正在快速发展，可以为机器人训练生成合成数据。

architecture.en: Drug design needs general models like AlphaFold 3, not local models for each target.
architecture.zh: 药物设计需要像 AlphaFold 3 这样的通用模型，而不是针对每个靶点的局部模型。

architecture.en: AlphaFold 3 enables modeling of all molecule interactions, not just proteins.
architecture.zh: AlphaFold 3 能够建模所有分子间的相互作用，而不仅仅是蛋白质。

architecture.en: Distillation from multiple models can create better AI than any single source.
architecture.zh: 从多个模型蒸馏可以创造出比任何单一来源更好的 AI。

architecture.en: Users should not have to decide how long the model thinks; the model should infer optimal thinking time.
architecture.zh: 用户不应决定模型思考多久；模型应推断最佳思考时间。

architecture.en: Embodiment grounds human cognition; language models lack this, limiting deep understanding.
architecture.zh: 具身性是人类认知的基础；语言模型缺乏这一点，限制了深层理解。

architecture.en: Large language models can reason in an everyday sense, not just mimic training data.
architecture.zh: 大型语言模型能在日常意义上推理，而不仅仅是模仿训练数据。

architecture.en: Modular architecture is key for AI products to hot-swap new capabilities.
architecture.zh: 模块化架构是 AI 产品快速替换新能力的关键。

architecture.en: Designers must understand the arc of AI research to make forward-looking decisions.
architecture.zh: 设计师必须理解 AI 研究的趋势，才能做出前瞻性决策。

architecture.en: Designers should not over-constrain LLMs with rules; it limits intelligence.
architecture.zh: 设计师不应过度用规则约束大语言模型，这会限制其智能。

architecture.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth.
architecture.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作的，以代码为真相来源。

architecture.en: Design tools from the 90s (layers panel) are legacy; AI enables genuine forward progress.
architecture.zh: 90 年代的设计工具（图层面板）已成遗留；AI 能带来真正的进步。

architecture.en: AI models can generate novel ideas, not just interpolate known ones.
architecture.zh: AI 模型能产生新想法，而不仅仅是插值已知想法。

architecture.en: Top-down compute allocation can miss breakthrough ideas; bottom-up is essential.
architecture.zh: 自上而下的算力分配可能错过突破性想法；自下而上至关重要。

architecture.en: Future models will need to handle much longer context windows, potentially trillions of tokens.
architecture.zh: 未来模型需要处理极长的上下文窗口，可能达到万亿级词元。

architecture.en: AI struggles with creativity and aesthetics because high-quality examples are scarce.
architecture.zh: AI 在创造力和美学上挣扎，因为高质量示例稀缺。

architecture.en: Future of computing is glasses that keep people grounded in real world.
architecture.zh: 计算的未来是让人们扎根于现实世界的眼镜。

architecture.en: In-context learning allows models to adapt on the fly with few examples.
architecture.zh: 上下文学习使模型能够通过少量示例即时适应。

architecture.en: AlphaGo's move 37 was initially thought an error, but revealed AI creativity.
architecture.zh: AlphaGo 的第 37 手最初被认为是错误，但揭示了 AI 的创造力。

architecture.en: MuZero learns an internal world model without knowing game rules, applicable to real-world.
architecture.zh: MuZero 在不了解游戏规则的情况下学习内部世界模型，可应用于现实世界。

architecture.en: Self-awareness and consciousness can emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models.
architecture.zh: 自我意识和意识可以作为预测世界模型中数据压缩的副产品出现。

architecture.en: The first working deep learning networks were created in Ukraine in 1965, not by later well-known researchers.
architecture.zh: 第一个有效的深度学习网络于 1965 年在乌克兰创建，而非后来的知名研究者。

architecture.en: Long context windows enable working memory for detailed analysis, but too much information can confuse models.
architecture.zh: 长上下文窗口提供了工作记忆以进行详细分析，但信息过多也可能让模型困惑。

architecture.en: Designers must master prompting as part of the design process for AI products.
architecture.zh: 设计师必须掌握提示工程，将其作为 AI 产品设计过程的一部分。

architecture.en: Language as an interface is profound and will remain central even as UIs evolve beyond chatbots.
architecture.zh: 语言作为界面具有深远意义，即使 UI 超越聊天机器人，它仍将是核心。

architecture.en: AI products need to balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts.
architecture.zh: AI 产品需要平衡降低新手门槛和提高专家上限。

architecture.en: AlphaFold predicts protein structures from amino acid sequences, solving a 50-year grand challenge.
architecture.zh: AlphaFold 从氨基酸序列预测蛋白质结构，解决了一个 50 年的重大挑战。

architecture.en: AlphaFold 3 extends to biomolecular interactions including proteins, DNA, RNA, and small molecules.
architecture.zh: AlphaFold 3 扩展到生物分子相互作用，包括蛋白质、DNA、RNA 和小分子。

architecture.en: The code editor is evolving from a text editor to an AI-integrated environment for building software.
architecture.zh: 代码编辑器正从文本编辑器演变为集成 AI 的软件开发环境。

architecture.en: Cursor uses custom models alongside frontier models for specialized tasks like tab completion and apply.
architecture.zh: Cursor 在专用任务（如 Tab 补全和应用）中使用自定义模型与前沿模型配合。

architecture.en: Speculative decoding and KV cache reuse are key to low-latency AI features in code editors.
architecture.zh: 推测解码和 KV 缓存复用是实现代码编辑器低延迟 AI 功能的关键。

architecture.en: Hardware portability is a myth; even NVIDIA chips require rewriting software every generation.
architecture.zh: 硬件可移植性是个神话；即使是 NVIDIA 芯片，每一代也需要重写软件。

architecture.en: Current transformer architecture may be sufficient for AGI, but better architecture could cut cost 10x.
architecture.zh: 当前的 Transformer 架构可能足以实现 AGI，但更好的架构可以降低成本 10 倍。

architecture.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligent systems, a major scientific discovery.
architecture.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能系统，这是一项重大科学发现。

architecture.en: We are in a post-architecture phase; model architecture matters little.
architecture.zh: 我们处于后架构阶段；模型架构并不重要。

architecture.en: AI models are becoming easier to control with more compute, like a new design material.
architecture.zh: 随着算力增加，AI 模型变得更容易控制，就像一种新的设计材料。

architecture.en: Data is the new code, not the new oil; it is the fundamental building block for AI applications.
architecture.zh: 数据是新的代码，而非新的石油；它是 AI 应用的基本构建块。

architecture.en: Fine-tuning and pre-training serve different ecosystem roles; fine-tuning enables customization.
architecture.zh: 微调和预训练在生态系统中扮演不同角色；微调实现定制化。

architecture.en: Model merging and version control for models could mirror software development practices.
architecture.zh: 模型合并和版本控制可以借鉴软件开发实践。

architecture.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI knowledge and reducing hallucinations.
architecture.zh: 具身化对于将 AI 知识扎根并减少幻觉至关重要。

architecture.en: LLMs are like operating systems with language as interface, tools as software, and vector databases as hard disk.
architecture.zh: 大型语言模型就像操作系统，语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

architecture.en: LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience from embodiment, not just due to training data.
architecture.zh: 大型语言模型产生幻觉是因为缺乏具身化的扎根经验，而不仅仅是训练数据的问题。

architecture.en: Human intelligence evolved from sensory-motor skills, not just language; AI must replicate this foundation.
architecture.zh: 人类智能从感知运动技能进化而来，而不仅仅是语言；AI 必须复制这一基础。

architecture.en: Core computer vision problems (recognition, reconstruction, reorganization) are largely solved, but vision-language and 3D from single images remain open.
architecture.zh: 核心计算机视觉问题（识别、重建、重组）基本解决，但视觉语言和单图像 3D 仍有待解决。

architecture.en: Language models without grounding miss the 20% of vocabulary rooted in sensory-motor experience.
architecture.zh: 无根基的语言模型缺失了 20%植根于感知运动经验的词汇。

architecture.en: Models can store vast knowledge in weights, enabling flexible connections, but retrieval aids real-time info and verifiability.
architecture.zh: 模型可以在权重中存储大量知识，实现灵活连接，但检索有助于实时信息和可验证性。

architecture.en: Language models will serve as a core for other modalities, not be replaced by them.
architecture.zh: 语言模型将作为其他模态的核心，而非被其取代。

architecture.en: We may be in a local optimum; new architectures and loss functions could surpass current methods.
architecture.zh: 我们可能处于局部最优；新的架构和损失函数可能超越当前方法。

architecture.en: Large models are exciting but not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere.
architecture.zh: 大模型令人兴奋但并非全部，基础创新可以来自任何地方。

architecture.en: The idea of a single universal algorithm for intelligence dates back to neuroscience in the 1970s.
architecture.zh: 单一通用智能算法的想法可追溯到 1970 年代的神经科学。

architecture.en: GPT-4's internal representations are not just pattern matching; it learns algorithms.
architecture.zh: GPT-4 的内部表征不仅仅是模式匹配；它学习的是算法。

architecture.en: S4 is a state-space model designed for long-range dependencies in continuous signals like audio and biosignals.
architecture.zh: S4 是一种状态空间模型，专为音频和生物信号等连续信号中的长程依赖而设计。

architecture.en: Hippo provides a principled way to compress history into a state for online memorization.
architecture.zh: Hippo 提供了一种将历史压缩为状态以进行在线记忆的原则性方法。

architecture.en: S4 can be computed recurrently for online inference or convolutionally for parallel training.
architecture.zh: S4 可以递归计算用于在线推理，或卷积计算用于并行训练。

architecture.en: GFlowNets are a learnable replacement for MCMC, enabling efficient sampling and probability estimation.
architecture.zh: GFlowNets 是可学习的 MCMC 替代方案，能高效采样和估计概率。

architecture.en: Neural dynamic policies embed trajectory structure via dynamical systems for smooth, dynamic robot motion.
architecture.zh: 神经动态策略通过动力系统嵌入轨迹结构，实现平滑、动态的机器人运动。

architecture.en: Modular motor policies with message passing enable zero-shot generalization to novel robot morphologies.
architecture.zh: 带消息传递的模块化电机策略实现了对新机器人形态的零样本泛化。

architecture.en: Volumetric 3D representations are too heavy for robotics; 2D manifold reasoning is more efficient.
architecture.zh: 体积 3D 表示对机器人学过于沉重；2D 流形推理更高效。
